kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, seafood, A5 beef and egg (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–1:00 (last order 0:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch set meals (February and October 2025). Tabelog says no cards, but an October 2025 diner paid by card and PayPay. 40 seats incl. a tatami room; whole-shop hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). On Higashioji by the Chion-in bus stop, near Gion Kagetsu, 6 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; September and December 2025).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Higashioji, to 1 am] A cheerful okonomiyaki and teppan house by Gion Kagetsu theatre, its walls covered in comedians’ autographs: fluffy okonomiyaki, negiyaki, yakisoba, A5 diced steak and tongue, with good-value lunch sets (buta-tama ¥1,150) and late hours. Smoking allowed; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an okonomiyaki shop near the Gion Kagetsu theatre, popular with Yoshimoto comedians, now adding creative teppan dishes.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular brought a work party of 15 for the banquet course and noted it is a favourite of Yoshimoto comedians.
A December 2025 solo diner nearly skipped it as a regulars-only place, then came back and found it the best option nearby.
A February 2025 lunch guest had food on the table about five minutes after ordering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き、東山区大和大路新橋東入ル林下町438、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩6分、月・水〜日・祝日11:30〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:00)、火曜休み、カード不可 (2025年10月の口コミではカードと PayPay 可)、40席、座敷、喫煙可、テイクアウト、ふわふわのお好み焼き、A5 の角切りステーキ、京都の豆腐と Kujo ねぎの料理、常連に人気の卵焼き。口コミ (2022年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 祇園花月の近く、芸人のサインがいっぱい、昼の定食 (豚玉定食1,150円)、タンとリブロース、15名の宴会コース、ねぎ焼き、焼きそば、海鮮のお好み焼き、目玉焼きのせの豚ねぎ焼き。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in for the lunch sets; book for groups. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan wagyu courses with seasonal vegetables (2025–26 reviews); wagyu fillet katsu sandwiches are also sold (Tabelog); no gluten information.
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu teppan restaurant (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「無し」). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private room for 6 (Tabelog). Bukkoji-dori east of Karasuma, 1 min from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma (Tabelog). Opened 18 January 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.notes: [Wagyu teppan · Shijo-Karasuma, since 2019] A ten-seat teppan counter plus a private room just off Shijo-Karasuma, cooking Kuroge wagyu — Matsusaka strip loin, Chateaubriand, prize-winning Ushi no Nakayama fillet — in kaiseki-style courses with Kyoto vegetables and a 50-strong wine and sake list. Polished service; wagyu katsu sandwiches to order. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppanyaki restaurant opened in January 2019, serving Kyoto-cuisine-inspired meat dishes of selected Kuroge wagyu and seasonal Kyoto ingredients; a March 2025 diner notes staff from the Imperial Hotel.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner, served by staff from the Imperial Hotel, was left speechless by the Chateaubriand.
A September 2026 diner found the salad of vegetables from across Kyoto and Japan a star in its own right before the fillet.
A July 2025 business guest called the course an ultimate meat kaiseki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: 鉄板焼き・日本料理・牛肉料理、下京区仏光寺通烏丸東入ル上柳町328、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩1分、月〜土17:30〜22:00、日曜休み、サービス料なし、カード・PayPay 可、16席 (カウンター10、個室6)、2019年1月18日オープン、厳選した黒毛和牛と京都の旬の食材の京料理風の肉料理、おまかせコース (松阪牛ストリップロイン100g 28,600円、シャトーブリアン100g)、ワインと日本酒50種以上、黒毛和牛ヒレのカツサンド (予約制)。口コミ (2019年9月〜2026年9月、英語): 帝国ホテル出身のスタッフ、シャトーブリアン、肉の会席、綾部・城陽・大原の野菜と加賀れんこんのサラダ、Ushi no Nakayama の黒毛和牛ヒレ100g。

cultural_comfort.note: Reserve a course; private room for six. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.gf_detail: Ask. A wine and sake shop with a tasting counter; drinks only in the sources (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.vegan_detail: Ask. Natural wines, sake and craft beer at the counter (2025–26 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–21:00; may change (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). A 6-seat counter (Tabelog). Bottles of over ¥3,000 from the shelves can be opened at the counter with no corkage (November 2025). Yaoichi Honkan 2F, Higashinotoin south of Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.notes: [Wine and sake counter · Higashinotoin-Sanjo] A liquor shop on the second floor of Yaoichi Honkan with a six-seat counter where you can drink natural wine, local sake or craft beer by the glass from 10:00 to 21:00 — or open a bottle from the shelves (over ¥3,000) with no corkage. A handy stop while shopping.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a wine and sake shop inside Yaoichi Honkan with a tasting counter.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular opened a Champagne bought in the shop at the counter, free of corkage over ¥3,000.
A February 2026 visitor found warmth there on a snowy Kyoto night.
A September 2026 shopper had a glass of orange wine while waiting for the day’s deli dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインバー、中京区東洞院三条下る三文字町220 八百一本館 2F、毎日10:00〜21:00、カード可、6席。口コミ (2014年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 自然派ワイン、地酒、クラフトビールをカウンターで、3,000円以上のボトルは持ち込み料なし、昼に一杯とワインの購入、百貨店の地下のようなカウンター、オレンジワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a glass at the counter or pick a bottle from the shelves.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26024716/ (35.007634, 135.761305); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区三文字町220番地 (lot) 32m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_sushi_ryuka.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi on red-vinegar rice with soy and cooked side dishes; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 18:00–22:30, two seatings at 18:00 and 20:30; closed Wednesday, though a Wednesday may be arranged in advance (Tabelog). Reservations through TableCheck ("Kyoto Sushi Ryuka - 鮨 流嘉"); seat requests may change (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: 7 at the counter and a private room with a table for 4 (Tabelog). Gokomachi above Oike, a short walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2025). Opened in summer 2025 (June–August 2025 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.notes: [Sushi · Gokomachi-Oike, 11 seats] A new, glossy sushi counter near City Hall serving a ¥20,000 omakase of thick-cut fish on red-vinegar rice, with seasonal rarities and showy pieces topped with caviar and truffle. Two seatings nightly; book on TableCheck. Some 2026 guests found the service and pairings unpolished.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a sushi counter that opened in summer 2025 near Kyoto City Hall, with a modern, gold-accented interior and an entertaining chef (July 2025–February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic sushi for everyday Kyoto, easy for first-timers (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner discovered unfamiliar seasonal fish such as aburabozu and called the wild tuna the best ever eaten.
A February 2026 guest liked the fish but found the pieces piled with smoked meat, caviar and truffle too much luxury on luxury.
A January 2026 visitor praised the sushi but found the service let down by a new part-time staff member.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区御幸町通御池上る亀屋町384、市役所前駅のすぐ近く、月・火・木〜日 18:00〜22:30、2部制 (18:00・20:30)、水曜休み (事前相談で可)、予約は TableCheck「Kyoto Sushi Ryuka - 鮨 流嘉」から、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・電子マネー・QR 可、11席 (カウンター7、4名の個室1)。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 2025年夏の開店、赤酢のシャリ、厚く贅沢なネタ、天然のまぐろ、あぶらぼうずなど珍しい季節の魚、おまかせ流嘉コース20,000円 (税込)、燻製の肉・キャビア・トリュフをのせた握り、金を使った内装、楽しい料理人、新しいアルバイトの接客が不慣れだったとの声 (2026年1月)、組み合わせがいまひとつとの声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on TableCheck; two seatings; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.gf_detail: Ask. Raw-fish bowls may suit, but the marinated salmon and tuna sauces, soy and sauce katsu are not wheat-free; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood bowls, sauce katsu and pork miso soup (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30), closing early when sold out (Tabelog). Reservations through Tabelog only, not by phone; a seat-only booking costs ¥200 unless you order a drink (Tabelog original 席だけ予約の場合のみ200円). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 27 seats: 7 at the counter and tables for 2 and 4 (Tabelog). Take-away available (Tabelog). Daihachi Hase building B1F on Karasuma below Bukkoji; a few minutes from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.notes: [Seafood bowls · Karasuma-Bukkoji, basement, cash only] A casual basement bowl shop near Shijo-Karasuma where you build a kaisen-don from some 28 toppings — tuna, marinated salmon, negitoro, ikura — from ¥900, or try the Fukui sauce katsu; a cheap weekday set until 2 p.m. Solo-friendly. Some found the fish ordinary for the price.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a seafood-bowl and set-meal shop in a basement near Shijo-Karasuma offering customisable bowls of seasonal fish, bluefin tuna and salmon, and Fukui-style sauce katsu, with friendly staff (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 salmon lover booked the social-media-only bowl, ¥2,200 and five a day, and piled on marinated salmon until saying stop.
A March 2026 diner arriving just before closing was kindly served a cheap and delicious toro-taku bowl.
An April 2026 visitor found the tuna fishy and the bowl no better than a chain's.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮丼・食堂・海鮮、下京区烏丸通仏光寺下ル大政所町680-1 第八長谷ビル B1F、毎日 11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、売り切れ次第終了、予約は食べログのみで電話不可、席だけの予約は200円 (ドリンク注文で不要)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、27席 (カウンター7、テーブル)、テイクアウト可、約28種から選ぶ海鮮丼900円から、本まぐろ、鮭、福井のソースかつ、鯛のあら汁、豚汁。口コミ (2026年1月〜8月、英語): 平日14時までのサービス丼980円、SNS 限定・予約制で1日5食の漬けサーモンのせ放題2,200円、ねぎとろ・とろたく、鯛、海老、しらす、いくらや卵黄の追加、まぐろ・いか・アボカド・海苔の韓国風の丼、一人でも入りやすい、値段のわりに普通・まぐろが生臭いとの声 (2026年1・4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book via Tabelog only; solo-friendly.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.gf_detail: Not GF: fried dishes and soy-based simmered fish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and chicken izakaya (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–3:00 (last orders food 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; banquet courses (Tabelog). The appetiser is grilled at the table on a small charcoal grill and was thought pricey (September 2024; August 2026). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 70 seats with a counter and a sunken-kotatsu room for 14 (Tabelog). Non-smoking since April 2020 (Tabelog). No phone signal in the basement (November 2024). Sanjo COHJU building B1F, Sanjo east of Karasuma, near the Museum of Kyoto (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Sanjo-Karasuma basement, till 3 a.m.] A big, busy basement izakaya open until 3 a.m., with fish from around Japan, charcoal-grilled chicken and an appetiser you grill yourself on a shichirin. Popular with students and office workers; non-smoking. The appetiser charge is on the high side. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a 70-seat seafood izakaya near Sanjo-Karasuma open until 3 a.m. with seasonal seafood delivered daily and banquet courses (2024–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal seafood delivered daily (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner found fish here that are rarely seen in Kyoto, at fair prices.
A November 2025 group, finding the Oike bars closing early, came here for a second round and grilled the appetiser on the shichirin.
An August 2026 regular enjoyed the charcoal-grilled black chicken but felt the once-rare sashimi had become ordinary.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、中京区三条通烏丸東入ル梅忠町24 三条COHJUビル B1F、京都文化博物館の近く、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.料理2:00、飲み物2:30)、日曜休み、予約可、宴会コース、カード可、電子マネー不可、70席、14名の掘りごたつの個室、2020年4月から店内禁煙。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 七輪で焼く先付 (とびうおのひれ、いわし、海老など)、京都では珍しい魚の刺身、あぶらぼうずの煮付け、黒鶏の炭火焼き、焼き物、鍋、メニューが豊富、学生から会社員まで、お通しがやや高いとの声、地下で電波がない (2024年11月)、刺身が普通になったとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Late night; non-smoking; appetiser charged; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.gf_detail: Ask. Mizutaki chicken broth may suit, but it is served with ponzu, and kaiseki and sukiyaki use soy; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken mizutaki, beef and fish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00 (last orders food 20:30, drinks 21:00); closing days irregular (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No charge for appetisers (Tabelog original お通し代なし). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR; ask about payment for banquets (Tabelog). 200 tatami seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30 (Tabelog). A designated smoking area (Tabelog). In the north woods of Maruyama Park, next to Yasaka Shrine; about 15 min by car from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.notes: [Mizutaki and kaiseki · Maruyama Park] A ryokan-like house in Maruyama Park, said to date from 1896, serving Nagoya Cochin chicken mizutaki in private tatami rooms — rich broth, homemade ponzu, porridge to finish — plus yudofu and seasonal Kyoto gozen. Kind, attentive staff. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a renowned restaurant of over 100 years in Maruyama Park, serving seasonal Kyoto kaiseki and hot pots such as mizutaki. A November 2024 reviewer gives its founding as 1896.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki and traditional hot pots (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 former university club member came back for a farewell party, as the club always had, and the staff kept out of the room during speeches.
A May 2024 visitor's mother felt cold and the staff promptly brought a lap blanket.
An October 2026 birthday party had the Wakadori mizutaki at ¥6,600 and a complimentary agedashi tofu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・鍋、東山区円山公園北林、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理20:30、飲み物21:00)、不定休、予約可、お通し代なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、宴会の支払いは相談、200席 (座敷)、個室 (2名〜30名以上)、分煙、創業100年以上の老舗、円山公園で季節の京懐石と水炊きなどの鍋。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 八坂神社の隣、旅館のような雰囲気、名古屋コーチンの水炊きと自家製ポン酢、締めのおかゆ、若鶏の水炊き6,600円 (2026年10月)、1896年創業との声 (2024年11月)、Yasaka 御膳 (おぼろ豆腐、鱧、赤だし)、湯豆腐の会席、和牛ステーキの御膳、夏のすき焼き、ていねいな接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; private tatami rooms; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26004469/ (35.004931, 135.779094); the address (円山公園北林) has no town or lot and GSI finds no match, so the Tabelog pin is kept; nearest existing record 69.3 m (kyoto_gion_maruyama_kagaribi); 2026-11-08

kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: the food is toast, sandwiches, pancakes and cake; drinks only (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee, tea, juices, sodas and shaved ice; the food uses egg, cheese and butter (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.hours_raw: 09:00–18:00; closed Tuesday (Gion shopping street association; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 38 seats, tables only; non-smoking; Wi-Fi (Tabelog; June 2026). At the south-west corner of Shijo and Hanamikoji, across from Ichiriki Chaya (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.notes: [Kissaten · Shijo–Hanamikoji corner, a retro café since early Showa] An old-fashioned coffee shop on a busy Gion corner, calm inside, with breakfast sets from ¥650, a ¥1,000 hot egg sandwich set, thick honey-cheese toast and shaved ice in summer. No cards — QR pay accepted; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in the early Showa era as a Western-style restaurant, then rare; now a coffee shop serving coffee and light meals, still aiming "to serve what customers find delicious" (Gion shopping street association). Reviewers (2014–2026) describe a nostalgic café with kind staff, local regulars reading newspapers and many overseas visitors.
chef_bio.philosophy: To serve what customers find delicious, as since the founding (Gion shopping street association).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular had the ¥650 morning set before a kabuki show at the Minamiza.
An October 2026 regular praised the hot egg sandwich set for not having raised the price.
A July 2026 Saturday visitor escaped the heat with a ¥780 Blue Hawaii shaved ice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 祇園商店街振興組合: 喫茶 農園、京都市東山区祇園町南側571、当時は珍しい西洋料理のレストランとして昭和初期に開業、現在はこだわりのコーヒーと軽食の喫茶店、「お客様に美味しいと思っていただけるものをお出ししたい」という想いは創業当時から、9:00〜18:00、火曜定休。食べログ: NOEN、カフェ・喫茶店、四条花見小路西南角、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR決済可、38席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙。口コミ (2014〜2026年、英語): 南座の観劇前に、モーニングBセット (トースト、サラダ、コーヒー) 650円、コーヒー550円、ホットエッグサンドのサラダとドリンク付き1,000円、ベーコンエッグトーストのセット、チーズとはちみつの厚切りトースト、パンケーキ、ケーキ、メロンソーダ、レモンスカッシュ、バナナジュース、ブルーハワイのかき氷780円、レトロで落ち着いた店内、新聞を読む地元客、海外の客も多い、Wi-Fi、一力亭の向かい。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-in café, many overseas guests; no cards, QR pay accepted.

existence.note: Gion shopping street association page and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26020737/ (35.003692, 135.774961), at the Shijo–Hanamikoji corner as its address says; cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区祇園町南側571番地 (lot) 87m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_gion_eguchi.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with dashi, soy and saikyo miso, suppon and fugu hot pots, sushi to finish; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_gion_eguchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki built on fish, suppon and dashi (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_eguchi.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday (official site). Tabelog gives 17:30–22:00 Monday–Saturday and holidays, last order 21:00 and last seating 19:30. Reservations taken, also online; cancellation 100% up to 3 days before, 50% 4–7 days before; at least one drink per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Service charge 6% (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter, tatami rooms and private rooms for 8 and 10–20; non-smoking except in the private rooms; children welcome (Tabelog; official site). Katsumi Building 1F on Kiyomoto-cho, also reached from the Kiritoshi side (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_eguchi.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion Kiyomoto-cho, suppon all year] A calm Gion kaiseki house whose owner trained at Kyoto Kitcho: seasonal courses from ¥8,500 with a flower-dressed opening plate, plus suppon, hamo shabu-shabu and torafugu courses. Counter and private tatami rooms; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: The owner trained at Kyoto Kitcho and was head chef at two other restaurants before opening Gion Eguchi (September 2025 review). The official site, signed by owner 小林宏哉, describes choosing tableware and settings, wild hamo bought by the owner, suppon all year and menus that change with the seasons.
chef_bio.philosophy: Thoughtful hospitality: tableware chosen to suit, settings arranged with care, seasonal ingredients at the peak, each plate beautiful and easy to eat (official site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest returned after six years to the owner’s attentive service.
An April 2026 last-minute diner watched the head chef run the counter alone at an impressive pace.
A July 2026 business dinner had hamo twice, in a vinegared dish and a soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇おん 江口、京都市東山区清本町369 かつみビル1F、17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22時)、日曜定休、店主 小林宏哉、心を尽くすおもてなし、器の取り合わせとしつらい、旬の素材、すっぽん料理を通年で、鱧など天然物を店主が厳選、季節で変わる献立、カウンター席と完全個室、座敷、接待や宴会。食べログ: ぎおん えぐち、日本料理・ふぐ・すっぽん、月〜土・祝日 17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00、最終入店19:30)、日曜定休、カード可、PayPay可、電子マネー不可、サービス料6%、30席、個室 (8名、10〜20名)、個室のみ喫煙可、子供可、1人1ドリンク以上、キャンセル料は3日前から100%・4〜7日前は50%、コース: おまかせ8品8,500円、9品9,500円、焼酎の飲み放題90分付き9品13,000円、すっぽんコース10,800円、鱧しゃぶコース10,800円、とらふぐのコース (てっさ、てっちり、雑炊) 10,800円。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 京都吉兆で修業し2店で料理長を務めた店主、花を添えた先付、鱧、鶏の西京焼き、鮎の焼き物、赤だし、巻き寿司と押し寿司、ひとりで切り盛りする日も、落ち着いた雰囲気、値段は祇園では手ごろ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; cancellation fees from 7 days; 6% service.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_gion_eguchi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26003319/ (35.004832, 135.774744); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区清本町369番地 (lot) 6m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Oden and obanzai in dashi and soy, kamameshi; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden and obanzai in dashi; the kamameshi seen in reviews had bacon (October 2025).
kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:30 daily, then 21:30–00:30 as a karaoke bar; closing days vary (Tabelog; October 2025). Lunch: one set per diner — kamadaki oden set ¥1,980, Okoshiyasu lunch ¥1,650, obanzai and kamameshi lunch ¥2,420 (November 2025); kamameshi takes about 30 minutes (March 2026). Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog). A 13-seat counter; non-smoking; Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Hanami Kaikan 1F, Tominaga-cho, near Hanamikoji (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.notes: [Oden & obanzai · Gion Tominaga-cho, lunch sets and late karaoke] A thirteen-seat counter lined with Kyoto obanzai, with oden and kamameshi cooked to order: lunch sets from ¥1,650, oden in the evening, and karaoke with the mama-san from 9:30 pm.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2022–2026) describe a small counter where the owner chats with guests over oden and obanzai; one person can run lunch alone (November 2025), and from 21:30 the mama-san turns the place into a karaoke bar (October 2025).

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 guest who left a hat behind had it posted home with a note and a maiko postcard.
An October 2025 party of four older guests had sweet-potato-and-bacon kamameshi cooked at the counter.
An October 2025 late wanderer arrived at 9:30 pm just as the sign changed to karaoke.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おこしやす おでんとおばんざい、ちょっと釜めし、居酒屋・おでん、京都市東山区富永町123 花見会館1F、毎日 12:00〜15:00、18:00〜21:30、21:30〜0:30、定休日は不定、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可 (PayPay、Alipay、WeChat Pay)、13席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、1人でも入りやすい。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): おでんとおばんざい、目の前で炊く釜めし、さつまいもとベーコンの釜めし (2025年10月)、ランチは1人1セット、釜炊きおでんのセット1,980円、おこしやすランチ1,650円、おばんざいと釜めしのランチ2,420円 (2025年11月)、釜めしは30分ほどかかる、ランチはひとりで切り盛り、21時半からはママのカラオケ、忘れた帽子を舞妓のはがきを添えて送ってくれた、修学旅行生の割引、おばんざいに覆いがないのが気になるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; one lunch set per diner; karaoke after 21:30.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26037183/ (35.004335, 135.774987), offset ~8m east to clear こもれびのワインバー (1m, likely the same building); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区富永町123番地 (lot) 20m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.gf_detail: Ask. Creative izakaya dishes with dashi; katsu sandwiches, gyoza and gratin are on the menu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, meat and dashi-based dishes (reviews).
kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 34 seats: counter, tables, a tatami private room for 6–8 and a private room for 8–12 (no children) upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse in Miyagawa-cho, east of Matsubara and Kawabata (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 13 July 2018; sister shop of Apollo+ in the Apollo Group (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.notes: [Izakaya · Miyagawa-cho, creative dishes in a townhouse] A calm, renovated townhouse in the Miyagawa-cho geisha quarter serving inventive izakaya food — thick sashimi, ginger gyoza, a well-liked wagyu katsu sandwich — with fresh-fruit sours and a long wine list. Courses with free drinks from ¥6,600; book ahead; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in July 2018 as part of the Apollo Group, whose other open shop is Apollo+ near Sanjo (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a calm Miyagawa-cho townhouse with attentive service and many overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Creative izakaya dishes; wagyu katsu sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner singled out the rock-oyster gratin and wagyu katsu sandwich on the ¥8,800 course.
A July 2026 guest took the beef katsu sandwich home for breakfast.
An August 2026 regular had lost count of visits and finds booking essential.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京Apollo食堂 (京アポロ食堂)、ダイニングバー・居酒屋・海鮮、京都市東山区新宮川町通松原下ル西御門町444、月・水〜日 17:00〜24:00、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、34席、個室 (2階に6〜8名の座敷、8〜12名の個室は子供不可)、禁煙、2018年7月13日オープン、アポログループ (アポロプラス)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 宮川町の町家を改装、飲み放題付きコース6,600円、8,800円のコースで焼き茄子のポタージュ、岩牡蠣のグラタン、和牛のカツサンド、刺身の盛り合わせ、鶏レバーの生姜煮、生姜餃子、揚げ茄子、椎茸の肉詰め、持ち帰りの牛カツサンド、フルーツたっぷりのサワーと自家製果実酒、ワインが充実、海外の客も多い、予約は必須、料理の間が空くという声、家庭的な味という声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; many overseas guests.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026. The official site (kyo-apollo.jp) now shows only a hosting placeholder.

kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26031099/ (34.998578, 135.770425); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区西御門町444番地 (lot) 57m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_rokuroku_tantan_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken in the broth and the meat sauce (2025 reviews).
kyoto_rokuroku_tantan_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; Sat 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–20:30; closed Sundays; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash and cards (October 2025 review). Counter seats only (2025–26 reviews). Down a very narrow alley in Gion north of Shijo, 4–5 min from Yasaka Shrine (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_rokuroku_tantan_gion.notes: [Tantanmen · Gion] A small counter down a narrow Gion alley serving one thing: a creamy, mildly spicy golden-sesame tantanmen, finished with rice and cheese as a risotto. About ¥1,200.

chef_bio.background: Opened 30 June 2024 (Tabelog). The soup uses roasted Japanese golden sesame and sesame paste over a broth of Hokkaido kombu, shiitake and chicken (October 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 diner heard the shop is popular with Yoshimoto comedians, was told to try the balsamic vinegar on the counter, and was amazed how well it worked.
A June 2026 visitor, nervous about the narrow alley, was lent a paper apron by the master.
A January 2025 diner paid ¥1,700 for the coriander bowl and later learned prices were raised ¥500 over the first three days of the New Year.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ロクロクタンタン、tantanmen、東山区祇園町北側286-6、祇園四条駅から447m、月〜金 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜20:30、土 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜20:30、日曜休み、2024年6月30日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 4種類、ロクロクタンタン1,000円 (2025年)・1,200円 (2026年9月)、パクチーのせ1,400円 (2025年10月)、金ごまと練りごま、Hokkaido の昆布・しいたけ・鶏のスープ、京都の老舗の製麺所の麺、最後にご飯とチーズでリゾット風、カウンターのみ、狭い路地、現金・カード可。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors (September 2025); one dish, point and order.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_rokuroku_tantan_gion.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26041913/ (35.004319, 135.776740), moved 2m WNW to clear kyr_gion_duck_noodles (4.6m) and kyoto_gion_nakahara (5.8m); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側286番地 (lot) 22m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and sashimi may suit, but fried dishes and sauces are common (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal vegetable obanzai (February 2024), but dashi is likely; the owner adjusts dishes for guests (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). Tax and 10% service charge (Tabelog, whose "Original text" is in English: "Tax and Service charge 10% will be charged when checking."). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter and 6–8 at tables; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.notes: [Obanzai · Gion] A cosy wood-lined counter where the owner cooks seasonal obanzai and pairs sake and wine, with an English menu and many overseas regulars. About ¥5,000–8,000 plus 10%; adults only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 24 September 2023 (Tabelog). The owner once worked at a famous obanzai izakaya in Gion and runs the place with a part-timer (February 2024 review); trained properly in cooking (September 2024 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto vegetables, seafood and wagyu with sake from around Japan and wines (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai platter; shrimp and lotus-root dumplings.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 solo diner on a business trip had portions sized down, booked again for Thursday, and was remembered and served the dishes mentioned on the first night.
A September 2024 guest, brought by the mama of a usual Gion bar, was served an off-menu sea bream simmered in sake.
A March 2024 regular notes that drinks not on the menu are sourced from various suppliers to match the dishes.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お酒とお料理 来春、居酒屋・日本料理・魚介料理、東山区祇園町北側347-143、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、火〜日 17:00〜23:00、月曜休み、税とサービス料10% (原文も英語)、カード・電子マネー可、QR 不可、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル6〜8)、禁煙、子供不可、英語メニュー・英語スタッフあり、2023年9月24日オープン、季節のコース7,000円 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 店主は祇園の有名なおばんざいの居酒屋で働いていた、アルバイトひとりと営む (2024年2月)、おばんざいの盛り合わせ、ホタルイカ、海老と蓮根の揚げ団子、豚肉で巻いたごぼうの黒酢あん、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); many overseas guests (2024–25 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26040281/ (35.004798, 135.776688); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側347番地 (lot) 92m — a large Gion block; 2026-11-08

kyoto_menya_taro_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the Hokkaido-style broth has chicken; duck and egg in the others (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_menya_taro_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 8:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). 2024–25 reviews mention opening at 7:00. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter downstairs and tables upstairs (Tabelog; March 2025 review); non-smoking (Tabelog). In the Sanjo Shokusai Roji alley off Sakaimachi, 5 min from Karasuma-Oike, Shijo or Karasuma (Tabelog).
kyoto_menya_taro_sanjo.notes: [Somen · Sanjo] A somen specialist in a Sanjo food alley, open from 8 am, serving the warm, slightly sweet somen of the owner's Hokkaido home with seasoned rice and shaved ice. About ¥1,300–1,700; the owner speaks English.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 June 2024 (Tabelog). The owner recreates the flavours of a family home in Hokkaido (September 2024 review) and used to work as a restaurant consultant (November 2025 review); English picked up from customers (June 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Somen eaten warm, the Hokkaido way — "a different flavour of nyumen from Kansai and Kanto" (shop sign, March 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 regular finally got the Hokkaido-style somen, which on an earlier visit was off because the owner was not happy with the taste that day.
A March 2025 couple followed the smell of dashi into the alley and found the downstairs counter full of Western tourists.
A September 2024 diner who skipped the shaved ice was given some anyway, and found it the best thing there.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: めん屋 東太郎、麺類、中京区道祐町135-1 三条食彩ろぉじ なずなの舗、地下鉄烏丸御池駅・四条駅、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩5分、毎日 8:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、休みは変わる場合あり、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、18席、禁煙、2024年6月3日オープン。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): そうめんの専門店、店主は Hokkaido の出身で実家の味を再現、Hokkaido の昆布、donko しいたけ、ごぼう、鶏をひと晩煮たスープ、Ibo no Ito の麺、Omi の鴨のつけ汁のそうめん、釜玉そうめん、炊き込みご飯、抹茶のかき氷、店主は元飲食店のコンサルタント、英語が話せる。

cultural_comfort.note: The owner speaks English (June 2025 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_soda_shoten_kissa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the food is toast and baguette sandwiches; coffee and tea only (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_soda_shoten_kissa.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and tea; the food has egg, bacon, ham or cheese (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_soda_shoten_kissa.hours_raw: Wed–Sat 8:30–16:00; closed Mon, Tue and Sun; hours may change (Tabelog). A February 2025 review gives an 8:00 opening and an October 2025 review a morning drink set 8:00–11:00; an April 2024 visitor found it shut twice. Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 5 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeaway coffee (February 2025 review). In a quiet residential street of Shimogyo, about 490 m from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog; February 2026 review).
kyoto_soda_shoten_kissa.notes: [Kissa · Shimogyo] A five-seat counter kissa where the owner, working alone, brews each coffee to order and makes thick toast breakfasts and a fluffy tamagoyaki baguette. Under ¥1,000.

chef_bio.background: The owner runs the shop alone (February 2025 and February 2026 reviews). Opened as a place for locals to gather over coffee (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: A place where locals can gather and enjoy coffee at leisure (October 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 couple let a takeaway customer go first, and got a free coffee refill from the owner in thanks.
A February 2026 guest asked for a café au lait and was given warm milk at no charge.
A May 2026 visitor called the tamagoyaki in the baguette the best omelette ever eaten, as several groups were turned away.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 左右田商店喫茶室、喫茶店、下京区忠庵町307-1、清水五条駅から490m、水〜土 8:30〜16:00、月・火・日曜休み、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、カウンター5席、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 店主が一人で営む、Toast A 500円、Toast B 700円、卵焼きのバゲットサンド550円、8:00〜11:00は飲み物が200円、ブレンドコーヒー450円 (マイルドとビター)、Beans Tei の豆、固めのプリン、テイクアウト可。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny counter; overseas guests common (2024–26 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_yama_mitsuwa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Italian courses with pasta, baguette and focaccia, shrimp tempura and scallop katsu (2026 reviews). Reviewers say dietary restrictions were handled carefully (June–August 2026) — ask ahead.
kyoto_yama_mitsuwa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: venison, prosciutto, pâté, duck, beef, seafood and egg dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_yama_mitsuwa.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 21:30, drinks 22:15); closed Monday (holiday changes posted). Daytime 10:00–15:00 the front of the shop is a standing bar selling sake, wine, beer and snacks (Tabelog; October 2026 review). Reservations taken; 5+ by phone; please keep to your booking time. Service charge ¥800 per person — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料 800円(一名様)」. 21 seats: counter, a main table and sofa seats. Non-smoking; avoid strong perfume. Cards. Sommelier on staff; English-speaking staff. Children from elementary-school age only. 3 min walk from Shijo-Karasuma. Opened 18 January 2026.
kyoto_yama_mitsuwa.notes: [Italian × sake · Shijo-Karasuma, a counter with a daytime standing bar] A new counter Italian that cooks with Japanese touches — venison, duck, rare scallop katsu, squid-and-karasumi pasta — and pairs every course with wine or sake, chosen by the owners. About ¥10,000–19,000 with drinks; ¥800 service. By day the front is a sake standing bar. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 18 January 2026 (Tabelog), featured as a rumoured new opening in Tabelog Magazine. An October 2026 reviewer describes the owner couple — the husband handling wine, the wife Japanese sake — and a cheerful chef. Repeat reviewers praise attentive but unobtrusive service and careful handling of dietary restrictions, including half portions (June–October 2026). Criticism: dishes take time to arrive (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Japanese essence with Western techniques and flavors (August 2026 review title).
chef_bio.specialty: Counter Italian with wine and sake pairing.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "The owner couple is wonderful; the husband specializes in wine while the wife focuses on Japanese sake, and they provide very attentive suggestions and explanations about the drinks."
June 2026: "They were very accommodating with my dietary restrictions, and I truly appreciated that they adjusted the portion sizes to half."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 山三ツ輪、イタリアン・創作料理、中京区橋弁慶町235 1F、四条烏丸から徒歩3分、火〜日・祝日17:00〜23:00 (料理L.O.21:30、ドリンクL.O.22:15)、月曜休み、昼10:00〜15:00は立ち飲み (日本酒・ワイン・生ビールなど)、予約可 (5名以上は電話)、原文で「サービス料 800円(一名様)」、21席、禁煙、強い香水は控えるよう案内、カード可、ソムリエ・英語対応スタッフ、子供は小学生以上、2026年1月18日オープン、食べログマガジンで紹介。口コミ (2026年1月〜11月、英語): ワインと日本酒のペアリング、おまかせコースとアラカルト、鹿のロースト、あさりの酒蒸し、カルボナーラ風ポテトサラダ、ブッラータと生ハムと洋梨、京鴨のタリアータとArima山椒、ホタテのレアカツと西京味噌タルタル、イカとKujoねぎとからすみのパスタ、Omi鴨、鮎のコンフィ、食事制限への丁寧な対応 (2026年6〜8月)、夫がワイン・妻が日本酒を担当するオーナー夫婦と明るい料理人 (2026年10月)、料理に時間がかかる (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff and a sommelier (Tabelog); ¥800 service; children from elementary age.

staff_allergy_handling: Reviewers report careful handling of their dietary restrictions, including half portions (June–August 2026).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 18 January 2026) with reviews dated October and November 2026.

kyoto_kuradai_hassai.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fermentation courses built on miso, koji and soy-based seasonings, with namafu dengaku, miso kara-age and a sake-lees pound cake (2026 reviews). The shop asks guests to tell it of allergies in advance; same-day requests may not be possible (Tabelog).
kyoto_kuradai_hassai.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses include salmon, pork, chicken, wagyu, mackerel and ishiru fish sauce (2026 reviews), although miso, tofu and fermented vegetables feature heavily — ask.
kyoto_kuradai_hassai.hours_raw: Tabelog: Tue–Sat, holidays and the days before and after them 12:00–14:30 (food L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00); closed Sunday and Monday (also Tuesday after a three-day weekend; varies at New Year and Obon). Reservation only (TableCheck per an April 2026 review). Tell the shop of allergies in advance. Cards, IC and e-money. 18 seats: counter, tables and private rooms for 4 or 6 (¥2,000 room fee). Non-smoking. Smart casual. Children of school age who eat the adult menu. English, Chinese and Korean menus. A renovated townhouse 5 min from Karasuma-Oike. Opened 25 February 2026.
kyoto_kuradai_hassai.notes: [Fermentation cuisine · Karasuma-Oike, a miso maker's townhouse dining room] A new restaurant from the miso shop 蔵代味噌 where every course runs on fermentation — house miso soups, koji-cured fish, Hatcho-miso wagyu, clay-pot rice — at about ¥4,000 for lunch and ¥10,000+ at dinner. Reservation only; tell them of allergies ahead. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Operator: the miso wholesaler behind 蔵代味噌
chef_bio.background: Opened 25 February 2026 (Tabelog). An April 2026 reviewer writes that it is a fermentation restaurant run by a long-established miso wholesaler, "Japanix" (romaji as given), and a September 2026 reviewer links it to Kuradai Miso, the bulk miso shop near Nishiki Market. A June 2026 reviewer says one person cooks. Criticism: pricey for the portion and water only on request (October 2026); a limited lunch menu (June 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fermentation knowledge — koji, miso, amazake — to nourish body and mind (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Fermentation courses; house miso soups; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "This is a fermentation cuisine restaurant run by a long-established miso wholesaler… The variety of fermented ingredients is impressive, including the unique fermented udo!"

September 2026: "I used to visit Kuradai Miso, a bulk miso shop near Nishiki Market, whenever I went to Kyoto… When I heard that Kuradai Hassai opened as a restaurant in February 2026, I decided to visit."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 蔵代醗彩、日本料理・創作料理、中京区亀甲屋町608-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、火〜土・祝日・祝日の前日と翌日12:00〜14:30 (料理L.O.13:30)・17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、日・月曜休み (三連休明けは火曜も)、完全予約制、アレルギーは事前に連絡を (当日は対応できない場合あり)、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー可、18席、個室 (4・6名、2,000円)、禁煙、スマートカジュアル、子供は大人と同じ料理が食べられる小学生以上、英語・中国語・韓国語メニュー、2026年2月25日オープン。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 蔵代味噌の発酵料理店、町家を改装、発酵松花堂4,180円 (土鍋ご飯と2種の味噌汁、2026年4月)、4種の味噌の味噌汁、発酵うど、発酵白菜のパテ、酒粕の鯖、Hatcho味噌ソースの和牛、白味噌汁、Tangoの貝の酢味噌、生麩田楽、Tanba鶏の味噌唐揚げ、銀だらの西京焼き、しそ味噌のおにぎり、さつまいものアイス (2026年9月)、料理人は一人 (2026年6月)、量の割に高め・水は頼まないと出ないとの声 (2026年10月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English, Chinese and Korean menus (Tabelog); reservation only; smart casual.

staff_allergy_handling: Tabelog: tell the shop of allergies in advance; same-day requests may not be possible.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 25 February 2026) with reviews dated September and October 2026.

kyoto_namaste_dhaulagiri_yasui.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Indian and Nepali curries with naan (including cheese and sweet red-bean naan), momo dumplings and samosa (2017–2026 reviews). Rice dishes (jeera rice, biryani, dal bhat) exist — ask about the curries.
kyoto_namaste_dhaulagiri_yasui.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog marks vegetarian options and the shop is particular about vegetables; pumpkin and spinach daily curries, chana masala, vegetable biryani and dal bhat appear in reviews (2018–2026), but ghee, cream and yogurt sauces were not described.
kyoto_namaste_dhaulagiri_yasui.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00; closed on irregular days. Reservations taken. Cards. 46 seats; private hire for parties of 20–35. Non-smoking. Take-out. Kids' menu (Tabelog). Coin-parking cash-back ¥100 at lunch, ¥200 at dinner (Tabelog). 1 min south of the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing, past Yasaka-dori; 2 min from the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop. Opened 27 December 2015. One of at least two ナマステダウラギリ shops (another by Iwashimizu-Hachimangu Station, Yawata — retty.me).
kyoto_namaste_dhaulagiri_yasui.notes: [Indian & Nepali · Higashiyama-Yasui near Yasaka Shrine, a curry house for sightseers] A roomy curry house a minute from the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing, with good-value lunch sets from ¥850, Nepali dal bhat and momo, biryani and cheese naan, and an all-you-can-eat-and-drink option. Vegetarian choices. Open daily 11:00–22:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 December 2015 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a friendly manager (2017), the smell of incense, North Indian curries and Nepali dishes, and many overseas guests (2024). Criticism: a salty chicken curry and soup in a children's plastic cup (January 2020); mild, similar curries in the special lunch and a cramped toilet (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch curry sets; momo; dal bhat.

anecdotes.text: November 2022: "This chicken momo appears in the form of dumplings floating in a tangy broth… Moreover… they were delicious!"
September 2025: "This was my first experience with biryani, and it came with a yogurt-based sauce for a flavor twist. It was delicious and not spicy at all."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ナマステ ダウラギリ 東山安井店、インド料理・カフェ・居酒屋、東山区玉水町80-2、市バス東山安井から徒歩2分、東山安井交差点から南へ1分 (八坂通の先)、毎日11:00〜22:00、不定休、予約可、カード可、46席、貸切20〜35名、禁煙、テイクアウト、キッズメニュー、野菜にこだわり・ベジタリアンメニューあり、日替わりランチ850円 (ソフトドリンク付き)、ディナーコース1,390円〜、食べ飲み放題3,700円、近くのコインパーキング代を昼100円・夜200円キャッシュバック、2015年12月27日オープン。口コミ (2017年8月〜2026年10月、英語): Bセット1,000円 (2020年1月)、ネパールのダルバート1,590円、スペシャルランチ1,950円 (2026年10月)、スープのモモ、マトンビリヤニ (2022年11月)、野菜ビリヤニとヨーグルトソース (2025年9月)、カダイチキン、チャナマサラ、ジーラライス (2018年12月)、チーズナン、あんこのナン、海外の客が多い、カレーがしょっぱいとの声 (2020年1月)、トイレが狭いとの声 (2026年10月)。別店舗に八幡店 (石清水八幡宮駅前)。

cultural_comfort.note: Popular with overseas guests (2024); vegetarian options (Tabelog).

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated September 2025 and October 2026.

kyoto_hunto_standing_bar.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wagyu "meat dogs" and fruit dogs in buns, shrimp-bread skewers, butter sandwiches, cheese balls and fries (2025 reviews).
kyoto_hunto_standing_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu and Omi-beef skewers, beef jerky, shrimp and cheese dishes. The fruit sodas, smoked nuts and strawberry tasting are plant-based (2025 reviews) — ask about the rest.
kyoto_hunto_standing_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–20:00 (2025 reviewers give a 10:00 opening); hours and closures may change. No reservations. Order and pay at the register (April 2025). Cards, IC, e-money and QR. 16 standing places, with chairs when free; parties up to 20. Non-smoking. Take-out. On Shimogawara-dori south of Yasaka Shrine's south gate, about 4 min walk from the shrine; a wine stand, SUMI, with a wine vending machine at the back (May 2025). Opened 3 April 2025.
kyoto_hunto_standing_bar.notes: [Standing bar & take-out · Shimogawara near Yasaka Shrine, wagyu dogs and fruit sodas] A sleek concrete standing bar on Shimogawara-dori serving charcoal-grilled wagyu skewers, wagyu hot dogs, berry "fruit dogs" and bright fruit sodas or sours, from late morning, to eat in or carry along the sightseeing route. Most items ¥500–1,350. Open daily.

roles: Owner (unnamed; menu supervised by a chef from a Michelin-listed Japanese restaurant)
chef_bio.background: Opened 3 April 2025 (Tabelog; two March 2025 reviews come from the pre-opening reception). Reviewers write that the owner, or the supervising chef, has experience at a Michelin-starred Kyoto restaurant; the restaurant is not named. Reviewers describe friendly staff and many overseas visitors. Criticism: an April 2025 reviewer found it aimed at inbound tourists and a skewer overpriced at ¥900. No review since July 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Wagyu dogs and skewers; seasonal fruit sodas.

anecdotes.text: April 2025: "This luxurious standing bar allows you to enjoy authentic Wagyu beef and a selection of cocktails and other alcoholic beverages!"
April 2025: "After ordering and paying at the register, they bring it to your seat. Most of the customers around me were foreigners. It seems to be a place aimed at inbound tourists."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: はんと HUNTO、立ち飲み・バル・ジューススタンド、東山区下河原町487、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、毎日11:00〜20:00 (2025年の口コミでは10時開店)、予約不可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、立ち席16、立食20名まで、禁煙、テイクアウト、本格和牛と京都の地酒を気軽に楽しむ立ち飲み、自家製ソースとスパイスの「和牛ドッグ」、季節の果物のサワーとソーダ。口コミ (2025年3月〜7月、英語、うち2件はレセプション): ミシュラン掲載の日本料理店出身の料理人の監修、和牛のミートドッグ1,350円、フルーツドッグ900円、インカのめざめの手切りポテト550円、フルーツソーダ800〜850円、和牛とOmi牛の串、エビパン串、チーズボール、いちご4種の食べ比べ、Kobe Takami牛のビーフジャーキー500円、燻製ナッツ、生ビール600円、奥にワインスタンド「SUMI」、インバウンド向けとの声 (2025年4月)、2025年4月3日オープン。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the counter; many overseas visitors (2025).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 3 April 2025) with reviews to July 2025; no review since then.

kyoto_bistro_le_saint_jou.gf_detail: Ask. Pâté, fried and grilled dishes, pasta, beef stew and homemade bread; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_le_saint_jou.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pâté, ayu, carpaccio, beef stew and cheesecake (2025 reviews).
kyoto_bistro_le_saint_jou.hours_raw: 16:00–23:00; closed on irregular days (Tabelog). The owner works alone — call ahead (April 2025). Cards: JCB, AMEX and Diners; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). About 8–10 counter seats facing an open kitchen (Tabelog; October 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Manjuji-dori west of Takakura, 4 min from Gojo (Tabelog).
kyoto_bistro_le_saint_jou.notes: [Bistro · Gojo-Takakura, a one-man counter] A tiny counter bistro where the friendly owner cooks everything alone in a spotless open kitchen: half portions of pâté, grilled ayu, pasta and beef stew, or a course with bread baked fresh between dishes. Book by phone.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the owner runs the bistro single-handed (April and October 2025), describe a friendly, cheerful chef (May and September 2025) and an open kitchen kept spotless (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 regular found the chef disappointed not to have the Toyama fish for the carpaccio that day — and still loved it.
At an October 2025 birthday dinner the party were the only guests, and the homemade bread proved impossible to stop eating.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ ル・サンジュ、フレンチ、下京区万寿寺通高倉西入万寿寺中之町68、地下鉄五条駅から徒歩約4分、16:00〜23:00、不定休、カードはJCB・AMEX・Diners、10席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 店主が一人で営む、電話してから、カウンターのみ、目の前で調理、ハーフポーションでいろいろ (パテ、揚げ物、焼き物、パスタ、ビーフシチュー)、骨を抜いた鮎とバルサミコソース、カルパッチョ、ポテトサラダ、チーズケーキ、和食器と箸で出す創作フレンチのコース、料理ごとに焼く自家製パンのおかわり自由、人参のカラムーチョ、清潔なオープンキッチン。

cultural_comfort.note: One-person counter; call ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_hana_koma_okonomiyaki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki and yakisoba (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hana_koma_okonomiyaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork okonomiyaki, mixed okonomiyaki and yakisoba, chicken gizzards (2026 reviews).
kyoto_hana_koma_okonomiyaki.hours_raw: Monday, Wednesday–Sunday 11:00–19:00; closed Tuesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Cards: JCB, Diners and UnionPay; PayPay (Tabelog). 40 seats: tables for 6 and 4 and three tatami tables for 4 (Tabelog). In the quiet streets between Kodai-ji and Kiyomizu-dera, about 10 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; April 2026).
kyoto_hana_koma_okonomiyaki.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Higashiyama near Kodai-ji, owner-run] A homely, Showa-feeling okonomiyaki house in the quiet lanes between Kodai-ji and Kiyomizu, run by a cheerful owner alone — mixed okonomiyaki from ¥800, buta-tama and yakisoba at prices free of tourist mark-ups. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: An April 2026 reviewer writes that a cheerful owner runs the place alone, giving it a homely feel.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor, hungry after a long day of walking near Kiyomizu, stopped for a ¥800 mixed okonomiyaki with extra green onion.
A July 2026 diner was surprised to find green beans in the okonomiyaki — and liked it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 花こま、お好み焼き、東山区下弁天町58-1、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、月・水〜日 11:00〜19:00、火曜定休、予約可、カードはJCB・Diners・UnionPay、PayPay可、40席 (6人テーブル1、4人テーブル2、座敷4人3)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 明るい店主が一人で営む家庭的な店、ミックスお好み焼き800円とねぎ100円、豚玉、ミックス焼きそば、いんげん入りのお好み焼き、砂肝、ビール、飲み物込みで1,000円、昭和の雰囲気、観光地価格ではない。

cultural_comfort.note: Homely and cheap; PayPay accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki courses with hot pots, seasonal fish, Wagyu and Kyoto vegetables; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, black Wagyu and hot pots in dashi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday–Saturday and days before holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday, though it may open on request (Tabelog). Lunch by reservation only, weekday limited lunches (Tabelog). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 56 seats in private rooms for 2 to 30, renovated from a century-old ryokan (Tabelog; January 2026). Down a long corridor from an alley off Kiyamachi by the Takase river, north of Oike, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Kamikiyamachi, a former ryokan] A calm kaiseki house reached down a long corridor off Kiyamachi, in a century-old former ryokan by the Takase river, with private rooms for 2 to 30: seasonal fish, black Wagyu and Kyoto vegetables in courses of about ¥8,000–11,000, and sake plans for groups. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Flagged: tied to the たん熊北店 group per a review.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T8130001026429 is registered to 株式会社左近太郎 of Sakyo-ku (NTA register). A January 2026 reviewer says the restaurant belongs to the same group as 熊魚菴 たん熊北店. Reviewers praise well-timed, polite service (July 2025, August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 guest was led down a long corridor to a calm upstairs room hung with a Gion Matsuri decoration.
A September 2025 family drank every drop of the rich mushroom hot-pot broth.

kyoto_chikara_mochi_shokudo_kiyomizu5.notes: [Udon and mochi diner · near Rokuharamitsuji, cash only] A homely 力餅食堂 near Rokuharamitsuji serving gentle-dashi udon — chikara udon with grilled mochi, kitsune, curry, beef-tendon ankake — with red rice, inari and kinako ohagi. chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: one of the Kyoto diners carrying the 力餅食堂 name, near Rokuharamitsuji and Rokudo Chinnoji, with young staff alongside the old hands (January 2026), loved locally and busy with visitors (2026 reviews). An October 2026 regular on the way to Rokuharamitsuji got the last inari-zushi to go with a chikara udon.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian restaurant opened 1 April 2005 at the corner of Oike and Yanaginobamba. Reviewers in 2026 describe a stone exterior, a calm interior with private rooms and regulars who return for anniversaries.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 couple, back again for a wedding anniversary, started with horse meat and the assorted antipasti the couple always loves.
A June 2026 group booked a private room for the lunch course and felt like walking into Harry Potter.
A May 2026 lunch guest in heavy rain watched the room fill up, and singled out the crisp-skinned sautéed amadai.

kyoto_teuchi_soba_sou.notes: [Hand-cut soba · Furukawa-cho, lunch only] A clean, quiet soba shop in an apartment building near Furukawa-cho market, milling buckwheat on a stone mill by the door and cutting juwari (100% buckwheat) noodles fresh each day — good enough to eat with just salt — plus inaka soba with tempura, duck nanban and soba pudding. Lunch only; closed Tuesday and often Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a soba shop with a stone mill by its entrance, making juwari soba fresh every day (August 2026).

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor came on from buying fresh wheat gluten in Furukawa-cho and found large, perfectly cooked shiitake on the soba.
An August 2026 visitor, nervous at the apartment-like entrance, found a spotless room and a stone mill grinding the day’s flour.
A November 2026 diner found the juwari soba delicious with nothing but salt.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened in November 2024, cooking genre-free dishes from fresh seafood, Kuroge wagyu and seasonal Kyoto vegetables.

kyoto_menya_torichu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: thin wheat noodles; kara-age sets (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_menya_torichu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken paitan broth and chicken chashu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_menya_torichu.hours_raw: Mon–Thu and the day before or after a holiday 11:30–16:00 and 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30); Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–21:00; open all year with occasional days off (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 12 seats incl. a counter (Tabelog; January 2026). Heated tobacco only, in a designated area (Tabelog). Bellagio Kyoto Kodaiji 1F on Higashiyama-dori, 1 min from the Higashiyama Yasui bus stop (Tabelog). Opened 26 September 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_menya_torichu.notes: [Chicken paitan ramen · Higashiyama Yasui] A twelve-seat ramen counter on the Higashiyama-dori walk between Yasaka Shrine and Kiyomizu, run by a Kyoto chicken shop with 60 years of history: a smooth, rich Akaji-chicken paitan with thin noodles, chicken chashu and lots of Kujo green onion, plus a shoyu bowl and kara-age sets. Open daily, until 21:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened in September 2022 by a long-established Kyoto chicken restaurant said to have 60 years of history, making Kyoto-style ramen with local chicken and Kujo green onion.

anecdotes.text: A June 2023 visitor followed a banner reading "ramen made by a chicken shop founded in Kyoto 60 years ago" and had the set with kara-age and rice.
A January 2026 weekday lunch guest found the counter empty and had a bowl in about five minutes.
A November 2026 diner found the broth rich and the chicken chashu tender, if a little pricey for the location.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: ラーメン、東山区毘沙門町31 ベラジオ京都高台寺 1F、東山安井バス停から徒歩1分、祇園四条駅から約12分、月〜木・祝日前後11:30〜16:00 と17:30〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、金〜日・祝日11:30〜21:00、年中無休 (不定休あり)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、12席、加熱式たばこのみ分煙、2022年9月26日オープン、創業60年の鶏料理店の、京都の地鶏と Kujo ねぎの鶏白湯ラーメン、特製醤油ラーメン。口コミ (2022年11月〜2026年11月、英語): なめらかな鶏白湯と細麺、たっぷりのねぎ、鶏チャーシュー、からあげとご飯のセット。

cultural_comfort.note: A small counter on a busy sightseeing street; quick service.

kyoto_gion_kotobukiya.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and grilled dishes may suit; the kitchen takes requests (December 2024 review); fried dishes and pasta are common.
kyoto_gion_kotobukiya.vegan_detail: Ask. Fresh yuba, avocado and agedashi tofu (2024–26 reviews), but dashi is likely.
kyoto_gion_kotobukiya.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥400 when ordering a la carte (Tabelog Japanese original 「付出400円（単品ご注文時）」). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter downstairs and four private rooms upstairs (for 4, 6, 10 and 12; ¥1,000 room fee for two guests); smoking only in private rooms and a smoking space (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Children welcome, with a children's menu on request; BYO drinks (Tabelog). 5 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_kotobukiya.notes: [Izakaya · Gion] A machiya izakaya on the edge of Gion with a counter in front of the kitchen and private rooms upstairs: fresh sashimi, charcoal grilling, mentaiko rice soup and off-menu requests. About ¥4,000–8,000.

chef_bio.background: A friendly master with a lovely voice, helped by female and part-time staff (May 2024 and August 2025 reviews). The kitchen takes any request — fish, meat, kushikatsu or pasta (December 2024 review).

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 guest stopping by after a theatre show got sake in a bamboo flask with a choice of cup, and found the place as lively as an Osaka izakaya.
A December 2025 first-timer at the counter found the mentaiko rice soup so filling it replaced the usual closing ramen.
An April 2025 diner was surprised to find sea-urchin pasta on the menu in a machiya.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園ことぶきや、日本料理・居酒屋・焼鳥、東山区祇園町北側347-17、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜土 17:00〜24:00、日曜・祝日休み、お通し400円 (単品のとき)、カード可、電子マネー不可、30席、個室4つ、喫煙は個室と喫煙スペース、子供可、持ち込み可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 町家の居酒屋、1階はカウンター、2階は個室、刺身の盛り合わせ、生湯葉、明太子の雑炊、雲丹のパスタ、和牛のステーキ5,500円 (2025年6月)、炭火焼き、何でも作ってくれる (2024年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter or private rooms; book rooms ahead.

kyoto_coffee_and_wine_ushiro.gf_detail: Ask. Pudding and coffee; breakfast is toast, croque monsieur or sandwiches (2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_and_wine_ushiro.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee and iced tea; the pudding and breakfasts have egg or dairy (2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_and_wine_ushiro.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:00–11:00 daily; coffee 12:00–19:00 (Sun–Thu) or 12:00–21:00 (Fri, Sat), a wine bar in the evening; hours may change (Tabelog). Breakfast is mostly booked by hotel guests; walk-ins may get only the toast set (August 2026 review). Order at the counter, then sit (April 2026 review). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 35 seats; non-smoking; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). On the ground floor of the TSUGU 京都三条 by THE SHARE HOTELS, to the right inside an apparel shop, 5 min from Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_coffee_and_wine_ushiro.notes: [Café & wine bar · Sanjo] A hidden café behind an apparel shop in a Sanjo hotel: breakfast with HIYORI BROT toast from 7 am, careful lattes and a firm pudding by day, wine in the evening. About ¥1,000–2,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 31 May 2019 (Tabelog) in the TSUGU 京都三条 hotel. Staff share recommendations at the counter (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Morning café, afternoon coffee specialist, evening wine bar (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 walk-in at 7:30 am could only get the toast set, and called the toast — from HIYORI BROT in Tanba — the best ever eaten.
A September 2026 breakfast guest liked the coffee of the day enough to buy similar beans to take home.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒー アンド ワイン ウシロ、カフェ・ワインバー、中京区桝屋町75 TSUGU 京都三条 by THE SHARE HOTELS 1F、烏丸御池駅から440m、毎日 朝食 7:00〜11:00、コーヒー 12:00〜19:00 (金・土は21:00まで)、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、35席、禁煙、子供可、テイクアウト可、2019年5月31日オープン、朝はモーニング、昼はコーヒー、夜はワインバー。口コミ (2026年、英語): プリン580円、カヌレ、カフェラテ850円、抹茶ラテ930円、水出しコーヒー、トーストのモーニング (パンは Tanba の HIYORI BROT)、朝食は主にホテルの客の予約、洋服の店の奥。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; hotel guests common.

kyoto_sushi_sanjusou_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi is often seasoned with soy sauce and simmered anago with sweet sauce; ask about tamari (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_sanjusou_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi course of fish and shellfish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_sanjusou_gion.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 21:30); closed Mondays (Tabelog). Reservation only, by the day before; four groups a day (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 6 counter seats; non-smoking; a sommelier and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). Hidden down Shinbashi-dori behind a back alley in Gion, 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; August 2026 review).
kyoto_sushi_sanjusou_gion.notes: [Sushi · Gion] A new six-seat counter hidden in a Gion back alley, where women sushi chefs serve an ¥11,000 nigiri course with domestic sea urchin and sommelier-picked sake. Opened July 2026; booking by the day before.

chef_bio.background: Opened 28 July 2026 (Tabelog). The owner-chef, a woman, cooked Western food at a hotel in Osaka before opening this first sushi restaurant (August 2026 review); female sushi chefs work the counter (August 2026 review). An August 2026 guest describes the head chef as beautiful.
chef_bio.philosophy: Ingredients sourced from around Japan, such as additive-free raw sea urchin (August 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Nigiri course with domestic sea urchin.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found no phone number on Tabelog, booked through another site, and was shown a large sweet shrimp before the course began.
An August 2026 guest, back for a second time with a senior colleague, praised the sommelier's sake pairings.
A critical August 2026 reviewer praised the sushi from a first-time sushi owner but found the drinks pricey and the pace slow.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鮨 三重奏、寿司、東山区祇園町北側347-160 佐々木会館1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、火〜日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 料理20:00、ドリンク21:30)、月曜休み、予約のみ (前日まで)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、6席、禁煙、ソムリエ、英語のスタッフ、2026年7月28日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 1日4組、にぎりのコース11,000円、国産の雲丹、店主は女性で大阪のホテルで洋食の経験、初めての鮨屋、女性の鮨職人、ほうじ茶のプリン。

cultural_comfort.note: English-speaking staff (Tabelog); the chef explains each piece (August 2026 review).

kyoto_restaurant_miki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: French kaiseki courses with bread, quiche, a crab cream croquette and sauces (2016–2025 reviews).
kyoto_restaurant_miki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood and beef courses with flan, cheesecake and ice cream (2016–2026 reviews).
kyoto_restaurant_miki.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (lunch by reservation only) and 18:00–22:00; closed Tuesday. Reservations taken; walk-ins welcome at dinner (Tabelog). Cards. 14 seats: 6 at the counter, tables (2019 review); private hire up to 20. Non-smoking. Ask about dishes for children. 1st floor of the 彩花亭ビル on Gokomachi north of Oike, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae. Opened 1 July 2014.
kyoto_restaurant_miki.notes: [French kaiseki · Gokomachi-Oike near City Hall, French with chopsticks] A homely counter where the chef cooks seasonal French courses in kaiseki style — hassun-like appetizers, carpaccio, chilled soups, fillet steak, then rice and pickles — all eaten with chopsticks. Lunch from about ¥3,300 (book ahead), dinner ¥6,000–15,000. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 1 July 2014 (Tabelog). The listing says the owner has over ten years in French cuisine; 2016 and 2019 reviewers write that he trained at Okumura (romaji as given; Ichijoji and Gion per the 2019 reviewer). A February 2021 reviewer says the owner runs it alone; August 2025 and April 2026 reviewers describe the chef and his wife running it together. Criticism: "lacks distinctiveness" (October 2016).
chef_bio.philosophy: Casual French dining with chopsticks in a Japanese setting (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: October 2019: "The chef trained at Okumura in Ichijoji and Gion, and the presentation of the dishes is reminiscent of the master Okumura."
April 2026: "I highly recommend the counter seats, where you can enjoy a delightful time chatting with the couple who run the place."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Restaurant 幹、日本料理・フレンチ、中京区御幸町御池上ル亀屋町397-1 彩花亭ビル1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、月・水〜日・祝日12:00〜15:00 (昼は予約制)・18:00〜22:00、火曜休み、予約可 (当日の来店も歓迎)、カード可、14席、貸切20名まで、禁煙、2014年7月1日オープン、フレンチ歴10年以上の店主による箸で食べるフレンチ懐石。口コミ (2016年4月〜2026年8月、英語): 昼のコース3,300円・5,300円、夜のコース6,300円 (2019年)、八寸風の前菜、ヒラメとグレープフルーツのカルパッチョ、冷製スープ、鰆のポワレ、豚肩肉のビール煮込み、牛ヒレ、蟹クリームコロッケ、オマール海老のスープ、あわび、アスパラのアイス、Okumuraで修業した料理人、一人で営む (2021年)、料理人と奥さんの二人で営む (2025年・2026年)、個性に欠けるとの声 (2016年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter with the chef couple; chopsticks only; lunch by reservation.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated April and August 2026.

kyoto_cafe_kawataro.gf_detail: Ask: drinks (coffee, tea, matcha, floats) and cakes — cheesecake, gâteau chocolat, sponge and chiffon cakes (2023–2026 reviews); no gluten-free option is mentioned.
kyoto_cafe_kawataro.vegan_detail: Ask: black coffee, tea and matcha are plant-based; the cakes, lattes and ice-cream floats contain dairy or egg (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_kawataro.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 12:00–17:30; hours and closed days may change. No credit cards — cash only (Tabelog; May 2025 and August 2026 reviews). Sofa seating facing a Japanese garden. Non-smoking. Quiet, with no music; reviewers ask visitors to keep their voices down (2025–2026). Near Kodaiji and Nene-no-michi, south of Yasaka Shrine. Opened 28 June 2014.
kyoto_cafe_kawataro.notes: [Garden café · Kodaiji near Nene-no-michi, a silent room facing a garden] A calm, music-free café in an old house where big windows frame a Japanese garden: cake sets, floats and matcha for about ¥900–1,500, usually without a queue even in high season. Cash only. Open daily from noon.

chef_bio.background: Opened 28 June 2014 (Tabelog). A March 2024 reviewer understood the house had been a traditional restaurant before becoming a café; a March 2026 reviewer found an elderly woman running everything alone. Reviewers love the garden view and quiet. Criticism: a matcha latte that tasted like instant mix at ¥900 (March 2026); weak iced coffee (July 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Cake sets and drinks with a garden view.

anecdotes.text: May 2025: "The interior had a modern Japanese style, and I could see a garden in the back! … The café was quiet, with no music playing, allowing us to enjoy our tea in peace."
March 2026: "There was an elderly woman managing everything by herself. The view is beautiful, and the interior is clean."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ カワタロ、カフェ、東山区高台寺鷲尾町505、毎日12:00〜17:30、営業時間・定休日は変更の可能性あり、カード不可、ソファ席、禁煙、公式サイト cafekawataro.com、2014年6月28日オープン。口コミ (2023年7月〜2026年8月、英語): 高台寺・ねねの道近くの庭を眺めるカフェ、マンゴーフロート850円、ピンクグレープフルーツフロート850円、抹茶と和菓子1,100円、抹茶アフォガート880円 (2025年5月)、抹茶ラテ900円 (2026年3月)、チーズケーキとガトーショコラのケーキセット、シフォンケーキ、音楽のない静かな店内、現金のみ、年配の女性が一人で切り盛り (2026年3月)、抹茶ラテがインスタントのようとの声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Very quiet — conversation is discouraged by regulars; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated April, July and August 2026.

kyoto_kyoshubo_fujikawa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tempura, fried conger eel, soba salad and sea-bream nyumen alongside sashimi and dashi dishes (2017–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyoshubo_fujikawa.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, beef tataki, conger eel, grilled fish and dashimaki (2017–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyoshubo_fujikawa.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun 17:30–23:00 (last entry 22:00); closed Thursday and the third Wednesday of each month. Reservations taken. Cards, IC, e-money and QR. 11 seats: 5 at the counter, 6 at tables; private hire up to 20. Non-smoking (vapour-type e-cigarettes only inside; ashtray outside). Children welcome. Down an alley off Kiyamachi south of Nijo — tell a taxi "Kiyamachi-dori Nijo-sagaru Oshikojibashi" (Tabelog); 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae exit 2. Opened 9 July 2010.
kyoto_kyoshubo_fujikawa.notes: [Kappo izakaya · Kiyamachi-Nijo, an 11-seat alley counter] A tidy little alley restaurant off Kiyamachi where the chef cooks the morning's market fish — thick sashimi, conger eel, tempura, Kyoto dashimaki — with good sake, and the hostess makes first-timers feel at home. About ¥5,000–8,000. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 9 July 2010 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a dignified chef and a smiling hostess or owner who chat with guests and regulars (2017–2026); a November 2024 reviewer says the chef selects fish and vegetables at the market every morning, and a July 2025 reviewer notes the chef cooks alone. Criticism: very slow service one July 2025 night — about an hour before the first dish.
chef_bio.specialty: Market fish; thick-cut sashimi; Japanese sake.

anecdotes.text: April 2017: "At first, we were eating in silence, feeling a bit anxious, but when we asked questions about the dishes, both the chef and the owner were very friendly and answered us kindly."
September 2026: "The sashimi platter was surprising—thick slices and incredibly tasty. The soba salad was well mixed, and the shrimp tempura and fried conger eel were fluffy."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京酒房 藤かわ、日本料理・焼酎バー、中京区木屋町通二条下る上樵木町491-4 一階、地下鉄東西線京都市役所前駅2番出口から徒歩3分、タクシーは「Kiyamachi-dori Nijo-sagaru Oshikojibashi」で路地の前、月〜水・金〜日17:30〜23:00 (最終入店22:00)、木曜と第3水曜休み、予約可、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー・QR可、11席 (カウンター5・テーブル6)、貸切20名まで、禁煙 (店内はベイプ型電子たばこのみ、外に灰皿)、子供可、2010年7月9日オープン。口コミ (2012年5月〜2026年9月、英語): 厚切りの刺身の盛り合わせ、牛のたたき、湯豆腐、だし巻き、酒盗、もろきゅう、conger eelの湯引き、天ぷら、Kamoなすの田楽、たけのこの炊いたもの、鯛にゅうめん、そばサラダ、海老の天ぷら、conger eelのフライ、毎朝市場で仕入れる料理人 (2024年11月)、料理人と女将、料理人一人で提供が非常に遅かったとの声 (2025年7月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny alley counter; friendly hosts; vape-type e-cigarettes only inside.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated August and September 2026.

kyoto_kyoshubo_fujikawa.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26016510/ (35.012183, 135.770852); GSI resolves only the town 京都府京都市中京区上樵木町, about 67m away — marked approximate; nearest pin kyoto_kappou_yamashita 16m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_kanshoku_minamiya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Korean dishes with gochujang and soy marinades, chijimi, kimbap, tteokbokki, cold noodles and udon to finish (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kanshoku_minamiya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: samgyeopsal, bossam, dakhanmari, octopus kimchi (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kanshoku_minamiya.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Wed–Sun 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Tuesday and some irregular days. Reservations taken. Many dishes are for two or more (2026 reviews). Cards, PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay. 56 seats; semi-private rooms for 10–20; private hire for 20–50. Non-smoking (smoking area outside). English and Chinese menus; English- and Korean-speaking staff. Children welcome. A townhouse on Bukkoji-dori east of Muromachi, 1 min from Karasuma (Hankyu) or Shijo exit 6. Opened 8 August 2012. Operator ミナミ・アンド・コー株式会社 (NTA invoice register).
kyoto_kanshoku_minamiya.notes: [Korean · Bukkoji near Shijo-Karasuma, a townhouse samgyeopsal house] A roomy Kyoto townhouse where staff grill and cut your samgyeopsal at the table — herb, gochujang and more — with bossam, dakhanmari, chijimi and lots of makgeolli. About ¥5,000–6,000. Many dishes are for two. Closed Tuesday.

roles: Operator: ミナミ・アンド・コー株式会社 (NTA invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 8 August 2012 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe attentive staff who grill the meat for diners and plentiful banchan (2025–2026). Criticism: loud neighbours behind a partition that staff did not address (August 2025); a table by the toilet (October 2025); a single toilet (January 2026); many dishes for two or more only (February and October 2026); chijimi served cold (March 2026); little explanation of the dips (March 2026).

anecdotes.text: July 2025: "The staff cooks the samgyeopsal for you and prepares everything until it's ready to eat, which is really helpful!"
March 2026: "The Dakhanmari was rich in chicken flavor, and the broth was exquisite. The Korean udon served at the end had a great chewy texture."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 韓食 南家、韓国料理・焼肉、下京区仏光寺通室町東入釘隠町234、阪急烏丸駅から徒歩1分・地下鉄四条駅6番出口から徒歩1分、月・水〜日17:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、火曜休み、不定休あり、予約可、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay可、56席、半個室 (10〜20名)、貸切20〜50名、禁煙 (店外に喫煙所)、英語・中国語メニュー、英語・韓国語対応スタッフ、子供可、2012年8月8日オープン。インボイス登録はミナミ・アンド・コー株式会社 (国税庁)。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): スタッフが焼くサムギョプサル (ハーブ、コチュジャン、牛、ホルモンなど6種ほど)、エゴマの葉、ポッサム1,480円、タコキムチ500円、生マッコリ600円、自家製フルーツマッコリ700円、タッカンマリと締めのうどん、チュクミ、チヂミ、キンパ、トッポッキ、ガーリックチキン、冷麺、焼き飯、隣席が騒がしかった (2025年8月)、トイレが一つ (2026年1月)、二人前からの料理が多い (2026年)、チヂミが冷めていた (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English and Chinese menus; English- and Korean-speaking staff (Tabelog). Many dishes for two or more.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated March and October 2026.

kyoto_kyo_negiyaki_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: negiyaki is made with wheat batter, tenkasu and sauce (October 2026 review).
kyoto_kyo_negiyaki_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the negiyaki has beef tendon, chikuwa, egg and bonito flakes (October 2026 review).
kyoto_kyo_negiyaki_kiyamachi.hours_raw: 18:00–03:00 Sunday–Friday; 18:00–04:00 Saturday (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). About 30 seats: a counter of about 10 and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Takeaway negiyaki, and takeaway draft beer ¥500 (August and October 2026). On Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, between Chao Chao Gyoza and Ramen Miyoshi (Tabelog; December 2021).
kyoto_kyo_negiyaki_kiyamachi.notes: [Negiyaki · Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, open till 3–4 am] A small cash-only teppan counter making one thing well: Kyoto negiyaki of Kujo green onions, beef tendon and konnyaku in a thin dashi batter. The ¥1,760 solo set adds a draft beer and a tendon side. Open late every night.

chef_bio.background: A December 2021 reviewer writes that the shop had been on Kiyamachi for about 15 years, first as the Kiyamachi branch of the okonomiyaki shop おほーつく in Nishinokyo and recently renamed 京ねぎ焼, serving only negiyaki. Reviewers (2021–2026) describe a friendly owner who cooks and talks at the counter, sometimes alone.
chef_bio.specialty: Negiyaki with beef tendon and konnyaku.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 business traveller had the solo set, then ika with garlic and dashimaki, and three beers.
An August 2026 second-stop guest paid ¥900 for bacon and eggs with a glass of sake.
An October 2026 diner watched the negiyaki built layer by layer on the teppan.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京ねぎ焼 木屋町店、お好み焼き、京都市中京区木屋町通三条下ル石屋町117 1F、日〜金 18:00〜翌3:00、土 18:00〜翌4:00、カード・電子マネー不可、30席 (カウンター10席ほどとテーブル)、喫煙可。口コミ (2017〜2026年、英語): 木屋町で15年ほど、西ノ京のお好み焼き「おほーつく」の木屋町店から「京ねぎ焼」に改名しねぎ焼き専門に (2021年12月)、九条ねぎ、ちくわ、こんにゃく、近江牛のすじ、卵、だしの効いた薄い生地、ねぎ焼き880円、おひとりさまセット (生ビール、ねぎ焼き、小すじ焼き) 1,760円、すじ焼き、だし巻き、イカのガーリック、ベーコンエッグ400円、日本酒500円、瓶ビール大800円、持ち帰りの生ビール500円、現金のみ、気さくな店主、ひとりで切り盛りする日も。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; counter; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_kissa_delica_takakura.gf_detail: Not GF: the food is curry, spaghetti, pizza, sandwiches and cake; drinks only (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_delica_takakura.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee and a wide range of teas; the food uses egg, cheese and meat (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_delica_takakura.hours_raw: 09:00–18:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 44 seats on the second floor: a smoking section and a few non-smoking tables by the window, plus private rooms for 2–6 (5 or more); children welcome (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Reservations taken (Tabelog). At Takakura and Shijo, by the Daimaru Nishinotoin exit and close to Nishiki Market (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_delica_takakura.notes: [Kissaten · Takakura-Shijo, Showa café with a tea list] A roomy upstairs coffee shop by Nishiki Market with teas from around the world, bubbling baked curry with egg (¥1,150), meat-sauce spaghetti and homemade pizza. Cash only; smoking section with a few non-smoking tables by the window. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a nostalgic Showa-era kissaten on a second floor at Takakura-Shijo, with handmade food, quick service, generous portions and a family-run feel.

anecdotes.text: An August 2025 diner had the baked curry set and was kept in water by a kind older woman at the counter.
An October 2025 visitor followed the street sign promising teas from around the world.
An April 2026 regular stops in before work for a ¥1,300 curry set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 喫茶デリカ、喫茶店・洋食・ケーキ、京都市中京区高倉通四条上ル帯屋町578、9:00〜18:00、水曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済不可、44席 (喫煙席が多く、窓際に禁煙のテーブル)、個室 (2〜6名、5名以上)、子供可、予約可。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 2階の昔ながらの喫茶店、錦市場や大丸西洞院口の近く、世界の紅茶、卵とチーズの焼きカレー1,150円、サラダとドリンク付きのカレーセット1,300円、ミートスパゲティのセット、自家製生地のデリカピザ (ハムと卵)、カフェオレ600円、アイスティー580円、紅茶とプリン、モーニング、手作りの料理、量が多い、家族経営のような雰囲気。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; mostly smoking seats.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026. A May 2025 review on the page describes a café at Namba Station and is not used.
