kyoto_kappo_igarashi_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo and Kyoto kaiseki with dashi and soy, tempura and cream croquettes among the dishes; tell the restaurant about allergies when booking (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_kappo_igarashi_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-led kappo with suppon and dashi (official site).
kyoto_kappo_igarashi_gion.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00 (last order 13:30), for two or more booked by the day before; dinner 17:00 (last order 20:00); closed Sunday (official site; Tabelog). Allergies to be given when booking (Tabelog). Cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 10% service (Tabelog; course prices on the official site are before service). 31 seats: an 11-seat L-shaped counter, tatami rooms and tables; private rooms for 2 to 20; all seats non-smoking with a smoking area; children welcome in private rooms only (Tabelog). On the south side of Gion off Hanamikoji (Tabelog; official site).
kyoto_kappo_igarashi_gion.notes: [Kappo · Gion south, second-generation counter since 1979] A Gion kappo where a brother and sister born in Gion host alongside the taisho and okami: talk your way through wild-fish sashimi, guji, suppon hot pot and funazushi at the L-shaped counter, with wines picked by the sommelier sister. Kaiseki courses from ¥16,500; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Founded in 1979 (official site; September 2024 review). The taisho and okami, who know the ways of the hanamachi, are joined by a brother and sister born and raised in Gion, as young master and sommelier (official site); an October 2022 reviewer heard the current owner is the second generation.
chef_bio.philosophy: Build each course from ingredients at the peak of the season, and cook to each guest’s taste at the counter, including dishes not on the menu (official site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2024 guest was told by the owner that newcomers are always welcome, despite the exclusive air.
A January 2025 regular was lucky to find oden on the counter that day.
An October 2026 matsutake hunter finished with funazushi, thick mackerel sushi and red miso soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 割烹いがらし、京都祇園で40年、1979年創業、花街の粋を知る大将・女将とともに祇園で生まれ育った姉弟が若主人・ソムリエとしておもてなし、カウンターの一品料理とお座敷の京会席、京都市東山区祇園町南側570-125、ランチ12:00〜13:30 (L.O.、2名から前日までに要予約)、ディナー17:00〜20:00 (L.O.)、日曜定休、おまかせ京会席 8品前後16,500円・9品前後19,800円・10品前後22,000円 (税込、サ別)、ランチのコース14,300円から、瀬戸内や日本海の天然鮮魚の御造り (5〜7種)、ぐじ、長年の名物のすっぽん鍋 (長崎・島原産)、ふなずし、自家製からすみ、くじらベーコン、ふぐ白子焼、ワインはソムリエ資格を持つ若主人の姉が選ぶ30〜50種 (リストなし)、カウンター割烹でワインを味わう会。食べログ: 割烹いがらし、日本料理、カード可、電子マネー・QR決済不可、サービス料10%、31席 (カウンター11席、座敷16席、テーブル4席)、個室 (2〜20名)、全席禁煙 (喫煙所あり)、子供は個室のみ、予約時にアレルギーを。口コミ (2013〜2026年、英語): 2代目、L字の木のカウンター、常連とホテルのコンシェルジュ経由の海外客、松茸と鰻の土瓶蒸し、40分焼く子持ち鮎、ふなずし、鯖寿司と赤だし、クリームコロッケ、百合根の揚げ物、のどぐろと和牛のステーキ、13,000円のコース (2024年)、おでんの日も、初めての客も歓迎。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter ordering by conversation; lunch needs booking the day before; 10% service.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_maisen_gion_shinmonzen.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo courses with fugu, hamo shabu-shabu, crab and beef hot pots, zosui to finish; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_maisen_gion_shinmonzen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fugu, hamo, crab and beef courses (reviews).
kyoto_maisen_gion_shinmonzen.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) accepted; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Counter, tatami and private rooms; non-smoking throughout (Tabelog; December 2023). A renovated machiya down a narrow alley off Shinmonzen, past Tatsumi Shrine; look for the noren and sign (Tabelog; 2023–2024 reviews).
kyoto_maisen_gion_shinmonzen.notes: [Kappo · Gion Shinmonzen, machiya down an alley] A renovated machiya at the end of a narrow Gion alley serving seasonal courses — fugu and crab in winter, hamo shabu-shabu in summer — with counter seats and private tatami rooms. Book ahead; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2004–2026) describe a kappo in a renovated Gion machiya reached through a narrow alley, with a clean, calm dining room, a counter facing the kitchen and private rooms; a January 2026 guest heard it has been used for film shoots.

anecdotes.text: An August 2023 family party of seven found the steak added to the hot pot the surprise of the night.
A March 2024 group of colleagues had the fugu course and planned a summer return for hamo shabu-shabu.
A January 2026 party in a private room had crab and fugu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 舞扇、日本料理、京都市東山区新門前通大和大路東入西之町232-2、月〜土 17:30〜23:00、日曜定休、予約可、カード可 (JCB、AMEX)、電子マネー・QR決済不可、個室あり、カウンター・座敷、隠れ家、一軒家。口コミ (2004〜2026年、英語): 細い路地の奥の町家を改装した割烹、辰巳神社の近く、冬はふぐのコースと蟹、夏は鱧しゃぶ、厚切りの牛しゃぶ、鍋にステーキ、締めの雑炊、全面禁煙、個室、撮影に使われたことも、1人20,000〜40,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; hard to find down an alley.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through January 2026.

kyoto_kurogane_tei_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask. Okonomiyaki, teppanyaki and yakisoba; lunch sets of rice, miso soup and two dishes such as chicken katsu or miso stir-fry; no gluten information (2025 reviews).
kyoto_kurogane_tei_sanjo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: miso soup in dashi, pork, chicken and fish dishes (May 2025).
kyoto_kurogane_tei_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–24:00; Saturday 17:30–24:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Cards: JCB and AMEX; e-money and QR (Tabelog). Counter and sunken seating (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). On the 2nd floor of 進々堂ビル on Sanjo east of Karasuma, a short walk from exit 5 of Karasuma-Oike (Tabelog).
kyoto_kurogane_tei_sanjo.notes: [Okonomiyaki and teppan · Sanjo-Karasuma, 2nd floor] A calm second-floor teppan restaurant on Sanjo-dori serving okonomiyaki, teppanyaki and yakisoba at night, and a popular weekday lunch where you pick two dishes — miso pork with lotus root, seared bonito, shirasu bowl — with rice and miso soup for about ¥1,100. Smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a calm place with carefully made Japanese set lunches (May 2025); prices have risen from about ¥800 to over ¥1,000 (October 2025). No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 diner paired stir-fried lotus root and pork in miso with thick-cut seared bonito, both with glossy, fluffy rice.
An October 2025 regular noted the lunch has gone from about ¥800 to over ¥1,000.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 鉄亭、お好み焼き・鉄板焼き・焼きそば、中京区三条通烏丸東入ル梅忠町16-2 進々堂ビル 2F、地下鉄烏丸御池駅5番出口から三条通を東へ、月〜金 11:30〜15:00、17:30〜24:00、土 17:30〜24:00、日曜定休、カードはJCB・AMEX、電子マネー・QR可、カウンターと掘りごたつ、喫煙可。口コミ (2025年、英語): ご飯、味噌汁、漬物に好きな2品を選ぶ昼の定食 (約1,100円)、蓮根と豚の味噌炒め、鰹のたたき、釜揚げしらす丼、梅しそタルタルのチキンカツ、以前は約800円。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and kotatsu seats; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2025.

kyoto_kyoryori_ueno.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki of seasonal ingredients and Kyoto vegetables, hamo courses; the menu can be tailored on request when booking (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_kyoryori_ueno.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, especially hamo, on dashi (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_kyoryori_ueno.hours_raw: 11:30–22:00 daily; closed over New Year; enquiries welcome outside these hours (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original 無し; its English wrongly says a fee is added). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 35 seats: an 8-seat counter and private rooms; parties up to 30 (Tabelog). Near Kodai-ji, about 10 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo or subway Higashiyama (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_kyoryori_ueno.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · near Kodai-ji, hamo courses] A kaiseki restaurant near Kodai-ji with a counter and private rooms, cooking seasonal ingredients and Kyoto vegetables — a hamo-zukushi course in summer, a smaller ko-kaiseki at lunch — and willing to tailor menus when you book. Open all day; no service charge.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes kaiseki of seasonal ingredients and Kyoto vegetables, with menus adjusted on request. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 party of three took the ¥33,000 hamo course in a private room from 6 pm.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理うえの、日本料理、東山区上弁天町427-2、京阪祇園四条駅・地下鉄東山駅から徒歩10分、11:30〜22:00 (時間外も相談可)、年末年始休み、サービス料なし、カード可、35席 (カウンター8と個室)、30名まで、旬の食材と京野菜の会席、「鱧づくし会席」、昼限定の「小会席」、要望に合わせて献立を調整、コース13,000円から、おせち (一段・二段)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 高台寺近く、個室で鱧のコース33,000円。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and private rooms; no service charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated May and August 2026.

kyoto_eperon_niomon.gf_detail: Ask. Natural wine with charcuterie, cheese, olives and vegetable plates; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_eperon_niomon.vegan_detail: Ask. Vegetable appetizers and olives are served, with no ingredients described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_eperon_niomon.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday–Sunday 15:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No service charge or cover (Tabelog, original サービス料・チャージなし). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 12 seats: 4 at the counter and 8 at tables (Tabelog). On Niomon-dori by Kawabata, 2 min from exit 12 of Keihan Sanjo (Tabelog; April 2025).
kyoto_eperon_niomon.notes: [Natural-wine bar · Niomon-dori, open from 3 pm] A small wood-lined wine bar on Niomon-dori run by a former Gion French-restaurant sommelier, pouring mainly French natural wines by the glass from mid-afternoon with cheese, charcuterie and vegetable plates. Warm, unhurried service; no cover charge; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Matsuura (owner, per a review; kanji not sourced)
chef_bio.background: An April 2025 reviewer writes that the bar is run by Matsuura, who worked for eight years as a sommelier at a French restaurant in Gion; an October 2025 reviewer also says the owner was a Gion French-restaurant sommelier. The name means “spur” in French, chosen to give small boosts of energy to everyday life (April 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: Small moments of vitality in everyday life (April 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: French natural wine by the glass.

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 pair asked for something with yeastiness and acidity and were poured a Languedoc orange wine that suited perfectly.
A November 2025 visitor stopped in at 5 pm on the way back from the Kyoto City Museum of Art after spotting the small sign.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: eperon、ワインバー、左京区川端通孫橋町18-4、京阪三条駅12番出口から徒歩2分、月・火・木〜日 15:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、水曜定休、サービス料・チャージなし、カード可、12席 (テーブル8、カウンター4)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 仁王門通の静かなワインバー、祇園のフレンチで8年ソムリエを務めたMatsuuraさんが営む、フランス中心の自然派ワインをグラスで、名前はフランス語で「拍車」、ラングドックのオレンジワイン、シャルキュトリー、チーズ、ハム、オリーブ、京野菜の前菜、15時から、温かい店主。

cultural_comfort.note: Owner explains the wines; no cover charge.

kyoto_sanjo_owariya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba and udon in soy-based broth; tendon and tempura sets (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sanjo_owariya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi broth, herring soba, oyakodon, tempura (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_sanjo_owariya.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 11:00–19:00; Sat until about 15:00; closed Sunday and holidays; may change (Tabelog). Often a short queue, with waiting seats inside (January 2026). Soba can sell out early on busy days such as Gion Matsuri parade days (July 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 29 seats: tables, a five-seat counter and raised tatami (Tabelog; January and November 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Higashinotoin-dori south of Sanjo, opposite a supermarket, near Rokkakudo (Tabelog; May and July 2026).
kyoto_sanjo_owariya.notes: [Soba · Higashinotoin-Sanjo] A busy, old-style soba shop near Karasuma Oike with tables and raised tatami, known for curry seiro — cold soba with a hot curry dip — plus herring soba, egg-topped kayaku soba and half-size tendon or oyakodon sets. A lively young proprietress; often a short queue. Closed Sunday; Saturdays to about 15:00.

roles: Proprietress (unnamed), described as young and lively (July 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per reviews: a long-established soba shop near Karasuma Oike; a January 2026 visitor says it preserves an Edo-period name and tradition.

anecdotes.text: On a July 2026 parade day the soba sold out early, and the proprietress welcomed a diner in for herring udon instead.
A January 2026 first-timer, curious about the queue seen on every walk past, found waiting seats inside and a lively welcome.
A November 2026 diner tried the curry seiro — cold soba, hot curry dip — for ¥1,050.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: そば、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町216-1、月〜金11:00〜19:00、土曜は15時ごろまで、日曜・祝日休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、29席、座敷、禁煙。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年11月、英語): 江戸時代からの屋号を守る老舗のそば屋、店内に待ち席、ふわふわ卵と椎茸のかやくそば、小のかけそばと小の天丼、カレーせいろ1,050円、にしんそば、祭りの日はそばが早く売り切れ、天ぷら定食、親子丼、ミニそばのセット、若い女将。

cultural_comfort.note: Wait on the seats inside if there is a queue; the curry seiro is the house speciality. No English evidence found.

kyoto_coffret_damitie.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch sets of fish or meat with soup and dessert; sole meunière and quiche appear (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_coffret_damitie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish and meat mains with sauces (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_coffret_damitie.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–21:00; closed Tuesday; may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (December 2025). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Seating includes a traditional sunken kotatsu (December 2025; April 2026). ミックナカムラビル 1F, Higashinotoin south of Sanjo, near the Museum of Kyoto (Tabelog; December 2025).
kyoto_coffret_damitie.notes: [French bistro · Higashinotoin-Sanjo] A warm little bistro near the Museum of Kyoto with a sunken-kotatsu seat, serving generous French lunch sets — soup, a choice of five fish or meat mains with lots of vegetables, and dessert — for ¥1,200–1,600, open through to 21:00. Cash only; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a bistro and café near the Museum of Kyoto, known for consistent lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 group found Christmas tableware and a whole grilled flounder with yuzu sauce in the ¥1,200 lunch.
An April 2026 weekday visitor relaxed at the sunken kotatsu over a gentle soy-milk soup and sautéed mackerel.
An August 2026 regular praised the steady prices and the sole meunière after the Gion Matsuri.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ・カフェ・ケーキ、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町 ミックナカムラビル 1F、月・水〜日11:30〜21:00、火曜休み、現金のみ。口コミ (2019年1月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都文化博物館の近く、掘りごたつ、魚と肉の5種から選べるメインとデザートの1,200円のランチ、にんじんのスープ、カレイの丸ごと焼き柚子ソース、豆乳スープ、鯖のソテー、きのこのキッシュと舌平目のムニエルの1,600円のコース、野菜たっぷり。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring cash; lunch sets are the easy order. No English evidence found.

kyoto_tonjiru_shigechan.gf_detail: Ask. Tonjiru (miso pork soup), onigiri and obanzai with soy-based seasoning (2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_tonjiru_shigechan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork miso soup, offal stew, chawanmushi (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_tonjiru_shigechan.hours_raw: Tue–Sun and holidays 11:30–16:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Monday (Tuesday if Monday is a holiday) (Tabelog). Reservation-only all-you-can-drink party course for groups of four or more, one group per day (Tabelog). Fills by noon (October 2025). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 18 seats: 12 at tables, 6 at the counter (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Inside the Museum of Kyoto, in its row of shops recreating late-Edo townhouses (Tabelog; May 2026). Opened 1 November 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_tonjiru_shigechan.notes: [Tonjiru and onigiri · Museum of Kyoto, since 2024] A small set-meal counter in the Museum of Kyoto’s Edo-townhouse arcade, built around hearty pork miso soup with your choice of miso, bite-size onigiri with chosen fillings, and Kyoto obanzai; sake-lees soup in winter. Sets about ¥1,600–2,300, free rice refills. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a tonjiru specialist opened in November 2024 inside the Museum of Kyoto, serving pork miso soup with a choice of miso and dishes of Kyoto ingredients.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 diner arrived at the 11:30 opening as the first guest and watched it fill by noon.
A February 2026 museum-goer warmed up with the winter sake-lees soup, rich with vegetables.
An October 2026 green-onion lover was delighted that extra onion is free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂・居酒屋・おにぎり、中京区東片町623-1 京都文化博物館、地下鉄烏丸御池駅から徒歩5〜10分、火〜日・祝日11:30〜16:00 と17:00〜21:00、月曜休み (祝日の場合は翌日)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、18席 (テーブル12、カウンター6)、禁煙、2024年11月1日オープン、味噌を選べる豚汁、京都の食材の料理、1日1組の飲み放題付き宴会コース。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 豚汁定食1,600円、おにぎり5種800円、大きな豚汁660円、豚汁とひと口おにぎり5種のセット2,200〜2,300円、ご飯おかわり無料、12〜3月は粕汁、もつ煮込みの定食、ねぎ増量無料。

cultural_comfort.note: Pick your miso and onigiri fillings; arrive early. No English evidence found.

kyoto_cafe_prima_karasuma.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: tarts, sandwiches, pizza and gratin napolitan (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_prima_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken plates, beef stew, beef sandwiches and cream tarts (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_cafe_prima_karasuma.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 11:30–23:00 (last order 22:30); Sun and holidays 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); irregular closures (Tabelog). Weekday lunch plates 11:30–14:30, with a free drink and soup bar via a LINE coupon (September 2026; January 2026). One drink per person in the evening unless in a set (March 2026). Ordering by QR code (February 2026). Cards (incl. UnionPay), e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 26 seats; private hire (Tabelog). Basement of the Sompo Japan Universe Kyoto Building, 1 min from Karasuma station (Tabelog).
kyoto_cafe_prima_karasuma.notes: [Café-bar · Shijo-Karasuma] A basement café by Karasuma station serving tarts baked each morning at the Prima pâtisserie in Gojo — Mont Blanc, apple chiboust, seasonal fruit — plus ¥990–1,100 plate lunches, beef stew, steak sandwiches and pizza, and cocktails into the evening. Cake sets around ¥950–990; weekday lunch drink bar with a LINE coupon.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: the café of the Gojo pâtisserie at’Prima, whose pastry chefs supply its tarts each morning.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor came to spend Tabelog points and chose a Mont Blanc tart from the morning delivery.
A February 2026 passer-by followed a few taxi drivers down the stairs and found a ¥990 beef stew plate.
A December 2025 visitor found most tarts already sold out at the main shop that day.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: カフェ・肉バル・イタリアン、中京区烏丸通錦小路上ル手洗水町671 損保ジャパンユニバース京都ビル B1F、烏丸駅から徒歩約1分、月〜土11:30〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日・祝日17:00〜21:00 (L.O. 20:30)、不定休、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、26席、五条の本店のパティシエのタルト、プレートのランチ、和牛サンド、ヒレステーキサンド、カクテル。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 毎朝五条の at’Prima から届くタルト、モンブランのタルト、りんごのシブースト、タルトのケーキセット950円、ビーフシチューのプレート990円、からあげのプレート1,100円、チキン南蛮990円、グラタン風ナポリタン、ビーフサンド約3,000円、ピザとケーキのセット、LINE のクーポンで平日昼のドリンクバー、夜はワンドリンク制、QR で注文。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by QR code; one drink each in the evening. No English evidence found.

kyoto_dernier_bar.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a food stop: bar snacks such as sausage platters, prosciutto, olives and giant corn (2019–2025 reviews). Ask about drinks.
kyoto_dernier_bar.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sausage and prosciutto platters (May 2025); olives and giant corn are plant-based snacks (2019; 2024). Drinks otherwise — ask.
kyoto_dernier_bar.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 19:00–2:00; closed Wednesday and 31 December–2 January (New Year details on Instagram). Reservations taken; private hire from 15 people (charged as 20). Service charge 10% — Tabelog, Japanese original 「最終会計時に１０％サービス料を頂戴しております。※コース料金はサービス料込※」. 28 seats: 8 at the counter, small tables and curtained sofa areas for up to 8. Smoking allowed throughout, so no minors; no children or pets (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay. 3rd floor of the カワモトビル, 1 min from Shijo exit 5. Opened 20 April 2016.
kyoto_dernier_bar.notes: [Cocktail bar · Shijo-Karasuma, a third-floor late bar] A plush third-floor bar a minute from Shijo Station, open until 2 am: fresh-fruit cocktails, a good whisky shelf, snacks and curtained sofa corners for groups. About ¥3,000–4,000 plus 10% service. Smoking allowed; adults only. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 20 April 2016 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe friendly staff who chat with first-timers, a calm, luxurious room and a late crowd after work dinners; one regular logged 28 visits between 2017 and March 2026. Smoking is allowed throughout.

anecdotes.text: May 2026: "They offer a wide variety of cocktails made with fresh fruits, and the selection of whiskey is impressive—every drink was truly delicious!"
December 2024: "The calm atmosphere of the restaurant, along with the friendly staff who engage in conversation, makes it an inviting place for beginners at the bar."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: dernier-bar、バー・ダイニングバー・バル、下京区室町通綾小路西入ル鶏鉾町501 カワモトビル3F、地下鉄四条駅5番出口から徒歩1分、月・火・木〜日19:00〜翌2:00、水曜休み、12月31日〜1月2日休み、予約可、貸切は15名から (20名分の料金)、原文で「最終会計時に１０％サービス料を頂戴しております。※コース料金はサービス料込※」、28席 (カウンター8、テーブル、カーテンで仕切れるソファ席)、全席喫煙可のため未成年不可、子供・ペット不可、カード・PayPay可、2016年4月20日オープン。口コミ (2017年8月〜2026年5月、英語): フレッシュフルーツのカクテル、ウイスキー、ホイッスルピッグ10年1,200円、ジャイアントコーン500円 (2024年12月)、ソーセージの盛り合わせ、生ハム (2025年5月)、気さくなスタッフ、遅くまで営業。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoking allowed throughout; adults only; 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated March and May 2026.

kyoto_shoku_no_gen.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Sichuan-leaning Chinese — dan dan noodles, ramen, gyoza, xiao long bao, mapo tofu, shrimp mayo, fried rice (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoku_no_gen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken, shrimp, pork and seafood dishes; egg-and-tomato stir-fry (2018–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoku_no_gen.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–23:00; hours and closed days may change. Reservations taken. No credit cards (Tabelog) — cash. 31 seats: counter, tables, a raised tatami area; a private room for 10–20. Smoking allowed. Take-out. 1 min from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop, below the Yasaka pagoda on the way down from Kiyomizu (2022; 2024 reviews); 12 min from Keihan Kiyomizu-Gojo. Staff speak Chinese (November 2022).
kyoto_shoku_no_gen.notes: [Chinese · below Kiyomizu-dera by the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop, a sightseers' lunch stop] A busy little Chinese kitchen at the bottom of the Kiyomizu slopes: Sichuan mapo tofu, dan dan noodles, seafood ramen and rice bowls for about ¥900–1,200, open all day until 11 pm. Cash only; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: A November 2022 reviewer writes that it seems to be run by a couple, with Chinese spoken by the staff; a May 2026 reviewer describes the owner as a lovely, welcoming and beautiful lady. A November 2023 reviewer found the flavors authentic from a Chinese perspective; a March 2024 reviewer felt they had been adjusted to Japanese tastes. Criticism: rude service (November 2018); unsweetened almond-tofu syrup and an off mapo tofu (January 2021); lukewarm soup (November 2022).
chef_bio.specialty: Sichuan mapo tofu; dan dan noodles; rice bowls.

anecdotes.text: November 2023: "I found the flavors to be quite authentic even from a Chinese perspective… the dishes on top of the bowls were stir-fried right there, producing an amazing aroma."
May 2026: "The owner, a lovely lady, is also very welcoming and beautiful… The seafood ramen was loaded with ingredients, and the broth was incredibly delicious."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食之源、中華料理・餃子・飲茶、東山区清水4-130、市バスKiyomizu-michiから徒歩1分・京阪清水五条駅から徒歩12分、毎日11:00〜23:00、営業時間・定休日は変更の可能性あり、予約可、カード不可、31席 (カウンター9、テーブル、小上がり)、個室10〜20名、喫煙可、テイクアウト。口コミ (2018年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 担々麺、チャーシュー麺、冷やし中華880円、鶏の麺、トマトと卵の丼、麻婆豆腐丼、牛丼1,100円、海鮮ラーメン、炒飯約900円、小籠包、羽根つき餃子、エビマヨ、いわしの唐揚げ、鶏とピーナッツの四川炒め、夫婦で営んでいるらしい (2022年11月)、中国語を話すスタッフ、すてきな女性の店主 (2026年5月)、接客が悪かったとの声 (2018年11月)、スープがぬるかった (2022年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Chinese spoken by staff (November 2022); cash only; smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated May, September and October 2026.

kyoto_hz_niomon.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: small plates include shumai, focaccia, pasta salads and meat-miso peppers (2025–2026 reviews). Ask about the raw tongue and vegetable plates.
kyoto_hz_niomon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: raw beef tongue, shumai, grilled tuna, minced meat (2025–2026 reviews). Some vegetable plates (Sri Lankan stir-fried okra, small potatoes with fried garlic chives) — ask.
kyoto_hz_niomon.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 15:00–23:00 (last entry 22:00); Sat 15:00–21:00 (last entry 20:00); Sun and holidays 12:00–18:00 (last entry 17:00); closed Thursday and irregular days. No reservations. No credit cards — cash. Standing counter, seated counter, window seats and one table. Non-smoking. Children welcome. 3rd floor of a building on Niomon-dori, open when the "Hz" wine bottle stands at the entrance (December 2025); 288 m from Sanjo Keihan. Opened late 2025.
kyoto_hz_niomon.notes: [Natural-wine stand · Niomon-dori near the Kamo, a third-floor daytime bar] A bright upstairs standing bar on Niomon-dori pouring natural wine from 3 pm (noon on Sundays), with window views and a handful of plates — raw beef tongue (it sells out), shumai, okra. About ¥2,000–5,000. Cash only. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened late 2025 (a December 2025 reviewer calls it newly opened). A September 2026 reviewer writes that the owner used to serve wine at the Tokyo natural-wine bar "Ahiru Store" (romaji as given). Reviewers note the building's well water, views of Niomon-dori and cherry blossoms, and a crowd of afternoon drinkers. Criticism: the raw tongue and other dishes sell out early (April and September 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Natural wine; raw beef tongue; small plates.

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "The owner, who used to serve wine at the renowned natural wine spot 'Ahiru Store' in Tokyo, offers a selection of wines that reflect their personal taste."
December 2025: "When the wine bottle labeled 'Hz' is placed at the entrance of the building, it signals the start of business."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Hz、レストラン、左京区大菊町102 3F、三条京阪から288m、月・火・水・金15:00〜23:00 (最終入店22:00)、土15:00〜21:00 (最終入店20:00)、日・祝日12:00〜18:00 (最終入店17:00)、木曜休み、不定休、予約不可、カード不可、立ち飲み、禁煙、子供可。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年11月、英語): Niomon通の自然派ワインの立ち飲み、入口に「Hz」のワインボトルが出ていれば営業中、Uchidaの牛タン刺し800円、ヘルシーしゅうまい800円、ハイボール700円 (2025年12月)、マグロの炙り、小芋と揚げたニラ (2026年2月)、ひき肉とピーマン、スリランカ風オクラ炒め、フォカッチャ、白いパスタサラダ (2026年9月)、グラスの自然派ワイン、井戸水、東京の自然派ワインの店「Ahiru Store」出身の店主 (2026年9月)、タンが早く売り切れる (2026年4月・9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Standing bar; cash only; dishes sell out — go early.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated September 2026; the latest visit is November 2026.

kyoto_wine_marche_takatsuji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ajillo with bread, melted-cheese "Heidi" set over baguette, gratin, crepes (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_wine_marche_takatsuji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cheese, prosciutto, sausages, seafood ajillo, steak (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_wine_marche_takatsuji.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 18:00–24:00; Sat and Sun 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed on irregular days; bookings outside these hours by arrangement. Reservations taken. Cover 「チャージ400円（税込）」 (¥400 incl. tax, Tabelog Japanese original). Cards. 22 seats: tables, sofas and a 2-seat counter; partitions for semi-private use; private hire from 12. Non-smoking (ashtray at the entrance). English menu and English-speaking staff. Children welcome; no pets except guide dogs. BYO allowed (Tabelog). 2nd floor of the エムシービル just east of Muromachi-Takatsuji, 5 min from Karasuma or Shijo. Opened 8 August 2020.
kyoto_wine_marche_takatsuji.notes: [Wine bar · Takatsuji near Shijo-Karasuma, a cheese-and-ajillo hideaway] A cosy upstairs wine bar with sofa seats and a talkative owner: melted-cheese "Heidi" sets, ajillo, cheese boards and good-value all-you-can-drink wine (about ¥3,500 for 90 minutes), open to midnight. ¥400 cover.

chef_bio.background: Opened 8 August 2020 (Tabelog). The shop site invites guests to ask the master about the monthly themed events (winemarche.net); a November 2025 reviewer enjoyed the owner's explanations of the wines. Reviewers describe kind staff, a relaxed antique-style room and a hidden-gem feel. Criticism: average sausages (September 2022).

anecdotes.text: September 2023: "The 'Heidi's Baked Cheese' was especially amazing. They melt several types of cheese right at the table, and once it's perfectly gooey, you can pour it over a baguette."

November 2025: "The selection of cheeses was impressive, featuring many varieties that paired perfectly with wine, including washed cheeses and Mont d'Or… the owner's explanations about the wines were very entertaining."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインマルシェ、バル・イタリアン・ワインバー、下京区骨屋町316 エムシービル2F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩5分 (烏丸高辻を西へ、室町高辻の手前の北側)、月〜金18:00〜24:00、土・日17:00〜24:00 (L.O.23:30)、不定休、時間外も相談可、予約可、原文で「チャージ400円（税込）」、カード可、22席、貸切12名から、禁煙 (入口に灰皿)、英語メニュー・英語対応スタッフ、子供可、盲導犬以外のペット不可、持ち込み可、2020年8月8日オープン。公式サイト winemarche.net (月1回のテーマイベント、マスターに聞いてね)。口コミ (2021年11月〜2026年5月、英語): ハイジのホットチーズセット、アヒージョ、ファイヤーカマンベール1,500円、90分飲み放題3,500円 (2025年7月)、60分飲み放題1,750円 (2022年9月)、クアトロフォルマッジ、生ハムサラダ、ムール貝、ローストビーフ、ステーキ、抹茶クレープ、ウォッシュチーズやモンドール (2025年11月)、シーフードグラタンのランチ1,500円 (2021年11月)、店主のワインの説明が楽しい。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); ¥400 cover.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated March and May 2026.

kyoto_wine_marche_takatsuji.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26034570/ (35.000258, 135.758382); GSI lot 京都府京都市下京区骨屋町316番地 about 39m away; nearest pin kyoto_kushi_teppan_zoronpa 99m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_live_spot_rag.gf_detail: Ask. Bar food — pizza, sandwiches, fried chicken, spring rolls — is mostly wheat; a cheese platter (2019–2025 reviews).
kyoto_live_spot_rag.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks and pickles; most food has meat or cheese (2019–2025 reviews).
kyoto_live_spot_rag.hours_raw: Sun–Thu 18:00–02:00; Fri, Sat and the day before a holiday 18:00–04:30; open year-round; hours may change (Tabelog). Shows start at 19:30 (or 19:00); after the show it is a bar with no charge (Tabelog). Show nights: a music charge plus one drink and one food order (Tabelog Japanese original 「ミュージック・チャージ＆ワンドリンク＆ワンフード・オーダー」); two drinks may replace the food (October 2023 review); food is served an hour before the show (March 2019 review). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, but not during shows (Tabelog). 5th floor of the Kyoto Empire Building on Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, 5 min from Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_live_spot_rag.notes: [Live music bar · Kiyamachi] A long-running live house on Kiyamachi with shows from 19:30 and pizza, fried chicken and cocktails; after the show it stays open as a bar into the small hours. Music charge plus one drink and one food.

chef_bio.background: A Kyoto live house with a long history (December 2025 review), supporting the local scene with an audience that gives honest feedback; guests sometimes join in on stage (December 2021 review). Run by RAG (ragnet.co.jp).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 first-timer came for a friend's show and found it so packed even the band was surprised.
An October 2023 guest ordered Kirin Ichiban Shibori and got it in a Heineken glass on a Heineken coaster.
A December 2021 regular recommends the bacon and Gorgonzola pizza because quiet food does not disturb the performers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: LIVE SPOT RAG、バー・その他、中京区の木屋町、三条の北、京都エンパイヤビル5F、京阪三条駅7番出口から徒歩5分、日〜木 18:00〜翌2:00、金・土・祝日の前日 18:00〜翌4:30、年中無休、ライブは19:30 (または19:00) から、ライブのあとはチャージなしのバー、ミュージック・チャージとワンドリンク・ワンフード、カード・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、喫煙可 (ライブ中は禁煙)。口コミ (2019〜2025年、英語): 歴史のある店、サンドイッチ700円 (2025年12月)、tatsuta-age (2023年10月)、ベーコンとゴルゴンゾーラのピザ920円、映画と音楽にちなんだカクテル (2021年12月)、チーズの盛り合わせ870円 (2019年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Ticketed shows; check the schedule on the website.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through December 2025.

kyoto_live_spot_rag.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26017553/ (35.010123, 135.770730), moved 6m NNW to clear kyoto_nankuru_shokudo (0.2m, same building); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区上大阪町521番地 (lot) 43m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_yushintei_tajitaji.gf_detail: Ask. The menu leans to fried dishes (May 2016 review).
kyoto_yushintei_tajitaji.vegan_detail: Ask. Cabbage salad and fries (2009 review), but most dishes have fish or meat.
kyoto_yushintei_tajitaji.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–01:00 (L.O. 24:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Usually open late on New Year's Eve (December 2025 review). Two-hour all-you-can-drink party course ¥3,500; private hire for 15 or more, including lunch parties (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB); PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Up narrow stairs on the 2nd floor of the Kawaramachi Oike Building, 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog; February 2013 review).
kyoto_yushintei_tajitaji.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi-Oike] A cosy upstairs izakaya and late bar by Kyoto City Hall with a friendly, guitar-playing master, cheap classic dishes from ¥300 and regulars who stay late. About ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: A friendly master who has played guitar for guests (February 2013 review); three guitars hang on the wall, and the place has also run as a bar until morning (May 2016 review). Many regulars (December 2009 review).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular made it the last stop of the year, on New Year's Eve, finishing with yakitori.
An April 2026 after-party guest remembered little but the fun atmosphere and gave it five stars.
A February 2013 visitor climbed the narrow stairs and was treated to a live guitar number by the master.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 遊心亭たじたじ、居酒屋・ダイニングバー・バー、中京区下丸屋町401-6 河原町御池ビル2F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩1分、毎日 17:30〜翌1:00 (L.O. 24:00)、不定休、カード可、PayPay 可、30席、喫煙可、2時間飲み放題のコース3,500円、15名以上で貸切 (昼も可)、定番の料理は300円から。口コミ (2009〜2026年、英語): ギターを弾くマスター (2013年2月)、たじたじサラダ、明太子の卵焼き (2009年12月)、揚げ物が多い (2016年5月)、大晦日も遅くまで営業 (2025年12月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual izakaya; regulars.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated December 2025 and April 2026.

kyoto_yushintei_tajitaji.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26014169/ (35.010297, 135.769258), moved 5m NNW to clear kyoto_marumiya_jr (4.0m); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区下丸屋町401番地 (lot) 37m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_washoku_naitou_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Japanese courses, some with sushi; soy sauce and dashi are likely (happytry).
kyoto_washoku_naitou_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seasonal courses with sushi (happytry).
kyoto_washoku_naitou_gion.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:30–22:30 (L.O. food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Wednesdays and on irregular days (Tabelog; happytry). Cover charge ¥800 a head for guests not ordering a course (Tabelog Japanese original 「お通し：800円(税込)/人※コースご注文以外のお客様」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and two raised tables for 4; non-smoking (Tabelog). Walk-ins welcome (happytry). Ground floor of the Vendome Gion Building, 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_washoku_naitou_gion.notes: [Washoku · Gion] A calm counter for seasonal Japanese courses and carefully chosen sake, run by a taisho and okami with brewery tie-ins and sake evenings. Lunch and dinner; about ¥8,000–15,000.

chef_bio.background: The owner is listed as 内藤徹 (happytry). A friendly taisho and okami; ties with several sake breweries (happytry).
chef_bio.philosophy: "日本酒と美味しいお料理と落ち着いた空間" — sake, good food and a calm space (happytry).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 business party found the course free of convention, each dish timed to the chosen drinks.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 和食ないとう、日本料理、東山区祇園町北側325 ヴァンドーム祇園ビル1F、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩8分、月・火・木〜日 11:30〜14:30 (L.O. 14:00)・17:30〜22:30 (L.O. 料理21:30、ドリンク22:00)、水曜休み、お通し800円 (コース以外)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、16席 (カウンター8、小上がりのテーブル2)、禁煙。happytry: 店主は内藤徹、「日本酒と美味しいお料理と落ち着いた空間」、大将と女将、季節のコース (コースにより寿司)、毎月の女将さんの日、2か月ごとの日本酒とお料理を楽しむ会、不定休あり。口コミ (2026年10月、英語): 型にとらわれないコース、飲み物との組み合わせ。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter dining; book for courses.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and happytry page; review dated October 2026.

kyoto_washoku_naitou_gion.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26045687/ (35.004319, 135.777176); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側325番地 (lot) 19m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_yakiniku_yuen_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Plain grilled meat with salt or wasabi may suit (April 2023 review); marinades and cold noodles are usually wheat.
kyoto_yakiniku_yuen_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Salads of Kyoto vegetables and kimchi (Tabelog); ask whether the kimchi has fish.
kyoto_yakiniku_yuen_gion.hours_raw: From 18:00 until late; earlier opening on request; irregular closures (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「なし」). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 36 seats with counter, tatami and sunken seating; smoking allowed (Tabelog; August 2026 review). English menu (Tabelog); English-speaking staff (May 2024 review). Same-day bookings by phone (Tabelog). Ground floor of the Vendome Gion building by the Gion bus stop, 5 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_yakiniku_yuen_gion.notes: [Yakiniku · Gion] A late-opening Gion yakiniku of Omi and other wagyu with Kyoto vegetables, an English menu and a ¥4,000 visitor set. Smoking allowed. About ¥5,000–9,000.

chef_bio.background: A friendly manager (March 2023 review). Staff speak fluent English (May 2024 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Omi beef with Kyoto-grown vegetables and rice (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A May 2024 visitor ordered extra outside skirt from the ¥4,000 set and called it a favourite meal in Japan.
An August 2026 diner liked the food but not the cigarette smoke from the only other table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉 夕苑、焼肉・韓国料理・居酒屋、東山区富永町東大路通西入祇園町北側325 ヴァンドーム祇園1F、祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、市バス「祇園」すぐ、18:00〜深夜、早い時間は要相談、不定休、チャージなし、カード可、電子マネー不可、36席、喫煙可、英語メニューあり、Omi の牛肉、京都の野菜と米、野菜ソムリエのサラダ、京都の老舗のキムチ、冷麺とビビン麺 (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 4,000円のセット、ハラミ、英語の話せるスタッフ (2024年5月)、わさびで食べる肉 (2023年4月)、店内で喫煙 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and English-speaking staff (May 2024 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_yuen_gion.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26019053/ (35.004335, 135.777193), moved 4m NE to clear 和食ないとう in the same building (2.4m); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側325番地 (lot) 23m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_okonomiyaki_hinoki.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat-batter okonomiyaki, monjayaki and yakisoba on shared griddles (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_okonomiyaki_hinoki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork okonomiyaki, seafood and meat teppanyaki (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_okonomiyaki_hinoki.hours_raw: Daily 17:30–3:00 (last order 2:00); closing days not fixed (Tabelog). A 10% late-night charge is added for guests arriving after 22:00 (Tabelog, English translation; no Japanese original shown). Reservations accepted; courses with 120-minute all-you-can-drink for 4–30 people (Tabelog). Busy on Fridays and weekends — book (April–September 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 35 seats, counter and tables, private rooms for 2 or 4 (Tabelog); the counter seats have no griddle (September 2025). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). Renamed from an earlier teppan-dining name; opened 21 July 2017 (Tabelog). 3 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo Stn.
kyoto_okonomiyaki_hinoki.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Shijo-Karasuma, open to 3 a.m.] A warm, wood-lined okonomiyaki and teppan izakaya: pork okonomiyaki, mentaiko-butter yakisoba, monjayaki and a long list of drinking snacks, open until 3 a.m. for late nights. Ask for a table — the counter has no griddle. 10% late-night charge after 22:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 21 July 2017 under an earlier teppan-dining name and since renamed ひのき; a sake-loving manager picks the drinking-course dishes (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe a late-night favourite for after-work drinks and second rounds.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 group of students from Kanto, stuck for a second bar on a Sunday night, found it open and loved the carefully cooked monjayaki.
A September 2026 reunion of friends found it packed even with a booking, and singled out the mentaiko-butter yakisoba.
A solo September 2025 diner booked a table online, was moved to the counter, and found it had no griddle.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・鉄板焼き・お好み焼き、中京区室町通錦下ル菊水鉾町569、阪急烏丸駅24番出口から徒歩3分、毎日 17:30〜翌3:00 (L.O.2:00)、不定休、22時以降の来店は深夜料金10% (英訳のみ)、予約可、飲み放題付きコース5,400〜6,400円 (4〜30名)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、35席、個室 (2名・4名)、分煙、2017年7月21日開店、旧店名あり。口コミ (2025年9月〜2026年10月、英語): 木のぬくもりの店内、豚玉1,100円、ねぎ焼き、明太バター焼きそば、もんじゃ焼き、あぶったスルメ、たこのガーリック焼き、焼き飯、夜遅くまで開いて二次会に便利、カウンター席には鉄板がない (2025年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: 10% late-night charge after 22:00; ask for a griddle table; smoking area.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_okonomiyaki_hinoki.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26029453/ (35.004753, 135.758178); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区菊水鉾町569番地 (lot) 37 m; nearest existing record 25.4 m (kyr_no_ko_kyo_tori_paitan_ra); 2026-11-08

kyoto_ibushidori_ichika.gf_detail: Ask. Smoked chicken is made with natural seasonings (Tabelog) and salt yakitori may suit, but kara-age, oyakodon and the noodle finishes involve wheat or soy (2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_ibushidori_ichika.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken specialist (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ibushidori_ichika.hours_raw: Daily including holidays 11:00–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last orders food 21:00, drinks 21:30); closing days not fixed; closed over the New Year holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; full on holidays (September 2026). No service charge (Tabelog original なし). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay); no e-money (Tabelog). 35 seats: 11 at the counter and three tables on 1F, four tables on 2F (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi; take-out; menus in English, Chinese and Korean (Tabelog). Lunch can be slow with one server (October 2026). 5 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn. Opened 14 December 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ibushidori_ichika.notes: [Smoked chicken and yakitori · near City Hall] A machiya with a lofty ceiling serving cherry-wood-smoked chicken: smoked-chicken rice boxes and bowls at lunch, and yakitori, garlic tomato and a smoked-chicken soba or oyakodon to finish at night. English menu, no service charge, non-smoking.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 14 December 2024 by エイムインターセクション株式会社 (NTA invoice register), smoking whole domestic chickens with cherry wood and Nambu ironware and natural seasonings, in a space recreating a Kyoto machiya. Reviewers in 2026 describe regulars who return monthly and chefs cooking in front of the counter.
chef_bio.philosophy: Bring out the ingredients’ own flavour with traditional smoking and natural seasonings (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 holiday lunch guest booked the opening slot and watched walk-ins turned away as the room filled; extra meat and an egg were worth it.
A monthly regular (September and October 2026) never misses the garlic tomato, ramen finish and oyakodon.
An October 2026 business traveller found the Kyoto Akajidori bowl dry and pricey at over ¥3,200 with extras, while locals ordered the salt kara-age set.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・焼き鳥・鶏料理、中京区山本町410、市役所前駅から徒歩5分、毎日 (祝日も) 11:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、17:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理21:00、飲み物21:30)、不定休・年末年始休み、予約可、サービス料なし、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・QR (PayPay・d払い・楽天ペイ・Alipay・WeChat Pay) 可、電子マネー不可、35席 (1階カウンター11席とテーブル3卓、2階テーブル4卓)、禁煙、車いす可、Wi-Fi、テイクアウト、英中韓のメニュー、2024年12月14日開店。インボイス登録はエイムインターセクション株式会社 (国税庁)。紹介文 (英訳): 国産の丸鶏を桜の木で燻し、天然の調味料で、丹波のコシヒカリを羽釜で炊く、京町家風の店内。口コミ (2026年9〜10月、英語): いぶし鳥の重、Kyoto Akajidori の丼2,400円、塩唐揚げ定食1,500円ほど、もも塩、ネック、九条ねぎ、たたき、よだれ鶏、にんにくトマト、だし巻き、鶏ワンタンスープ、しめの親子丼やそば、毎月通う常連、昼は一人で給仕で遅めとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; no service charge; non-smoking; book for holidays.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_ibushidori_ichika.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260201/26042137/ (35.012255, 135.766833); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市中京区山本町410番地 (lot) 72 m; nearest existing record 22.9 m (kyoto_tokumaru); 2026-11-08

kyoto_suetomi_aoq_cafe_stand.gf_detail: Ask. Coffee, matcha and the anko café au lait may suit; bread, the casse-croûte and financiers contain wheat, and the anko-kohaku vanilla comes with wheat crackers (2025–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_suetomi_aoq_cafe_stand.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee, matcha and red-bean anko may be plant-based, but the signature drinks use milk and the sandwich has ham and cheese; no plant milk mentioned (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_suetomi_aoq_cafe_stand.hours_raw: Daily 8:00–17:00 (Tabelog; hours may change). The 2023 opening notice gave 11:00–18:00 with no closing day (aoq.jp, 9 May 2023), so check before an early visit. Takeaway only — order at a small window; a bench beside the stand (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Cashless only (Tabelog original キャッシュレス決済のみ): cards (VISA, Master, JCB), e-money, PayPay. One person makes each drink by hand, so expect a short wait (March 2026). By Karasuma-Matsubara, next to a hotel; opened 10 May 2023 (aoq.jp; Tabelog).
kyoto_suetomi_aoq_cafe_stand.notes: [Takeaway coffee and anko · Karasuma-Matsubara] A tiny cashless stand of the old wagashi house 末富’s AoQ brand: anko café au lait with red bean settled at the bottom, hand-dripped coffee, matcha, and anko-and-prosciutto casse-croûte. Takeaway only, with a bench outside.

chef_bio.background: Per aoq.jp: AoQ (青久) is a new brand produced by the Kyoto confectioner 末富, founded 1893, bringing tea-time sweets to more people with new ingredients and techniques; the Cafe Stand opened 10 May 2023 as its first takeaway café, serving drinks and sandwiches made with 末富 anko that are only available here. A coffee blend made with Sarutahiko Coffee went on sale in November 2025 (aoq.jp).
chef_bio.philosophy: Carry on tradition while adding new ingredients and techniques (aoq.jp).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 visitor came for the anko café au lait featured on Kansai TV, and scooped the settled red bean from the bottom like sweet bean soup.
A three-time visitor in June 2026 tried the prosciutto-and-anko bread and found the salty-sweet pairing exquisite.
A March 2026 hotel guest next door found a stand about one tatami mat in size, run by one person.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: コーヒースタンド、下京区松原通東入玉津島町319、毎日 8:00〜17:00、予約不可、キャッシュレス決済のみ (カード VISA・Master・JCB、電子マネー、PayPay)、テイクアウトのカフェ、2023年5月10日開店。aoq.jp: 「AoQ（青久）は、1893年創業の京菓子司「末富」がプロデュースする新ブランドです。」、2023年5月10日にテイクアウト専門カフェ「SUETOMI AoQ Cafe Stand」をオープン、末富のあんこをたっぷり使った「あんカフェオレ」や「あんカスクート」、開店時の営業時間は11時〜18時・定休日なし、2025年11月に猿田彦珈琲とのコラボ商品。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年6月、英語): あんカフェオレ (アイス650円)、あん琥珀バニラ700円、あん塩パン400円、フィナンシェ378円、生ハムとチーズのカスクート、ハンドドリップのコーヒー、温かい抹茶、ベンチあり、一人で営業。

cultural_comfort.note: Takeaway only; cashless only; order at the window.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and aoq.jp; reviews through June 2026.

kyoto_tengo_gojo.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled fish, heshiko and sashimi-style dishes may suit, but gyoza, fried dishes and ramen contain wheat and seasonings use soy (2017–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_tengo_gojo.vegan_detail: Ask. Kyoto pickles, grilled yuba, tofu and vegetable obanzai appear, but dashi is likely and most dishes are fish or meat (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tengo_gojo.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Dinner only since the pandemic — lunch has stopped (September 2025). Reservations accepted; Tabelog remark (machine-translated): only one group a day is taken so guests need not worry about time — book early (Tabelog). All-you-can-drink available (September 2025). No cards; e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). 22 seats: six at the counter and four tables of four; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Children welcome (April 2025). Toukan Gojo-Karasuma Castell 1F; 2 min walk from Gojo Stn.
kyoto_tengo_gojo.notes: [Izakaya · Gojo-Higashinotoin] A quiet, softly lit izakaya with a sake list: lightly cured saba heshiko from the Tango coast, garlicky fried gizzard, salt-grilled kinmedai, water dumplings and obanzai, at fair prices. Dinner only; book. No cards. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: the owner trained at Shimizu Shoten (October 2026); a hideaway izakaya by Gojo station loved by locals and visitors since at least 2017, which once served lunch but has opened only for dinner since the pandemic (2017–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 guest tried the rare lightly pickled saba heshiko and the shop’s own limited sake, also named Tengo.
A family in April 2025 booked on the spot because children were welcome, and ordered shijimi-clam ramen first to keep the child happy.
A former lunchtime regular came back in September 2025 for a farewell party with all-you-can-drink.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮・郷土料理・創作料理、下京区東洞院通五条上ル深草町580 トーカン五条烏丸キャステール 1F、地下鉄五条駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 18:00〜22:00、日曜休み、予約可 (英訳の備考: 1日1組のみ、時間を気にせず、早めの予約を)、カード不可、電子マネー可、QR 不可、22席 (カウンター6席、4人掛け4卓)、喫煙可、貸切可、テイクアウト可。口コミ (2017年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 浅漬けの鯖のへしこ (丹後の郷土料理)、Shimizu Shoten で修業した店主の砂ずりのガーリック揚げ、はまちのキムチ、しめ鯖、金目鯛の塩焼き、湯葉焼き、水餃子、おばんざい、京漬物、しじみのラーメン、お通し3品、店のオリジナルの日本酒、昼はコロナ後にやめた (2025年9月)、子ども連れも可 (2025年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Dinner only; book ahead; no cards (e-money OK); smoking allowed.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_rokkaku_kitchen_109.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled mackerel or saury sets may suit, but tonkatsu, kara-age, fried shrimp and hamburg steak are breaded or bound with wheat, and sides use soy (official site; 2026 reviews). No allergy information.
kyoto_rokkaku_kitchen_109.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and fish set meals with miso soup and obanzai (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_rokkaku_kitchen_109.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and dinner 17:30–21:00 (last order 20:30), daily except Wednesday; breakfast 8:00–11:00 (last order 10:30) on Saturday and Sunday only, and on Monday when it is a public holiday (official site; Tabelog). Closed Wednesday. Reservations accepted; busy at lunch with walk-ins turned away and shared tables possible (September–October 2026). QR-code ordering (September 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX per Tabelog), e-money and QR (Tabelog). Designated smoking area (Tabelog). A machiya with a small back garden; 5 min walk from Karasuma-Oike or Karasuma Stn. Opened 9 July 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_rokkaku_kitchen_109.notes: [Set meals · Karasuma-Rokkaku] A renovated machiya with a little garden serving hearty teishoku — tonkatsu, hamburg steak, grilled mackerel and the daily special with obanzai and a free rice refill — plus a proper Japanese breakfast at weekends. Book for lunch. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a set-meal restaurant in a traditional Kyoto machiya, built on serving warm rice at any time of day, with a daily set chosen as the owner pleases; opened 9 July 2019 (Tabelog). The site also lists ろじうさぎ (mp_roji_usagi, in data).
chef_bio.philosophy: Warm rice to eat any time, morning, noon or night (official site).

anecdotes.text: A Gion Matsuri visitor in July 2026, with floats being readied nearby, had the Haikara Rokkaku lunch of generous shrimp tempura and hamburg steak.
A September 2026 weekend breakfaster found a classic Japanese morning tray of salted mackerel and chirimen sansho.
An October 2026 lunch guest with a booking saw people without one turned away, and a queue on the way out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 六角キッチン、「朝・昼・晩、あたたかいごはんがいつでも食べられることをコンセプトに」、「伝統的な京都の町家で、不易流行の空間と料理をお楽しみください。」、朝 8:00〜11:00 (L.O.10:30、土・日のみ、月曜が祝日の場合は営業)、昼 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、晩 17:30〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、水曜休み、国産とんかつ定食1,850円、唐揚げ定食1,580円、焼さば定食1,480円、「気がわり定食」。食べログ: 食堂・ハンバーグ・オムライス、中京区烏丸六角西入ル骨屋町150-2、予約可、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー・QR 可、分煙、2019年7月9日開店。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): 小さな庭のある町家、ねぎおろしハンバーグ1,780円、月替わりの和と洋の昼、さんまの塩焼き、だし豆腐、おばんざい、ご飯のおかわり1回無料、QR で注文、相席もある、週末の朝ごはん。

cultural_comfort.note: QR-code ordering; book for lunch; shared tables possible.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_white_lover_kiyomizu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: cutlets, curry and shrimp tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_white_lover_kiyomizu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork and beef cutlets, chicken curry, teriyaki, shrimp (2026 reviews).
kyoto_white_lover_kiyomizu.hours_raw: 11:40–15:30 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 30 seats (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). A minute from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop on Higashioji (Tabelog).
kyoto_white_lover_kiyomizu.notes: [Café lunch · Kiyomizu-michi, Showa retro] An old-fashioned coffee-shop-style lunch spot a minute from the Kiyomizu-michi bus stop, serving cheap cutlet sets, curry and teriyaki — a welcome break from the area’s tourist prices. Reviewers find the owner curt or kind by turns. Cash only; lunch only.

chef_bio.background: Two reviewers describe the owner as brusque (January and October 2026); a November 2026 reviewer found the owner kind. No operator was found.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 pair, put off by prices near Kiyomizu-dera, found relief here with a pork-tenderloin cutlet set and a beef-cutlet curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ホワイト ラバー、洋食・カフェ、東山区清水4-140、市バス清水道から徒歩1分、毎日 11:40〜15:30、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、30席、禁煙、昼の予算1,000円未満。口コミ (2026年、英語): 昭和レトロの喫茶店の雰囲気、チキンカレーとトンカツのセット、ヒレカツ定食、牛ヒレカツカレー、照り焼きと海老天ぷら、手頃な値段、店主の接客は無愛想との声と優しいとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Old-style local café; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated January to November 2026.

kyoto_enya_shijo_muromachi.gf_detail: Ask. Charcoal-grilled pork, yakitori, sashimi, oden, dashimaki, dumplings and handmade soba to finish; whether the soba contains wheat is not stated (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_enya_shijo_muromachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: black pork, chicken, sashimi and oden in dashi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_enya_shijo_muromachi.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 17:30–24:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). No cover charge (Tabelog, original なし). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 23 seats: an 11-seat counter and 12 on tatami, more upstairs (Tabelog; November 2025). A red lantern in a lane between Muromachi and Shinmachi north of Shijo, about 3–5 min from Karasuma/Shijo (Tabelog; June and August 2026).
kyoto_enya_shijo_muromachi.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Muromachi lane, charcoal grill and soba] A long-loved red-lantern izakaya off Shijo, with an open charcoal grill for black pork and yakitori, a counter full of regulars, good sashimi and obanzai, and handmade soba to finish. Friendly owner; closed Sunday. Flagged: part of a small local group with 円屋 三条小路店.

chef_bio.background: The shop’s site describes a charcoal-grill izakaya at Shijo-Muromachi alongside a jidori izakaya at Nishiki-Takakura; 円屋 三条小路店 in our data calls itself the sister of 円屋 near Shijo. Reviewers describe a welcoming owner who shares local tips (August 2026) and many local regulars (November 2025).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 couple spotted the red lantern on the way to a convenience store and ended up chatting with the owner and regulars.
A September 2026 non-drinker had the steamed pork with rice and pickles, and was talked into the soba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 四条室町の炭焼と、錦高倉の地鶏が美味しい居酒屋 京都 円屋。食べログ: 円屋、そば・居酒屋、中京区室町と新町の間四条上ル観音堂町454-2、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から西へ徒歩5分、月〜土 17:30〜24:00、日曜定休、チャージなし、カード可、23席 (カウンター11、座敷12)、六白黒豚、手打ちそば、備長炭でじっくり焼く旬の野菜、飲み放題付きコース。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 焼き鳥の盛り合わせ、ねぎま、だし巻き、水餃子、赤こんにゃくのおばんざい、刺身、焼き魚と豚、締めの手打ちそば、しゃぶしゃぶサラダ、おでん、蒸し豚と手羽先、うざく、ねぎとろ、カマ焼き、名物のおから、稚鮎の南蛮漬け、気さくな店主、地元の常連。

cultural_comfort.note: Local regulars at the counter; no cover charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_salon_de_kanbayashi.gf_detail: Ask. Matcha sweets (gateau chocolat, opera, macarons) and a five-tier afternoon tea with savoury Japanese dishes; no gluten information (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_salon_de_kanbayashi.vegan_detail: Ask. The plain teas are plant-only, but the sweets and afternoon tea are not described as vegan (own site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_salon_de_kanbayashi.hours_raw: Monday, Wednesday–Sunday and holidays 11:30–17:00; closed Tuesday and on some weekends and holidays (Tabelog). Afternoon tea “京KASANE” ¥5,000 a head plus 10% service, or ¥6,100 plus service in the round-window private room for 1–4 (own site, original サービス料別途10％). Cash only (Tabelog). 30 seats; smoking on the terrace (Tabelog). In a renovated Taisho-era house and storehouse with a large garden, near the Yasaka pagoda, 3 min from the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). A second salon is at 京都・時代祭館 十二十二 by Heian Shrine (own site).
kyoto_salon_de_kanbayashi.notes: [Tea salon · near the Yasaka pagoda, an Uji tea house since c. 1560] The café of the historic Uji tea merchant 上林春松本店, in a renovated Taisho house with a big garden: brew gyokuro or sencha yourself, try matcha sweets, or book the five-tier “京KASANE” afternoon tea (¥5,000 plus 10% service). Cash only; closed Tuesday.

roles: Tea salon of 上林春松本店 (staff unnamed)
chef_bio.background: The salon’s site says 上林春松本店 was founded in the Eiroku era (around 1560), with 450 years of history as a Uji tea house; the Kanbayashi family served as official tea masters (御茶師), and the house is now led by the 14th-generation 上林春松. Sweets are made by a pastry chef using the house’s teas (Tabelog).
chef_bio.philosophy: Tea brewed with care from a long-established Uji tea house (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 visitor, struck by the building after lunch, went in and was taught to brew gyokuro at the table.
A June 2025 guest in a yukata spent two and a half hours over afternoon tea looking out on the 700-tsubo garden.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: Salon de KANBAYASHI、上林春松本店は永禄年間 (1560年頃) 創業、450年の歴史を持つ宇治の老舗茶舗、上林家は御茶師、現在は十四代 上林春松、玉露と煎茶を急須で淹れる体験1,500円、選べるドリンクセット2,000円、五段重アフタヌーンティー「京KASANE」1人5,000円 (税込・サービス料別途10%)、丸窓の個室は6,100円、2号店は京都・時代祭館 十二十二。食べログ: 東山区下河原通高台寺塔之前上る金園町400-1、市バス東山安井から徒歩3分、月・水〜日・祝日 11:30〜17:00、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー不可、30席、禁煙 (テラスで喫煙可)、蔵を改装、抹茶「Biwa no Shiro」のガトーショコラ。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 700坪の庭、浴衣でアフタヌーンティー、鯖の酢締め、抹茶のオペラとマカロンの甘味プレート1,800円、玉露「Zuitama」、大正時代の建物、竹林。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff teach tea brewing; cash only; 10% service on afternoon tea.

existence.note: Own site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_yakiniku_soya.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakiniku with sweet-spicy miso and soy-based sauces, beef-tendon ramen, cold noodles and bibimbap (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_soya.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a yakiniku shop — tongue, kalbi, yukhoe, beef bowls (2023–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_soya.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); open all year apart from special closures such as New Year (check the reservation calendar). Lunch also at weekends (2025 reviews). Reservations taken; lunch can be fully booked (September 2025). Cards and PayPay. 28 seats with counter seating. Non-smoking. The toilet is outside, so the door lets in a draught (May 2025). Ayanokoji-dori just west of Muromachi, 3 min from Karasuma or Shijo exit 26 (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Opened 12 December 2023. Run by 有限会社MASUICHI (NTA invoice register); reviewers call it a shop of the 益市 (Masuichi) yakiniku group.
kyoto_yakiniku_soya.notes: [Yakiniku · Ayanokoji near Shijo-Karasuma, a casual grill with lunch bowls] A clean, casual yakiniku room from the Masuichi people: raw tongue and approved raw yukhoe at night, and some of the best-value lunches in the area — tongue or kalbi bowls about ¥1,000 with free large rice. Dinner about ¥4,000–5,000. Open daily.

roles: Operator: 有限会社MASUICHI (NTA invoice register)
chef_bio.background: Opened 12 December 2023 (Tabelog). The invoice registration is 有限会社MASUICHI, and four 2025–2026 reviewers call it part of the long-established 益市 (Masuichi) yakiniku group; the group's 焼き肉家 益市 堺町錦店 record lists it among the group's other-named shops. Reviewers describe attentive staff, a clean room, solo diners and an app with points. Criticism: a pricey outside skirt (June 2025); too little meat at lunch (2025); soft ramen noodles and little tendon (November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Raw tongue; yukhoe; yakiniku bowls at lunch.

anecdotes.text: May 2025: "Overall, everything was tasty, but the yukhoe and tongue were particularly exceptional! The texture of the yukhoe and the tenderness of the tongue were simply exquisite."
April 2026: "This restaurant is a casual yakiniku spot operated by the long-established 'Masuichi' group… For lunch, there are many menu options available in the JPY 1,000 range."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉 soya、焼肉・居酒屋・ホルモン、下京区善長寺町153 和優館ビル1F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅26番出口から徒歩3分、毎日11:30〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、年中無休 (年末年始など特別休業あり)、予約可、カード・PayPay可、28席、禁煙、2023年12月12日オープン、生タンと保健所の許可を得た生ユッケ。インボイス登録は有限会社MASUICHI (国税庁)。口コミ (2023年12月〜2026年8月、英語・日本語): ねぎ塩牛たん丼980円 (スープ・キムチ付き、ご飯大盛り無料)、甘辛味噌の牛たん丼980円、カルビランチ980円、焼肉ランチ2,200円、カルビ丼1,280円 (2026年4月)、石焼ビビンバ、牛すじ塩ラーメン、ユッケ、タン、ハラミ、冷麺、昼の200円ハイボール、益市グループの店との記載 (2025〜2026年)、トイレは店外 (2025年5月)、ハラミが高めとの声 (2025年6月)、ランチの肉が少なめとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Casual and solo-friendly; lunch fills up — book.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated June, July and August 2026.

kyoto_manjiro_kodaiji.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: kaiseki built around nama-fu (wheat gluten) — fu dengaku, fu noodles, fu manju — with tempura and soy-based dishes (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_manjiro_kodaiji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses include sashimi, buri daikon, Omi-beef steak and chirashi sushi (2025–2026 reviews), though yuba and fu feature heavily — ask.
kyoto_manjiro_kodaiji.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:00; closed on irregular days. Reservations taken. Prices include tax, service charge 10% extra — Tabelog, Japanese original 「税込・サービス料10％別」. Private rooms for 2–30 with lunch kaiseki from ¥7,000 or dinner kaiseki at ¥11,000 (Tabelog). 50 seats: tables on the 1st floor, tatami and sunken private rooms upstairs with a courtyard view. Designated smoking area. Cards and WeChat Pay. An old townhouse on Kodaiji Kitamon-mae-dori east of Shimogawara, between Yasaka Shrine and Kodaiji (2025 reviews); 10 min from Keihan Gion-Shijo.
kyoto_manjiro_kodaiji.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Kodaiji, an old townhouse with private rooms] A comfortable townhouse between Yasaka Shrine and Kodaiji serving gentle Kyoto courses built on yuba and nama-fu — fu noodles, fu dengaku, fu manju — with a ¥5,500 lunch "Nene Gozen" and private rooms upstairs. 10% service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: A December 2025 reviewer calls it a sister restaurant of Hanazaki in Gion (romaji as given). Reviewers describe a long-standing old building, polite and friendly staff who see guests off and help with photos, regulars who return every New Year, and private rooms with a courtyard view. Criticism: a menu much like last year's (February 2026); no standout dish for the price (March 2026); flavors that did not leave a strong impression (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba and nama-fu kaiseki; "Nene Gozen" lunch.

anecdotes.text: December 2025: "I ordered the Mini Kaiseki Nene Gozen for lunch, priced at JPY 5,500. This course includes a total of 9 dishes… offering great value!"
January 2025: "Every year, we visit after receiving a purification ritual at Yasaka Shrine. Our New Year starts here."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 萬治郎、日本料理、東山区高台寺北門前通下河原東入鷲尾町518、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩10分、毎日11:30〜14:00・17:30〜20:00、不定休、予約可、原文で「税込・サービス料10％別」、50席、個室 (2〜30名、昼は7,000円以上・夜は11,000円の会席で利用可)、分煙、カード・WeChat Pay可、公式サイト kyoto-manjiro.com。口コミ (2023年1月〜2026年10月、英語・日本語): 湯葉と生麩の会席、ミニ会席「ねね御膳」5,500円 (9品、2025年12月)、まぐろ・鯛・湯葉の刺身、生麩と小芋の焼き物、鰤大根、麩の麺、天ぷら、ちらし寿司、麩まんじゅう、生湯葉の刺身、紫芋のごま豆腐、正月の白味噌雑煮 (2026年1月)、近江牛のステーキの会席 (2026年2月)、熟成の刺身 (2026年4月)、祇園Hanazakiの姉妹店との記載 (2025年12月)、2階の個室、毎年通う常連、献立が昨年と似ていたとの声 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Popular with overseas visitors (December 2025); private tatami rooms or ground-floor tables; 10% service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated March, April and October 2026.

kyoto_non_tea_ceremony.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog's listing marks gluten-free options, but the three reviews (July–September 2026) describe only a lemon-themed afternoon tea and do not say which items are gluten-free. Reservation only — ask when booking.
kyoto_non_tea_ceremony.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog's listing marks vegan options; reviewers describe a lemon-themed afternoon tea with Japanese black tea (July–September 2026) without saying which items are vegan. Ask when booking.
kyoto_non_tea_ceremony.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 11:00–18:00; closed Thursday. Reservation only — contact them by Instagram DM if running late. Cards, IC and e-money. 12 seats. Non-smoking. 13 min walk from Gion-Shijo, at 星野町 in Higashiyama. Opened 5 June 2026.
kyoto_non_tea_ceremony.notes: [Afternoon tea · Higashiyama, a quiet 12-seat salon] A calm, reservation-only tea room for a seasonal afternoon tea with free-flowing Japanese black tea — lemon-themed in summer — at about ¥5,000–8,000. Tabelog lists vegan and gluten-free options: ask when you book. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Opened 5 June 2026 (Tabelog). The three reviews so far (July–September 2026) describe a calm, quiet room, free-flowing drinks and ingredients chosen with care. Thin evidence: three short reviews.
chef_bio.specialty: Seasonal afternoon tea with Japanese black tea.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "The afternoon tea featured a menu rich in lemon, which was refreshing during the hot summer and paired wonderfully with the Japanese black tea."
July 2026: "The deliciousness clearly reflected their commitment to quality ingredients… I was able to spend a relaxing time in a calm and quiet atmosphere."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: non tea ceremony、カフェ・スイーツ、東山区星野町92-9、祇園四条駅から徒歩13分、月〜水・金〜日・祝日11:00〜18:00、木曜休み、完全予約制 (遅れる場合はInstagramのDMなどで連絡を)、交通系IC・電子マネー可、12席、禁煙、ヴィーガン・グルテンフリーの対応あり、2026年6月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜9月、英語、3件): ドリンクおかわり自由のアフタヌーンティー、夏はレモンをたっぷり使った内容と和紅茶、静かで落ち着いた空間。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; quiet room.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (opened 5 June 2026) with reviews dated July and September 2026.

kyoto_smoke_grill_lotus.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: ajillo with baguette, bruschetta, katsu curry, shrimp fry, chicken tenders with tartar (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_smoke_grill_lotus.vegan_detail: Not vegan: smoked bacon, mackerel, chicken ham, steak, hamburg, liver (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_smoke_grill_lotus.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 (lunch, as "Cafe Lotus", weekdays only) and 18:00–1:00; Sat and Sun 18:00–1:00; L.O. 23:30; open all year apart from occasional breaks (a summer break in August 2026). Reservations taken. Cards and PayPay. 32 seats: 8 at the counter, 24 at tables. Smoking: e-cigarettes only until 22:00, then a designated smoking area (Tabelog); a 2026 reviewer smoked at lunch. BYO allowed. 2nd floor of the 道家商事ビル down a winding alley near Shijo-Karasuma, 3 min from Karasuma or Shijo. Opened 10 June 2008. Sister restaurants Charcoal and Stem (May 2026 review).
kyoto_smoke_grill_lotus.notes: [Smoked dishes & Italian bar · back alley by Shijo-Karasuma, open to 1 am] An alley bar devoted to the smoker and the grill — the theatrical smoked-egg "Potato Salad Mountain", smoked mackerel and bacon, ajillo, steak — with good wine until 1 am, and hearty weekday lunch sets around ¥1,100–1,300 with mountains of salad. Smoking area after 22:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 10 June 2008 (Tabelog); lunch as "Cafe Lotus" began in 2025 (June 2025 review). Reviewers describe a friendly manager, staff who adjust portions to the group, and a smoker-friendly room; a May 2026 reviewer mentions sister restaurants Charcoal and Stem. Criticism: an inedibly tough Angus steak and slow service (December 2025); drink mix-ups on all-you-can-drink and a disappointing sangria (2025); a bad katsu (2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Smoked dishes; "Potato Salad Mountain"; weekday lunch sets.

anecdotes.text: January 2026: "We started with the famous 'Potato Salad Mountain.' Hidden inside is a smoked boiled egg, and the staff crushes it right in front of you for a fun presentation!"
December 2025: "Angus Beef ▶︎ Unbelievable… I couldn't even chew it, let alone cut it with a knife."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: LOTUS (スモーク＆グリル ロータス)、イタリアン・居酒屋・バル、中京区観音堂町470 道家商事ビル2F、阪急烏丸駅・地下鉄四条駅から徒歩3分、月〜金11:30〜15:00 (平日のみのランチ「Cafe Lotus」)・18:00〜翌1:00、土・日18:00〜翌1:00、L.O.23:30、年中無休、予約可、カード・PayPay可、32席 (カウンター8・テーブル24)、22時までは電子たばこのみ、持ち込み可、2008年6月10日オープン、公式サイト lotus0610.com。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年9月、英語): いぶりがっこと燻製卵の「ポテサラマウンテン」880円、燻製 (鶏ハム、ベーコン、カニカマ、鯖、明太子、いちじくバター、梅干し) 380〜660円、鶏レバーのオイル煮880円、アヒージョ1,100円、バゲット330円、牛ステーキとフライドポテト3,190円 (2026年1月)、スモークサーモンのブルスケッタ、燻製タン、昼はビーフカレー1,100円、カレーハンバーグ1,300円、デミグラスハンバーグ、鶏むね肉のおろし、チキンのタルタル、姉妹店CharcoalとStem (2026年5月)、アンガス牛が硬すぎたとの声 (2025年12月)、飲み放題のミス (2025年)。

cultural_comfort.note: Smoker-friendly (e-cigarettes only until 22:00); lunch on weekdays only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated June, August and September 2026.

kyoto_gion_takezushi.gf_detail: Ask. Nigiri with soy, plus fried dishes such as deep-fried scallop; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_gion_takezushi.hours_raw: 17:30–21:30 (last order 21:00) Wednesday–Sunday; closed Monday and Tuesday, and on some other days; may close early (Tabelog). Reservations online and by phone, same-day calls welcome (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay accepted; no e-money (Tabelog). Service charge 5% (Tabelog). 22 seats: an 8-seat counter and three private rooms with sunken kotatsu for 4, 4 and 6 that join for 14; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible (Tabelog). On Gion-machi Kitagawa, 2 minutes from Gion-Shijo Exit 7 (Tabelog). Opened 2 July 2012 (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_takezushi.notes: [Sushi · Gion north of Shijo, counter and kotatsu rooms] A traditional Gion sushi bar with an 8-seat counter and sunken-kotatsu private rooms: 12 pieces for ¥5,750 or 16 for ¥9,200, served briskly by a chef who seems gruff at first and warms up. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in July 2012 (Tabelog). Reviewers (2024–2026) describe a craftsman head chef who can seem brusque at first but turns friendly and chatty, serving sushi at a quick pace.

anecdotes.text: A June 2024 group ordered the deep-fried scallop twice.
A November 2025 birthday dinner of 16 pieces won over a diner who usually dislikes horse mackerel.
A July 2026 reviewer called the chef a true craftsman, if a little unapproachable.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園 竹寿司 (たけずし)、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、京都市東山区祇園町北側270-2、水〜日 17:30〜21:30 (L.O.21:00)、月・火定休、ほかに不定休、早じまいの日も、予約可 (当日の電話も)、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可、サービス料5%、22席 (カウンター8席、掘りごたつの個室3室 4・4・6名、つなげて14名)、禁煙、車椅子可、2012年7月2日オープン、おまかせ寿司12貫5,750円、おまかせ握りコース (16貫) 9,200円、特選寿司コース13,000円。口コミ (2021〜2026年、英語): 職人肌の大将は最初こわそうでも話すと気さく、テンポよく出る、追加は1貫500〜600円ほど、ほたての揚げ物、海老、鯵、鯛、烏賊。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; 5% service.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with current courses; reviews dated through July 2026.

kyoto_chocolate_bold_italic_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask. Hazelnut soft serve, hot chocolate with gianduja, and sodas; cones and toppings not described; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_chocolate_bold_italic_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dairy soft serve and milk-based hot chocolate (reviews).
kyoto_chocolate_bold_italic_nishiki.hours_raw: 10:00–17:30; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). A drink and soft-serve stand in a renovated machiya with a few small benches; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2025). On Takakura about 20 m north of Nishiki Market, by the Daimaru Takakura exit (Tabelog; June 2025). Opened 5 March 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_chocolate_bold_italic_nishiki.notes: [Sweets · Nishiki Market north end, hazelnut soft serve] A tiny machiya stand a few steps from Nishiki Market making soft serve from Italian hazelnuts (¥600) and thick hot chocolate under shaved gianduja (¥650), plus bright seasonal sodas. A couple of benches; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 5 March 2024 (Tabelog). A June 2025 reviewer writes that an Italian chef opened the shop (Tabelog review B509331167).

anecdotes.text: A June 2025 visitor found the hot chocolate velvety under melting shaved gianduja.
A June 2025 pair cooled off on the mini benches with a mint soda that came with mint ice cream.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: chocolate Bold Italic、スイーツ・ソフトクリーム、京都市中京区高倉通錦上ル中魚屋町510-3、月・水〜日 10:00〜17:30、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可、禁煙、2024年3月5日オープン、錦市場から北へ20mの高倉通、イタリア産ヘーゼルナッツで毎日つくるソフトクリーム、濃厚なホットチョコレート、季節のドリンク。口コミ (2025年6月、英語): 町家を改装したカフェスタンド、ヘーゼルナッツのソフトクリーム600円、削ったジャンドゥーヤをのせたホットチョコレート650円、ミントソーダ、イタリア人シェフの店、小さなベンチ、大丸の高倉口の近く。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; cards and QR accepted.

kyoto_ookini_youkini_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Japanese dishes built on dashi, with homemade ponzu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_ookini_youkini_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi, sashimi and fish dishes (reviews).
kyoto_ookini_youkini_gion.hours_raw: 18:00 to about midnight Monday–Saturday; closed Sunday and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted (Tabelog). A 6-seat raised counter without backrests and a tatami area with two tables for four; smoking allowed (Tabelog; March and May 2024). Second floor of the Sky Court Gion building on Hanamikoji north of Sueyoshi-cho, west side; easy to miss (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_ookini_youkini_gion.notes: [Kappo · Gion Hanamikoji, upstairs and easy to miss] A small upstairs kappo on Hanamikoji run by a chef and an okami, much loved by regulars: careful dashi, sashimi and obanzai from the day's list, shirako with homemade ponzu in winter, mackerel sushi to finish. About ¥6,000–10,000; smoking allowed; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: A December 2024 regular has been coming since it opened about 14 years earlier. Reviewers (2023–2026) describe a small restaurant run by a chef and an okami, a friendly chef with a skilled hand at dashi, and mostly regular guests.

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 year-end party finished, as always, with the mackerel sushi.
A February 2026 regular had the last shirako of the season with homemade ponzu.
A March 2024 diner ordered the hojicha ice cream three times.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おおきにようきに、日本料理、京都市東山区花見小路末吉町上ル西側 スカイコート祇園2F、月〜土 18:00〜0:00ごろ、日曜・祝日定休、予約可、カード可 (JCB、AMEX、Diners)、喫煙可、カウンターと座敷。口コミ (2018〜2026年、英語): 開店から14年ほど通う常連 (2024年12月)、大将と女将の小さな店、刺身とおばんざい、出汁がうまい、土瓶蒸し、白子と自家製ポン酢、ほたるいかの酢味噌、まぐろのユッケ、ぐじの塩焼き、白焼き、ほうじ茶アイス、締めの鯖寿司、カウンター6席 (背もたれなし)、座敷に4人卓が2つ、見つけにくく常連が多い、1人6,000〜10,000円ほど。

cultural_comfort.note: Regulars’ counter; smoking allowed.

kyoto_umenoya_gion_shinbashi.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu shabu-shabu with homemade ponzu and sesame sauce, sukiyaki, udon to finish; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_umenoya_gion_shinbashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu shabu-shabu, sukiyaki and steak (official site).
kyoto_umenoya_gion_shinbashi.hours_raw: 09:30–16:00 (last order 15:30) and 18:00–22:00 (last food order 21:00, drinks 21:30); closed Monday and Wednesday (official site). Tabelog instead lists Monday and Wednesday as evening-only and says evenings are by advance reservation from September. Cards (incl. UnionPay) and PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no e-money (Tabelog). 27 seats: a 10-seat counter and a 17-seat tatami room with sunken kotatsu (official site); smoking at the counter, non-smoking in the tatami room (Tabelog). English menu with photos, English- and Chinese-speaking staff; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). By the Shirakawa near Tatsumi Daimyojin, Shinbashi-dori west of Hanamikoji (official site).
kyoto_umenoya_gion_shinbashi.notes: [Shabu-shabu & sukiyaki · Gion Shinbashi, a former maiko's ochaya] A Shirakawa-side teahouse turned shabu-shabu house so first-timers can taste ochaya life, run by an okami who was once a maiko. Lunch from 9:30 — wagyu courses ¥5,980 or the ¥3,980 maiko meal; dinner courses ¥12,800 with a drink. English menu; closed Monday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A traditional Kyoto ochaya renewed as a shabu-shabu and sukiyaki restaurant so that first-time visitors can enjoy it; run by an okami who was a maiko (official site). An October 2026 reviewer describes a teahouse of about 100 years, with photos of the okami’s maiko days along the entrance corridor; the okami serves in the evenings and leaves lunch to the staff.
chef_bio.philosophy: Gion hospitality in the Kyoto speech of a former maiko (official site).

anecdotes.text: A December 2024 guest came for the ambience and the chat with the okami over a free-drink course.
An October 2026 solo diner had the maiko meal, whose diced steak is sized for a maiko’s small mouth.
An October 2026 host brought overseas guests for Omi beef shabu-shabu at lunch.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 梅乃家、しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼き、京都市東山区新橋通花見小路西入橋本町385、白川のほとり、辰巳大明神の近く、元舞妓の女将が営む老舗、京都伝統のお茶屋を一見さんにも楽しめるようにしゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼きの店にリニューアル、9:30〜16:00 (L.O.15:30)、18:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理21:00、ドリンク21:30)、月曜・水曜定休、27席 (カウンター10席、座敷17席)、ランチ: 和牛しゃぶしゃぶコース・和牛すき焼きコース各5,980円、舞妓飯3,980円、ステーキコース4,980円、七色餃子1,980円、翠雪 (抹茶体験) 1,880円、肉追加2,980円、野菜追加1,980円、ディナー: 和牛しゃぶしゃぶコース・和牛すき焼きコース各12,800円、最高級しゃぶしゃぶ・すき焼きコース各14,800円 (日曜・祝日の夜限定、要予約)、ディナーはドリンク1杯付き。食べログ: 月・水は夜のみ、9月から夜は事前予約のみ、カード (銀聯も)・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay可、電子マネー不可、カウンターは喫煙可・座敷は禁煙、英語メニュー、英語・中国語のスタッフ、子供可。口コミ (2017〜2026年、英語): 元舞妓の女将、100年のお茶屋を改装、廊下に女将の舞妓時代の写真、夜は女将が接客、近江牛のしゃぶしゃぶ、自家製のポン酢とごまだれ、締めのうどん、舞妓飯は九州産黒毛和牛のサイコロステーキ、飲み放題のコース (2024年)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu with photos; English- and Chinese-speaking staff (Tabelog).

existence.note: Official site with current menu; reviews dated through November 2026.
