kyoto_ichirakuya_higashinotoin.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi and grilled dishes may suit; soy-based bowls and fried dishes are common (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_ichirakuya_higashinotoin.vegan_detail: Ask. Nukazuke cucumbers (2023–25 reviews), but most dishes have fish or meat.
kyoto_ichirakuya_higashinotoin.hours_raw: Mon and Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:00–24:00; Tue, Wed, Thu, Sat 17:00–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays; lunch until sold out; hours may change (Tabelog). Lunch is three dishes only — seafood bowl, pork bowl, curry (2024 reviews). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners only); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). Smoking allowed, at lunch too (Tabelog; February 2024 review). Counter and tatami seats in an old-house interior (November 2023 review). 2 min from Shijo Stn, near Hotel Nikko (Tabelog; November 2023 review).
kyoto_ichirakuya_higashinotoin.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma] A smoky, old-farmhouse-style izakaya loved by locals and office workers: daily sashimi, shichirin grilling and cheap stir-fries at night, a big ¥1,100 seafood bowl at lunch. About ¥3,000–6,000; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: A local izakaya run by a manager with a small, lively staff (January 2025 review); the boss shows the day's specials on a small blackboard (January 2025 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi; seafood rice bowl at lunch.

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 diner found the stir-fried garlic chives and egg topped with mayonnaise a first, and noted the cook shouting thanks at every bill paid.
A September 2024 lunch guest was asked straight away whether it would be the seafood bowl, and found the fish hid the rice entirely.
A July 2026 office worker meant to have a quick drink and enjoyed grilling on the shichirin.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 一楽家 東洞院高辻店、居酒屋・魚介料理・日本料理、下京区、四条烏丸の南、サイトービル1F、地下鉄四条駅から徒歩2分、月・金 11:30〜13:30・17:00〜24:00、火・水・木・土 17:00〜24:00、日曜・祝日休み、昼は売り切れまで、カード可 (JCB・AMEX・Diners)、電子マネー・QR 不可、喫煙可。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): 地元の客に愛される居酒屋、古民家のような店内、刺身の盛り合わせ、ぬか漬けのきゅうり、ニラ玉、海老フライ、雑炊、七輪、昼は海鮮丼1,100円、豚丼とカレー700円 (2024年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: A local, smoky izakaya; specials on a whiteboard.

kyoto_unagi_en_sanjo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: eel is basted with a soy-based tare; plain shirayaki with wasabi is offered (2025–26 reviews) — ask about soy.
kyoto_unagi_en_sanjo.hours_raw: Tue–Fri 12:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:00) and 17:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–16:00 and 17:00–21:30; closed Mondays (Tuesday when Monday is a holiday) (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog Japanese original 「無し」). Order by QR code (2025–26 reviews). Cards and QR; no e-money (Tabelog). 30 seats: 14 at the counter and tables at the back; non-smoking (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Basement of the Takagi Kaikan on Sanjo-dori east of Sanjo Ohashi, 2 min from Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_unagi_en_sanjo.notes: [Unagi · Sanjo] A modern basement eel house by Sanjo Ohashi grilling Kansai-style over charcoal — crisp skin, fluffy flesh, light tare — with unaju from about ¥3,000 and hitsumabushi. QR ordering; one of two shops with Hikone.

chef_bio.background: One of two shops of the brand, with Hikone in Shiga (Hot Pepper; Retty; September 2026 review). The eel is grilled to order, about 30 minutes (December 2025 review), behind a glass partition at the counter (December 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 diner who tours eel shops nationwide sensed the craftsmen's dedication from the entrance and rated the value top-level.
A July 2026 guest staying at the Hilton Kyoto walked over for unaju and was seen off by the owner.
A September 2026 family of three ordered three different dishes, and the daughter noticed the dashimaki crowding out the eel in one box.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 本格炭火焼うなぎ えん 京都三条店、うなぎ・日本料理・弁当、東山区、三条大橋の東、高樹会館 B1F、京阪・地下鉄三条駅から徒歩2分、火〜金 12:00〜16:00・17:00〜21:30、土日・祝日 11:30〜16:00・17:00〜21:30、月曜休み、サービス料なし、カード・QR 可、30席 (カウンター14)、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年): 関西地焼き、外はカリッと中はふわトロ、注文は QR (2025年12月、日本語)、うな重 (1/2・3/4・1本)、ひつまぶし、白焼き、湯葉とあおさの吸い物、肝吸い、彦根にも店 (2026年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering suits overseas visitors (December 2025 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_il_filo_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Homemade pasta and bread are wheat; the kitchen adapts courses to requests (August 2025 review).
kyoto_il_filo_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. The kitchen adapts courses to requests (August 2025 review), but dishes use seafood, meat and butter.
kyoto_il_filo_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (reservation required); dinner 18:00–22:00 (last entry); closed Wednesdays and Thursday lunch — the listing is ambiguous; hours may change; a notice says it reopens on 1 November (year not given) (Tabelog). Lunch from ¥2,500 on Fri, Sat and Sun (November 2024 review). Seat charge ¥300 plus tax (Tabelog Japanese original 「席料￥300（税別）」). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: a 10-seat counter and two tables, a private room for 8; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Kiyamachi south of Oike, 1 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog).
kyoto_il_filo_kiyamachi.notes: [Italian · Kiyamachi] A counter Italian run like a kappo: a Northern Italian chef cooks courses shaped to each guest, with homemade pasta, ossobuco and white truffles in season, and a deep wine list. About ¥10,000–20,000; ¥300 seat charge.

chef_bio.background: A chef specialising in Northern Italian cooking (December 2025 review); Italian food by Japanese chefs, served like a kaiseki counter that takes requests (August 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular had white truffle over thin egg pasta and felt it beat the best of Milan.
An August 2025 first-timer, introduced by Kurihana, saw a note asking guests to check before taking photos.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イル フィーロ、イタリアン・ワインバー・パスタ、中京区の木屋町、御池の南、1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩1分、昼 12:00〜14:00 (要予約)、夜 18:00〜22:00 (最終入店)、定休日は「水曜と木曜 (昼)」と記載、11月1日に再開と告知 (年の記載なし)、席料300円 (税別)、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、18席 (カウンター10)、個室あり、禁煙、子供可。口コミ (2023〜2025年、英語): 北イタリアの料理の料理人、自家製のパンとパスタ、オッソブーコ (2025年8月)、白トリュフ (2025年12月)、割烹のように注文に応じる、昼は2,500円から (2024年11月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter dining; ask before taking photos (August 2025 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing (a reopening notice for 1 November, year not given); reviews dated through December 2025.

kyoto_tempura_kappo_yamamoto_gion.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a tempura counter (wheat batter).
kyoto_tempura_kappo_yamamoto_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood tempura course (2023–26 reviews).
kyoto_tempura_kappo_yamamoto_gion.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 14 seats at a counter and tatami rooms; heated tobacco only in a smoking area (Tabelog; April 2026 review). English and Traditional Chinese menus (Tabelog); English-speaking staff (December 2024 review). 4th floor of the Higashi-Shinbashi Building east of Hanamikoji on Shinbashi, 7 min from Sanjo or Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_tempura_kappo_yamamoto_gion.notes: [Tempura · Gion] A fourth-floor tempura counter run by a famously cheerful owner with years in Miyakawacho: creative courses with karasumi mochi and sea urchin, light batter, curry salt, and sake to match. About ¥10,000–20,000.

chef_bio.background: Moved to Gion in March 2023 from Takakura-Nijo (October 2023 and March 2025 reviews); Tabelog gives 19 March 2023 as the opening. Many years in Miyakawacho (April 2026 review). Nicknamed "Sexy Yamamoto" by a July 2025 guest; cheerful and entertaining (2024–26 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Karasumi mochi with sea urchin; tempura sushi.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 birthday party asked for junmai daiginjo when booking and found excellent sake waiting; tempura sushi closed the course.
An April 2026 guest was put at ease by the owner's smile the moment the door opened, and enjoyed IQOS at the table.
A December 2024 diner who usually avoids anago happily finished one here.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 天ぷら割烹 やまもと、日本料理、東山区林下町427 東新橋ビル4F、京阪三条駅・祇園四条駅から徒歩7分、月〜土 17:00〜22:00、日曜休み、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、14席、個室あり、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙可、英語と繁体字のメニュー、2023年3月19日オープン。口コミ (2023〜2026年、英語): Takakura-Nijo から祇園に移転、店主は Yamamoto さん、Miyakawacho で長く、からすみ餅に雲丹、穴子、カレー塩、最後は天ぷらのおにぎりか天ぷらの寿司、英語の話せるスタッフ。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu (Tabelog) and English-speaking staff (December 2024 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through April 2026.

kyoto_dot_coffee.gf_detail: Ask. A December 2025 diner found gluten-free cheesecake and chocolate cake made without wheat; other cakes and snacks are not described. No cross-contact information.
kyoto_dot_coffee.vegan_detail: Ask. The gluten-free cakes were made without soy milk (December 2025), but no vegan claim is sourced; the acai bowl comes with honey (August 2025).
kyoto_dot_coffee.hours_raw: Hours not listed on Tabelog; check before visiting. Reviews mention Saturday early afternoon (December 2025) and lunch (August 2025). E-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Counter seats at the front, sofas and tables at the back (December 2025). Wi-Fi (December 2024) and phone charging (January 2025). Near Sanjo Keihan Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_dot_coffee.notes: [Café · Sanjo Keihan] A small café near Sanjo Keihan with a counter at the front and sofas at the back, serving strong espresso drinks in large sizes, acai bowls and cakes — including gluten-free cheesecake and chocolate cake. Wi-Fi. Hours not listed; check first.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café near Sanjo Keihan Station, opened 29 October 2021.
chef_bio.specialty: Large espresso drinks; acai bowls; gluten-free cakes.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 Saturday visitor was surprised to find gluten-free cheesecake and chocolate cake, made without wheat or soy milk; the sofa seats filled within an hour.
A February 2025 walker ordered a large café latte for ¥650 and got about one and a half times the expected size, with very strong espresso.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ、京阪三条駅近く、2021年10月29日オープン、電子マネー・QR 可、全席禁煙、営業時間の記載なし。口コミ (2024年12月〜2025年12月、英語): Wi-Fi、充電可、ラージのカフェラテ650円は約1.5倍の量、フルーツとグラノーラにはちみつのアサイーボウル、小麦も豆乳も使わないグルテンフリーのチーズケーキとチョコレートケーキ、手前にカウンター、奥にソファ席。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter; ask whether the gluten-free cakes are in stock that day. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through December 2025.

kyoto_yakiniku_toranoya_shiyakushomae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: yakiniku with marinades and dipping sauces, mixed noodles, kimchi-based sundubu (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_toranoya_shiyakushomae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: grilled beef and offal, yukhoe, horumon sundubu (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_toranoya_shiyakushomae.hours_raw: Mon, Tue, Wed, Sun 17:00–22:00; Fri–Sat 17:00–03:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Lunch is also served — sundubu sets, mixed noodles, steak rice bowl (July and November 2025); lunch hours not listed. Popular cuts can sell out by 18:00 (March 2025); some items, including kalbi, were out in May 2026. Payment: Tabelog lists cards and QR (no e-money), but a March 2025 diner was told cash only and no invoices — bring cash. Private rooms; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Next to Kyoto City Hall, above Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae subway station (May 2026).
kyoto_yakiniku_toranoya_shiyakushomae.notes: [Yakiniku · Kyoto City Hall] A yakiniku restaurant beside Kyoto City Hall, sister to a Korean restaurant in Minami Ward: thick-cut tongue and tenderloin, yukhoe and namul at night, and sundubu, mixed noodles and steak bowls at lunch. Open to 3:00 on Friday and Saturday; closed Thursday. Bring cash — a 2025 diner was told cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: opened 1 August 2024 near Kyoto City Hall as the sister shop of a well-known Korean restaurant in Minami Ward (September 2024).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 lunch diner chose the horumon sundubu set on a hot day; the kimchi-based soup was milder than expected and arrived in a little over five minutes.
A March 2025 diner, expecting cards from the Tabelog listing, was told cash only; many items had sold out by 18:00, but the thick-cut tongue impressed.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉、中京区上本能寺前町480-3、月火水日17:00〜22:00、金土17:00〜翌3:00、木曜休み、カード・QR 可 (電子マネー不可)、個室あり、喫煙可、2024年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2024年9月〜2026年5月、英語): 南区の有名な韓国料理店の姉妹店、特製ユッケ、ハツ、ねぎ塩タン、厚切りヒレ、2025年3月は現金のみでインボイス未登録と言われた、18時には売り切れ多数、厚切りタン、ランチはホルモンスンドゥブ定食や麺料理、ステーキ丼、遅くまで営業、市役所前駅の真上、ドリンクが豊富、カルビがない日も。

cultural_comfort.note: Bring cash even though Tabelog lists cards; arrive early in the evening, as popular cuts sell out. Smoking is allowed. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through May 2026.

kyoto_gion_boloniya_coffee.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: the menu is built on the maker’s Danish bread — honey-cheese toast, pizza toast (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_boloniya_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: Danish-bread toasts with cheese and honey (2025–26 reviews); no vegan item sourced.
kyoto_gion_boloniya_coffee.hours_raw: Daily 9:00–18:00 (last order 17:00); irregular closures (Tabelog). Order at the counter on the first floor, then sit upstairs in the second-floor café (January and October 2026). Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 46 seats (Tabelog). Power outlets and Wi-Fi (November 2025). Danish bread to take away is sold too (November 2025, October 2026).
kyoto_gion_boloniya_coffee.notes: [Café · Gion] The café of Bologna, the Kyoto maker of Danish bread loaves: order downstairs, then eat thick honey-cheese toast or pizza toast in a roomy second-floor café with outlets and Wi-Fi. Daily 9:00–18:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a café opened 24 November 2022 by Bologna, a maker of Danish bread sold in Kyoto and online.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor who had ordered the Danish bread online for about 20 years finally came to Kyoto with family to eat it in person.
A January 2026 brunch guest tried the most popular dish, the honey-cheese toast, on bread thick enough to fill up on its own; the set tea came in a large cup for about one and a half servings.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・喫茶店、東山区稲荷町南組577-1、毎日9:00〜18:00 (L.O.17:00)、不定休、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、46席、2022年11月24日オープン。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年10月、英語): 2階に広いカフェ、電源と Wi-Fi、1階で注文、デニッシュパンのチーズはちみつトースト、セットの紅茶は大きなカップ、クリームソーダ、ピザトースト、通販で約20年買っている客が来店、テイクアウトも。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the ground-floor counter, then go upstairs to sit. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_gion_boloniya_coffee.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26038642/ (35.007369, 135.778039); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区稲荷町南組577番地 (lot) 18m; offset 8 m south from the Tabelog point so as not to stack on 喫茶 六花 (577-4, same lot); 2026-11-08

kyoto_kyo_yuba_kobo.gf_detail: Ask. Fresh yuba is served with ponzu (2025–26 reviews); ponzu is usually made with soy sauce, which often contains wheat — ask about the sauce, or for the yuba plain.
kyoto_kyo_yuba_kobo.vegan_detail: Ask. Fresh yuba and hot soy milk are soy products (2024–26 reviews), but the ponzu may contain fish stock and no vegan claim is sourced; the tofu soft-serve’s ingredients are not described.
kyoto_kyo_yuba_kobo.hours_raw: Sat–Sun 12:00–17:00; closed Monday to Friday; may change (Tabelog). A small yuba workshop selling fresh yuba to eat on the spot — a ¥300 plate with ponzu (February 2025, September 2026) — with a bench outside (March 2025); you can watch it being made (February 2025). No cards; e-money accepted; no QR (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). A February 2025 visitor stopped by between Yasui Konpiragu and Yasaka Koshindo.
kyoto_kyo_yuba_kobo.notes: [Yuba · Higashiyama] A small yuba workshop near Yasui Konpiragu, open weekend afternoons: a ¥300 plate of freshly made yuba with ponzu, hot soy milk, and tofu soft-serve, eaten on the bench outside while you watch the yuba being made. A warm welcome from the owner.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a yuba workshop in Higashiyama selling freshly made yuba to eat on the spot, open on weekend afternoons.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 sightseer, between Yasui Konpiragu and Yasaka Koshindo, spotted the sign for a ¥300 fresh-yuba plate, watched it being made, and was seen off with a loud “Thank you!” from the owner.
On a cold December 2024 day a visitor warmed up with hot soy milk and fresh yuba.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 豆腐料理、東山区玉水町71-8、土日12:00〜17:00、月〜金休み、カード不可、電子マネー可、QR 不可、予約不可。口コミ (2024年12月〜2026年9月、英語): 生ゆば一皿300円をポン酢で、作るところが見られる、店主が元気に見送り、外のベンチで豆腐屋のソフトクリーム、熱い豆乳と生ゆば、温かいスタッフ、安井金比羅宮から八坂庚申堂へ向かう途中に立ち寄り、清水寺を訪れる際にまた来たいとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Eat on the bench outside; bring e-money or cash, as cards are not taken. Weekends only. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_kyo_yuba_kobo.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26030356/ (34.998729, 135.777573); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区玉水町71番地 (lot) 19m; 2026-11-08

kyoto_organic_restaurant_umi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: an organic seafood izakaya with soy-seasoned dishes, salted fish innards and fried food (2018–2026 reviews); wheat-free soy sauce is not mentioned.
kyoto_organic_restaurant_umi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-centred menu — live-fish sashimi, grilled sea bream, salted squid and fish innards (2018–2026 reviews). Organic vegetable dishes such as sesame-dressed green beans exist (2021) — ask.
kyoto_organic_restaurant_umi.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 16:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00; also noted "from 17:00"); closed on irregular days. Reservations taken; private hire by phone. No credit cards (Tabelog) — cash. 28 seats. Non-smoking; children welcome. 1st floor of the アソルティビル on the west side of Kawaramachi just south of Nijo, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae.
kyoto_organic_restaurant_umi.notes: [Organic seafood izakaya · Kawaramachi-Nijo, a fish-tank kitchen] A serious little izakaya where everything is organic — vegetables, seasonings, oil, even the sake — and the owner drives in fish from Maizuru for live sashimi, charcoal grilling and salty sake snacks. Pricey but praised; about ¥6,000–9,000. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a particular owner who serves organic sake and sources live fish himself — a July 2024 reviewer says he personally brings seafood from Maizuru, and a July 2020 reviewer heard of a fish tank in the basement. Criticism: pricey (2018–2024); several dishes very salty (September 2021).
chef_bio.philosophy: Everything organic, including seasonings and frying oil (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Live-fish sashimi; organic sake; binchotan-grilled fish.

anecdotes.text: July 2024: "The owner personally delivers fresh seafood all the way from Maizuru to Kawaramachi, showcasing their serious commitment."
February 2026: "The vegetables were surprisingly delicious, each one incredibly sweet with a rich flavor that deepens with every bite."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: オーガニックレストラン 海、魚介料理・居酒屋・鍋、中京区河原町二条下ル一之船入町347 アソルティビル1F、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分 (河原町二条を下がった西側)、毎日16:30〜22:30 (L.O.22:00、17時からとの記載も)、不定休、予約可、カード不可、28席、禁煙、子供可、調味料まですべてオーガニック、備長炭で焼き、オーガニックの油で揚げる、朝獲れの魚と有機米の日本酒。口コミ (2018年9月〜2026年2月、英語): 鯖の刺身、生きたマナガツオと肝、鱧、カサゴ (2020年7月)、牡蠣の塩辛、うるか、野菜の酢の物 (2020年9月)、鱧の燻製、ちびイカの塩辛、なまこ、有機いんげんの胡麻和え、鯛の塩焼き (2021年9月)、活け平目の刺身、お通しと日本酒のセット (2023年4月)、舞鶴から店主自ら魚を運ぶ (2024年7月)、地下に生け簀 (2020年7月)、値段は高め、塩辛い料理が多いとの声 (2021年9月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; pricey; children welcome.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with a review dated February 2026.

kyoto_kikunoi_niku_unshu.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a kaiseki-style beef course with sauces, soy, curry and a parfait (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kikunoi_niku_unshu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Chateaubriand course with seafood starters (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kikunoi_niku_unshu.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Thu–Sun 15:00–19:30; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; hours may change. Reservation only. No children. Cards. Non-smoking. One course only — ¥30,000 (June 2025), ¥33,000 (September 2025). Upstairs from 菊乃井 鮨 青 on Shimogawara-dori (September 2025 review).
kyoto_kikunoi_niku_unshu.notes: [Wagyu kaiseki · Shimogawara-dori, Kikunoi's beef counter] The famous kaiseki house's meat restaurant, upstairs from its sushi bar: a single seasonal course of Kikunoi starters around charcoal-grilled Chateaubriand, eaten with salt and then sauce, finished with beef ochazuke and curry. About ¥33,000. Reservation only; no children. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: A meat restaurant of the Kyoto kaiseki house 菊乃井 (kyoto_kikunoi_honten and kyoto_kikunoi_sushi_ao are already in data); a September 2025 reviewer found it on the floor above Sushi Ao. An April 2026 reviewer enjoyed talking with "Chef Murata" (romaji as given). A May 2025 reviewer saw a regular served a salt-free course. Criticism: a June 2025 reviewer felt the starter outshone the rest and was unsure what the restaurant was aiming for.
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto cooking techniques applied to carefully chosen meat (July 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Chateaubriand course; beef ochazuke; Unshu curry.

anecdotes.text: September 2025: "Today's meat was Chateaubriand made from Kagoshima Prefecture's black-haired Wagyu. We first enjoyed it with wasabi, salt, soy sauce, and lemon salt paste."
June 2025: "The only option is a course priced at JPY 30,000 per person… I wasn't quite sure what the restaurant was aiming for."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 菊乃井 肉 雲収、日本料理、東山区下河原通463-30、祇園四条から812m、月・木〜日15:00〜19:30、火・水曜休み、営業時間は変更の可能性あり、完全予約制、子供不可、カード可、禁煙、公式サイト kikunoi-niku-unshuu.com。口コミ (2025年2月〜2026年7月、英語・日本語): コースのみ30,000円 (2025年6月)・33,000円 (2025年9月)、鮨 青の2階 (2025年9月)、枝豆の豆腐、菊飾りの寿司、毛蟹と帆立、Akashiの鯛、鮎、鹿児島の黒毛和牛のシャトーブリアンを塩とたれで、牛の佃煮の茶漬け、雲収カレー、赤だし、シャインマスカットのパフェ、雲丹豆腐、牛タン大和煮、鱧落とし (2026年7月)、塩抜きのコースを頼む常連 (2025年5月)、Murataという料理人との会話 (2026年4月)、狙いがよくわからないとの声 (2025年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Reservation only; one course; no children.

staff_allergy_handling: A May 2025 reviewer saw a regular served a salt-free version of the course.

kyoto_hagi_saryo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soba and udon in soy-based broth, tempura soba and curry udon (2024–2026 reviews); no 100% buckwheat noodles mentioned.
kyoto_hagi_saryo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: herring, duck, chicken and anago soba in dashi (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hagi_saryo.hours_raw: Tabelog: Mon, Tue, Wed, Sat, Sun 11:30–15:00; Fri 9:00–17:00; closed Thursday. No reservations; queues move quickly (January 2026). No credit cards (Tabelog) — cash. 40 seats: tables and tatami (not sunken) looking onto a garden with a koi pond. Non-smoking. On Shimogawara by Kodaiji, between Kiyomizu-dera and Gion (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_hagi_saryo.notes: [Soba & udon · Kodaiji on Shimogawara, a garden-view noodle house] A reasonably priced, old-fashioned noodle house between Gion and Kiyomizu where you eat herring soba, yuba udon or tempura soba looking out on a garden pond with koi — about ¥1,250–1,500. Cash only. Lunch only (Friday 9–17); closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe experienced, efficient staff, a homely, traditional feel, many overseas visitors and prices below the nearby slopes (2024–2026). Criticism: no hand towels (August 2025); a broth a little light (October 2025; February 2026).

anecdotes.text: April 2025: "From the seat where we took off our shoes, we had a lovely view of the beautiful garden, complete with koi swimming in the pond."

January 2026: "In recent years, many restaurants in this area have catered to inbound tourists with their pricing and menu, but this place felt like a traditional Kyoto restaurant, which was reassuring."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 波ぎ茶寮、そば・うどん、東山区下河原町463-24、祇園四条から811m、月・火・水・土・日11:30〜15:00、金9:00〜17:00、木曜休み、予約不可、カード不可、40席、個室あり、禁煙。口コミ (2024年11月〜2026年8月、英語・日本語): 高台寺近く、鯉の泳ぐ池の庭、にしんそば1,250円、きのこみぞれそば1,350円 (2026年2月)、穴子の天ぷらそば約1,300円 (2025年10月)、鴨そば、かしわそば、天ぷらそば、山菜そば、湯葉うどん、カレーうどん、焼き飯や炊き込みご飯のセット、夏の冷やしかしわそば、せいろそばと天ぷら、手際のよい店員、海外の客が多い、おしぼりがない (2025年8月)、だしがやや薄いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Many overseas visitors (2025–2026); cash only; shoes off for tatami seats.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated April, July and August 2026.

kyoto_subabibani_shiyakusho.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: Indian and Nepali curries with very large naan, samosa and fried snacks (2025–2026 reviews). Basmati rice can replace naan (January 2026) — ask about the curries.
kyoto_subabibani_shiyakusho.vegan_detail: Ask: dal curry, vegetable curry and an eggplant-and-potato daily curry appear in reviews (2026), but cream, ghee and yogurt in the sauces were not described.
kyoto_subabibani_shiyakusho.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no hours — reviewers ate both lunch and dinner (2025–2026), so check before visiting. Cards accepted. 2nd floor of the 河二ビル on Nijo-dori just west of Kawaramachi, with large windows; about 5 min north of Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (2026 reviews). Opened in 2025 (a July 2025 reviewer says "this year"). Discount coupons sometimes on the 1st floor (July 2025). One of at least four スバビハニ shops in our crawls (丸太町, 四条大宮, リサーチパーク前).
kyoto_subabibani_shiyakusho.notes: [Indian–Nepali curry · Nijo-Kawaramachi, a bright second-floor spice izakaya] A cheerful upstairs curry house with big windows: table-sized naan, curries at your chosen heat, lunch sets from ¥950 and a ¥2,200 dinner set with tandoori chicken and Kingfisher. Hours not listed — check ahead.

chef_bio.background: A July 2025 reviewer calls it a branch of an Asian dining chain opened that year; our crawls hold four スバビハニ shops. Reviewers describe young, polite, uniformed staff who check the spice level, and prices a little below average. Criticism: flavors similar to other Indo-Nepali shops (January and May 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Giant naan; curry sets; Indian beer and whisky.

anecdotes.text: October 2026: "It was so large that it not only overflowed from the plate but also occupied half the table, resembling a freshly baked work of art."
July 2025: "This Asian dining chain opened this year on the second floor of a building near Teramachi Street, behind Kyoto City Hall."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: スパイス居酒屋 スバビハニ 京都市役所前店、アジア・エスニック、中京区二条通河原町西入榎木町87 河二ビル2F、京都市役所前から233m、営業時間の記載なし、カード可。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 2025年オープンのアジアンダイニングのチェーン店との記載、大きなナン、辛さを選べるカレー、Aランチ950円 (2026年4月)、VIPセット2,200円 (2026年1月)、マクダウェルズNo.1 600円、ナンのおかわり+100円、チキンティッカ、キーマ、マトン、ポーク、シーフード、ガーリックチキンのカレー、カシミールナン、オニオンナン、ビリヤニ、サモサ、飲み放題、丁寧な若いスタッフ。食べログの同名店: 丸太町店、四条大宮店、リサーチパーク前店。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff speak limited Japanese (January 2026); hours not listed.

kyoto_yakiniku_teien_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Salted tongue and plain-grilled cuts may suit, but marinades, sauces and the Kyoto Yaki use soy, and cold noodles contain wheat (2025–2026 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_yakiniku_teien_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu and offal yakiniku house; kimchi and namul are sides only (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yakiniku_teien_karasuma.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); Sunday, holidays and days before holidays 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Monday and the first and third Thursday — open on the Thursday when Friday is a holiday (Tabelog). Thursday is left out of the hours because it is closed two weeks a month. Reservations accepted; phone 13:00–22:00 (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog original なし). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 90 seats: 10 tables and tatami seating; 1F non-smoking, heated tobacco only on 2F (Tabelog). Touch-panel ordering (July 2026). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). Opened 16 July 2025 as the second shop of a yakiniku house near Momoyama Goryo-mae in Fushimi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). 4 min walk from Shijo or Karasuma-Oike Stn.
kyoto_yakiniku_teien_karasuma.notes: [Yakiniku · Karasuma-Rokkaku, wagyu value] The roomy second shop of a popular Fushimi yakiniku house: kuroge wagyu and very fresh offal at keen prices, a ¥5,000 all-you-can-drink course with bottomless rice, and famously fast service. No service charge. Closed Monday and the 1st/3rd Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: run by 庭園フーズ株式会社 (NTA invoice register, head office in Fushimi), this is the second shop of a popular yakiniku house in front of Momoyama Goryo-mae in Fushimi, opened 16 July 2025 with the motto of good food at affordable prices; reviewers praise cheerful, well-trained staff and very quick service (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.philosophy: Delicious food at affordable prices (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 parent who usually takes the family to the Fushimi shop got the last table here on the same day; fresh liver and sashimi-style omasum came first.
A July 2026 table found the touch-panel orders arriving so fast the staff seemed to know what was coming.
A September 2026 company party came back within a month for the ¥5,000 all-you-can-drink course with unlimited rice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・ホルモン・肉料理、中京区骨屋町152、四条駅・烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、火〜土 17:00〜22:30 (L.O.22:00)、日曜・祝日・祝日の前日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、月曜と第1・第3木曜休み (金曜が祝日なら木曜営業)、予約可、サービス料なし、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯) 可、電子マネー・QR 不可、90席 (テーブル10卓と座敷)、1階禁煙・2階は加熱式たばこのみ、子ども可、2025年7月16日開店。インボイス登録は庭園フーズ株式会社 (国税庁、伏見区)。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年10月、英語): 伏見の桃山御陵前の人気店の2号店、黒毛和牛、タン、ハラミ、サガリ、カルビ、ロース、新鮮なレバーやハツ、センマイ、ユッケ、キムチとナムル、ざらめと卵のすき焼き風「京都焼き」1,290円、石焼ビビンバ、冷麺、テールスープ、120分飲み放題とご飯おかわり自由の5,000円コース、提供がとても速い。

cultural_comfort.note: Touch-panel ordering; no service charge; book ahead.

kyoto_wagyu_kajiya.gf_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists gluten-free options, but no dish or method is named; lunch sets include tempura, kara-age and katsu, and fish is grilled with Saikyo miso (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Confirm when booking.
kyoto_wagyu_kajiya.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but none is named; sets and courses centre on wagyu and fish, and the soup is sake-lees (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_wagyu_kajiya.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–22:00; closed over the New Year holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted via TableCheck and Hot Pepper; lunch fills up, so book (Tabelog; February–July 2026). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, UnionPay), IC cards, iD, QUICPay and QR (PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay) (Tabelog). 49 seats: 1F counter, 2F private and tatami rooms for 2–8; two 2F tatami rooms are kept as kids’ rooms (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu and English-speaking staff; the manager is a wine sommelier (Tabelog). A renovated machiya said to be about 120 years old (March 2026). Opened 8 July 2024 (Tabelog). 4 min walk from Karasuma-Oike Stn.
kyoto_wagyu_kajiya.notes: [Wagyu and seafood izakaya · Karasuma-Rokkaku] A calm, high-ceilinged machiya: good weekly lunch sets with sashimi and sake-lees soup, and evening courses of the house’s own Kajiya wagyu shabu-shabu with sake or sommelier-picked wine. Tabelog lists GF and vegetarian options — ask. Kids’ tatami rooms upstairs.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya in a renovated Kyoto townhouse, opened 8 July 2024, run by 株式会社mulberry (NTA invoice register) and proud of fresh seafood, wagyu and creative dishes, with a sommelier manager. Reviewers in 2026 describe the house brand of kuroge wagyu, Kajiya beef, rice chosen by Hachidaime Gihei, and a friendly owner.
chef_bio.specialty: Kajiya wagyu shabu-shabu; weekly lunch set.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 group in the back room upstairs could not finish the ¥5,500 course of a three-tier box and wagyu shabu-shabu.
A March 2026 diner came because the queue at a neighbouring set-meal shop was too long, and found a weekly set with grilled sawara and sake-lees soup.
A July 2026 guest heard stories of the Gion Matsuri from the staff, and later found a forgotten hat kept safe.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 牛料理・居酒屋、中京区骨屋町150-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩4分、毎日 11:00〜14:30、17:00〜22:00、年末年始休み、予約可 (TableCheck・ホットペッパー)、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・銀聯)・交通系IC・iD・QUICPay・QR (PayPay・d払い・楽天ペイ・au PAY・Alipay・WeChat Pay) 可、49席、個室 (2・4・8名)、禁煙、車いす可、英語のメニューとスタッフ、ソムリエの店長、野菜・魚にこだわり、ベジタリアンとグルテンフリーの選択肢あり、2階の座敷2室は子ども部屋、2024年7月8日開店。インボイス登録は株式会社mulberry (国税庁)。口コミ (2026年1月〜11月、英語): 築120年ほどの町家、週替わり定食1,600円 (西京焼きの鰆など、刺身、だし巻き、粕汁、Hachidaime Gihei のご飯)、Haikara ランチ1,750円、唐揚げ定食1,500円、昼の御膳3,500円、5,500円のコース (三段の松花堂、黒毛和牛のしゃぶしゃぶ)、自社ブランドの黒毛和牛 Kajiya 牛、気さくな店主。

kyoto_curry_shop_family_yatai.gf_detail: Not GF: breaded tonkatsu and chicken katsu; the curry roux is not described as flour-free (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_curry_shop_family_yatai.vegan_detail: Not vegan: curry made with bonito, beef-bone and chicken stocks and minced chicken (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_curry_shop_family_yatai.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday 17:00–22:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Some reviewers describe lunchtime visits (November 2025; July 2026), so midday opening may vary. No reservations (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 5 places: 3 counter seats plus standing room; non-smoking; English menu with photos; take-out, which comes without the egg (Tabelog; December 2025). Formerly Stefan Curry, renamed by December 2025 (December 2025 reviews). Opened 6 February 2025 (Tabelog). Yokoyama Building 1F, Muromachi-Bukkoji; 5 min walk from Shijo or Karasuma Stn.
kyoto_curry_shop_family_yatai.notes: [Curry stand · Muromachi-Bukkoji] A tiny three-seat yatai-style counter from the Roji-oku roast-beef group: mild, dashi-rich minced-chicken curry topped with egg yolk, with crisp chicken katsu, tonkatsu or wagyu roast beef. Evenings; take-out too. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a curry shop from the Roji-oku group (合同会社Rミート, rmeet-kyoto.com), upgrading Roji-oku’s popular curry into an old-fashioned yatai curry; opened 6 February 2025 as Stefan Curry and since renamed CURRY SHOP FAMILY; the larger main shop is near Shichijo Station (2025–2026 reviews).
chef_bio.specialty: Family chicken katsu curry; Wagyu roast beef curry.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular back for the chicken katsu curry found the name changed but the curry as good, and took it home when the three seats were full.
A March 2026 diner learned from the friendly staff that the stand is part of the same group as nearby Roji-oku — hence the roast beef curry.
An August 2025 visitor’s first Kyoto lunch was roast beef curry topped with tonkatsu, cheese and spinach.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カレー・バル・とんかつ、下京区糸屋町229 横山ビル 1F、四条駅・烏丸駅26番出口から徒歩5分、木〜火 17:00〜22:00、水曜休み、予約不可、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、5席 (カウンター3席と立ち)、禁煙、英語の写真付きメニュー、テイクアウト可、2025年2月6日開店、紹介文 (英訳): ローストビーフの Roji-oku グループのカレー専門店、オリジナルのスパイスとかつお・牛骨・鶏白湯のだしの昔ながらの屋台カレー。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年5月、英語): 旧店名 Stefan Curry、ファミリーチキンカツカレー1,280円、ファミリーとんかつカレー1,480円、大盛り120円、チーズ100円、和牛ローストビーフカレー、卵黄のせ、サフランやターメリックのライス、やさしい辛さ、七条駅近くに本店。

cultural_comfort.note: Three seats plus standing; English photo menu; take-out.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through May 2026.

kyoto_shokudo_hayashi.gf_detail: Not GF: a diner of breaded cutlets, fries, udon and ramen with sweet demi-glace and soy sauces (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_hayashi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: meat and fish set meals with fried egg and sausage (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_hayashi.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; full at lunch and on event days near Miyako Messe and Heian Shrine, with weekend evenings busy too (March–October 2026). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 35 seats at six tables; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog). Walls covered in visitors’ signatures and messages, a Showa-era feel (May–October 2026). 2 min walk from Higashiyama Stn.
kyoto_shokudo_hayashi.notes: [Diner · Higashiyama-Sanjo, cash only] A beloved old shokudo with signature-covered walls: two-cutlet tonkatsu with a choice of sauces for ¥1,050, big hamburg and minced-cutlet plates, omurice and udon, all in big portions at old prices. No bookings; cash only. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: a Higashiyama-Sanjo diner said to have been around for over 70 years (October 2026), loved by students, locals and visitors, with walls covered in messages from famous guests (May–September 2026). A March 2026 reviewer found the owner — as rumoured, beautiful — running the busy floor single-handed; three staff handle the long menu, with young staff added (September–October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Every dish in a large portion (official site).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 visitor who ate here as a student around Higashiyama-Sanjo returned for the crisp chicken kara-age at a diner of over 70 years.
A September 2026 couple arrived just before 2 p.m. during the Kyoto Manga festival and were squeezed into a cleared table at the back.
Two diners in September and October 2026 came because the queue at Marushin Hanten nearby was too long.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食堂、東山区東大路三条下る北木之元町523、地下鉄東山駅から徒歩2分、月〜土 11:00〜15:00、17:00〜21:30、日曜休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、6卓35席、禁煙、子ども可。公式サイト: 「メニューは全部大盛り、ボリューム満点！」、「人気のオムライスは、ガッツリ食べたい方にも満足頂ける大きさで650円とリーズナブル。」。口コミ (2026年3月〜11月、英語): 70年以上続く食堂 (2026年10月)、壁一面のサインやメッセージ、昭和の雰囲気、とんかつ定食1,050円 (2枚、デミグラスやごま・みそ・おろしポン酢)、チキンカツ定食1,050円、ビッグハンバーグ定食950円、ビッグミンチカツ定食950円、白身フライとコロッケ880円、ごまチキン定食、唐揚げ、うどん550円から、ざるラーメン650円、海鮮ミックス定食950円、学生や常連や観光客、昼はいつも満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; no bookings; busy at lunch.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews through November 2026.

kyoto_shokudo_hayashi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260301/26010925/ (35.008803, 135.778161); cross-checked: GSI 京都府京都市東山区北木之元町523番地 (lot) 20 m; nearest existing record 28.0 m (mp_marushin_hanten); 2026-11-08

kyoto_maruyama_tensho.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled wagyu and steak may suit, but sukiyaki warishita, yukhoe and sauces use soy (2021–2024 reviews). No gluten information.
kyoto_maruyama_tensho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: wagyu yakiniku and sukiyaki courses (2021–2024 reviews).
kyoto_maruyama_tensho.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday and holidays 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Book dinner by the day before; groups of 8+ get a confirmation call by noon the day before, and unreachable bookings are cancelled (Tabelog). Earlier reviewers had lunch courses (2021–2025), but Tabelog now lists dinner only, with a renewal-opening campaign. No service charge (Tabelog original サービス、チャージ料なし). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 34 seats: 8 at the counter, private rooms for 4–30 and the whole building for hire; wheelchair accessible; menus in English, Chinese and Korean, English-speaking staff, kids’ menu (Tabelog). Inside Maruyama Park along a stone path; about 5 min by car from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog; December 2022). Opened 31 March 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_maruyama_tensho.notes: [Wagyu yakiniku and sukiyaki · inside Maruyama Park] A stylish two-storey house reached by a stone path in Maruyama Park, serving wagyu courses — meat sushi, yukhoe, staff-grilled steak and tongue or sukiyaki, then clay-pot rice — in private rooms with park views. Dinner only now; book the day before. No service charge. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and the official site: a wagyu yakiniku and sukiyaki restaurant inside Maruyama Park, opened 31 March 2021, run by 有限会社アダチコーポレーション (NTA invoice register; 0029.jp also links an online meat shop). Reviewers describe a still-new building, private rooms on the second floor overlooking the park, and staff who grill at the table (2021–2024).

anecdotes.text: A December 2022 diner who thought Kyoto held no more surprises found a yakiniku house inside Maruyama Park, reached by a stone path.
A March 2024 family’s sukiyaki course opened with meat sushi, the highlight, then yukhoe with egg yolk.
A November 2024 couple on the Ume course got a birthday plate in a second-floor private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・すき焼き・日本料理、東山区祇園町北側461 (円山公園内)、木〜火・祝日 17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、水曜休み、夜は前日までに予約、8名以上は前日正午までに確認の電話、サービス、チャージ料なし、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners)・PayPay 可、電子マネー不可、34席 (カウンター8席、4〜30名の個室、一棟貸切可)、車いす可、英中韓のメニュー、英語のスタッフ、子どもメニュー、2021年3月31日開店、リニューアルオープンのキャンペーン中。公式サイト 0029.jp: 京都円山 天正、京都府京都市東山区祇園町北側338番地 (円山公園内)、オンラインショップ。インボイス登録は有限会社アダチコーポレーション (国税庁)。口コミ (2021年12月〜2025年6月、英語): 石畳の先の円山公園の中の店、2階の個室から公園の緑、肉寿司、卵黄のユッケ、A4〜A5のステーキやタンを店の人が焼く、すき焼き、土鍋ごはん、梅コース、9,000円のコース、昼の焼肉ランチ (2021年、2025年6月)。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and staff; book by the day before; no service charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (renewal campaign) and official site; latest review June 2025.

kyoto_unaichi_teramachi_nijo.gf_detail: Ask. Grilled eel on rice with a sweet sauce; the sauce ingredients are not stated (2026 reviews).
kyoto_unaichi_teramachi_nijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an eel restaurant (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_unaichi_teramachi_nijo.hours_raw: 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, original なし; the English line says otherwise). Cards; QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 19 seats: six at the counter and two tables of four (May and July 2026), plus a private room for six (Tabelog; September 2026). Non-smoking (Tabelog). 5 min from Kyoto-Shiyakusho-mae station (Tabelog).
kyoto_unaichi_teramachi_nijo.notes: [Eel · Teramachi-Nijo, opened 2026] A new eel shop (April 2026) a few minutes from Kyoto City Hall, grilling Kansai-style — no steaming, so the skin comes out crisp. Unaju from ¥3,300 for half an eel; hitsumabushi too. Counter, two tables and a private room for six; open for lunch and dinner every day. Flagged: operator unknown.

chef_bio.background: Opened on 25 April 2026 (May 2026 review). No operator or chef was found.
chef_bio.specialty: Kansai-style grilled eel: unaju and hitsumabushi.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 reviewer went straight after the 25 April opening and found the grilling already steady.
A September 2026 family of three took the private room and ordered one whole-eel unaju and two half-eel ones.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うないち、うなぎ、中京区二条通寺町東入ル榎木町92-7 佐野ビル、地下鉄京都市役所前駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:00〜15:00・17:00〜21:00、サービス料なし、カード・QR (Alipay、WeChat Pay含む) 可、19席、個室6名、禁煙。口コミ (2026年、英語): 2026年4月25日開店、関西風で蒸さずに焼く、頭付き、カウンター6席と4人掛けテーブル2卓、うな重 (並・半尾 3,300円、上・1尾 5,500円、特上・2尾 10,000円)、ひつまぶし (3,700円、5,900円、10,500円)、たれの追加可。

cultural_comfort.note: Simple menu of eel bowls; Alipay and WeChat Pay accepted.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; opened April 2026; reviews dated May to September 2026.

kyoto_brisket_rony_shijo_karasuma.gf_detail: Ask. Thin-sliced brisket grilled on a teppan with house sauces, Korean pancake, fried rice; sauce ingredients are not stated (Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_brisket_rony_shijo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetable set (¥2,500) appears in a September 2026 review, but everything is cooked on the shared beef teppan with dashi-rolled egg; nothing is described as vegan (Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_brisket_rony_shijo_karasuma.hours_raw: 17:30–24:00 daily incl. public holidays; food last orders 23:45; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 29 table seats on two floors; first-floor tables are small (Tabelog; October 2026). Designated smoking area inside (Tabelog). In a back lane close to Shijo station (May 2026).
kyoto_brisket_rony_shijo_karasuma.notes: [Korean brisket grill · Shijo-Karasuma lane] A specialist in chadolbaki: paper-thin black-wagyu brisket grilled on a domed teppan with house condiments, dashi-rolled egg cooking round the edge with free refills, and fried rice to finish. Staff grill the first round and show how to eat it. Popular — book ahead. Flagged: operator MASTERMIND株式会社, other shops not found.

chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer says the owner travelled through Korea to recreate this style of chadolbaki. The receipt invoice number on Tabelog belongs to MASTERMIND株式会社 (下京区).
chef_bio.specialty: Black-wagyu chadolbaki on a domed teppan.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 party of three noted bags handed out to keep belongings clear of oil spatter, and the fat draining off the domed grill.
A September 2026 first-timer, brought by a regular, found a short queue before opening.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ブリスケロニー 四条烏丸、韓国料理・居酒屋、中京区新町通錦小路下ル小結棚町434-4、毎日 17:30〜24:00 (料理L.O. 23:45)、不定休、カード・電子マネー・QR可、テーブル29席、店内に喫煙所。メニュー: Miyagawa-cho の Ohashitei の黒毛和牛ブリスケットをプロトン凍結で極薄切りにしたチャドルバギ 1人1,800円、ホタテセット2,800円、だし巻き食べ放題600円、高菜明太炒飯900円。適格請求書: MASTERMIND株式会社 (下京区堀之内町263)。口コミ (2026年、英語): 店主は韓国を巡ってこの味を再現、野菜セット2,500円、120分飲み放題プラン6,500円、ドーム型の鉄板、2階は広いが1階のテーブルは小さい、予約で満席。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff grill the first round and explain the set.

existence.note: Tabelog official listing; reviews dated March to October 2026.

kyoto_kakyu_oshikoji.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto dishes in dashi, white miso soup, sashimi, grilled fish, fried dishes, duck soba and mackerel sushi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kakyu_oshikoji.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dishes built on dashi, with fish, duck and seafood (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kakyu_oshikoji.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00; closed the first and third Sundays of each month (Tabelog). Cards: JCB, AMEX and Diners only; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 60 seats: a counter of about six to eight, a tatami room at the back (shoes off) and a second floor with tables (Tabelog; January 2025, April and September 2026). Private rooms (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). About 10 min on foot from Karasuma-Oike, in a narrow lane (September 2026).
kyoto_kakyu_oshikoji.notes: [Kyoto cooking · Oshikoji, counter and tatami] A local favourite down a narrow lane near Karasuma-Oike: a long à la carte menu of Kyoto dishes to go with drinks — sashimi, white miso soup, grilled fish, homemade karasumi, duck soba to finish — at prices well below a formal kaiseki. Counter, tatami room and an upstairs floor; JCB, AMEX and Diners only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers describe a humble, friendly head chef with a craftsman’s seriousness (April 2026), working with young staff in front of many regulars (January 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: A place where customers can drop in often, rather than an expensive kaiseki (April 2026 reviewer’s impression).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 group on a second stop had homemade karasumi, sawara sashimi, water eggplant and two sakes upstairs for about ¥3,000 each.
A September 2026 business traveller, brought by a local, expected duck nanban soba and got a rich, creamy noodle bowl instead.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 佳久 (かきゅう)、創作料理・日本料理、中京区押小路通柳馬場西入ル竹屋町169-2、17:30〜23:00、第1・第3日曜定休、カードはJCB・AMEX・Diners、電子マネー・QR不可、60席、個室あり、禁煙、夜の予算8,000〜9,999円。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 大将と若いスタッフ、常連で満席、2階席もある、京の白味噌汁、なまこ、蟹、炭火の椎茸、締めのミニカレー、豆ご飯、新ごぼうと鶏の鍋、自家製からすみ、鰆の刺身、水茄子、鴨とイチジク、甘鯛、鴨そば、鯖の押し寿司、日替わりは値段の表示なし、カウンター6〜8席と奥に座敷。

cultural_comfort.note: Daily specials have no prices shown; shoes off in the tatami room; JCB, AMEX and Diners only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated January 2025 to September 2026. The listed site kakyu.net did not respond.

kyoto_gion_sushi_spot.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and sashimi are often served with soy sauce; tempura is also on the menu (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_sushi_spot.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 18:00–01:00; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX); no e-money (Tabelog). Counter seats only (February 2026 review). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Ground floor of the Higashi-Shinbashi Building on Shinbashi-dori east of Hanamikoji (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_sushi_spot.notes: [Sushi bar · Gion] A small late-night sushi counter with jazz on Shinbashi, open to 1 am: market fish as omakase or a la carte with drinks — a relaxed second or last stop. About ¥8,000–15,000; smoking allowed.

chef_bio.background: A chef who looks stern but is kind and funny (July 2022 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fresh fish from the market at reasonable prices, with jazz (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2022 guest was told there was no rice left, asked for just one dish instead, and found it excellent.
A February 2026 group of friends booked the whole counter and ordered a la carte, finding every dish good value.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 祇園寿司 Sushi and Bar SPOT、寿司・バー、東山区林下町427 東新橋ビル1F、月〜土 18:00〜翌1:00、日曜・祝日休み、カード可 (JCB・AMEX)、電子マネー不可、喫煙可、新鮮な仕入れの魚、ジャズ、寿司、刺身、てんぷら (紹介文、英訳)。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): メニューのないおまかせ (2022年7月)、ふたりで約2万円 (2023年7月)、カウンターのみ、アラカルトで貸切 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; no fixed menu at times.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through February 2026.

kyoto_gion_tachinomi_yamaneko.gf_detail: Ask. Craft beer is wheat or barley; the original doburoku is rice, koji and water only (own site); food includes gyoza and okonomiyaki (May 2025).
kyoto_gion_tachinomi_yamaneko.vegan_detail: Ask. Sake and doburoku (rice, koji, water — own site); snacks are mostly fish or meat.
kyoto_gion_tachinomi_yamaneko.hours_raw: Daily 13:00–23:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter; standing tables plus chairs, tables and sofas (2025 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). In a 150-year-old former teahouse behind Gion Kaikan, by the west alley of Gion Kagetsu (own site; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_gion_tachinomi_yamaneko.notes: [Craft beer · Gion] An all-Kyoto drinks bar in a 150-year-old former teahouse behind Gion Kaikan: eight local craft taps, its own doburoku, Kyoto sake and shichirin-grilled snacks, open from 1 pm. Popular with visitors; about ¥1,500–4,000.

chef_bio.background: Opened 22 April 2023 (Tabelog) in a 150-year-old former teahouse (own site; November 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Everything from Kyoto — beer, sake and whiskey (October 2026 review); food with ingredients from Tango (own site).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto craft beer on tap; shichirin-grilled dried fish.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 guest at the doburoku set was treated to sake by three overseas visitors drinking at the entrance.
An August 2026 regular tried a low-alcohol lemon ale from Nishijin Brewery and a Kyoto Beer Lab collaboration made for the bar.
An April 2026 pair were the only Japanese customers, surrounded by visitors from abroad.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: GION TACHINOMI 山根子、立ち飲み、東山区祇園町北側321-1、毎日 13:00〜23:00、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、禁煙、2023年4月22日オープン。公式サイト: 築150年の元お茶屋、クラフトビール8タップ、米と麹と水だけのオリジナルのどぶろく、七輪で焼く乾物、Tango の食材。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): Gion Kaikan の裏、京都のクラフトビール (Nishijin Brewery、Kyoto Beer Lab、Kyoto Brewing)、ビール、日本酒、ウイスキーはすべて京都 (2026年10月)、Miyazu のオイルサーディン、餃子とお好み焼き、海外の客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Mostly overseas guests; detailed beer descriptions and tasting before ordering (2026 reviews).

existence.note: Tabelog listing and own site; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_usumatsu_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: gyoza are the specialty (wheat wrappers); oden is in a Kyoto-style dashi (2025 reviews).
kyoto_usumatsu_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: gyoza with fillings such as mentaiko and octopus, and oden with beef tendon in dashi (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_usumatsu_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00, drinks 23:30); closed Tuesdays, which may change around holidays (Tabelog). Cover charge ¥385 a person (Tabelog Japanese original 「おひとり様385円（税込）」). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 28 seats: a sunken counter and tatami tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; August 2026 review). Pairs may be moved to the counter when busy (Tabelog). On Kiyamachi north of Sanjo, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog).
kyoto_usumatsu_kiyamachi.notes: [Gyoza & oden · Kiyamachi] A classic Kiyamachi izakaya with a sunken counter and tatami: crisp, juicy Kujo-negi gyoza, deep Kyoto-dashi oden and cheap seasonal plates. About ¥3,000–5,000.

chef_bio.background: Known for oden and gyoza, as the sign outside says (September 2026 review). Kind staff (July 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 couple asked whether the oden platter could be shared, and the staff cut every piece in half to share.
An August 2026 guest, turned away from several places on a Saturday night, got in without a booking and was steered to the Kujo-negi gyoza and oden.
A December 2025 visitor liked the fluffy filling of the fried gyoza in broth as a closing dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 臼松、居酒屋・餃子・おでん、中京区の木屋町、三条の北、京阪三条駅から徒歩5分、京都市役所前駅から徒歩3分、月・水〜日 18:00〜24:00、火曜休み (祝日や連休は変更あり)、お通し385円 (税込)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、28席、半個室、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): Kujo ねぎの餃子、焼き餃子と揚げ餃子 6個490円、おでん5種900円 (2026年3月)、京都の出汁のおでん、牛すじと大根、ホタルイカの酢味噌、座敷とカウンター。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off for the tatami; counter is a sunken kotatsu style (August 2026 review).

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_usumatsu_kiyamachi.pin_source: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/en/kyoto/A2601/A260202/26004053/ (35.010293, 135.770741), moved 8m ENE to clear kyoto_umemura_kiyamachi (2.9m); the address has no lot number (GSI resolves only to the ward), so loc_approx single; 2026-11-08
